        Ongoing Investigations & Unfinished Business

        Investigation (Closed): Verdas

        1978

        Henry dies defending Helen and George.

        At the time he is cursed, seemingly by Jade Fox, daughter of Verdas.

        18th July 2018

        A SATT team is assembled for a mission. It is a group that does not usually work together — Bad Moon wasn’t even a member of SATT then — and took someone with some pull to arrange. Likely someone from Section 1.

        The members were:

        • Alexia
        • Bad Moon
        • Click
        • Magnus
        • Scarab

        They were accompanied by a group of druids, most of whom (according to Major Seb) didn’t know the identities of the SATT team members.

        They bound Verdas using magic that demanded they each take on a geas.

        1st July 2022

        Members of the team that took part in the above mission are attacked.

        • Alexia is kidnapped for sacrifice (and later rescued).
        • Bad Moon is killed
        • Click is killed
        • Magnus is badly wounded
        • Scarab was later kidnapped from SATT HQ by someone with super-strength. He thought they were a man, but caught a glimpse of skirt at the last moment. He was rescued from Amarna a few months later.

        When Alexia was about to be sacrificed, a projection was reading from Verdas’ book.

        The hallmarks of the attack on Alexia (harpies, frost giants, portal stones) line up with the modus operandi of Mordred Sr..

        He denies all knowledge when challenged by SATT’s Mordred and suggests it might be his eldest surviving son.

        Scarab

        Alexia received a message from Scarab over Apollonet. “He’s found me. Don’t trust…”

        We heard nothing more from him until the Sherwood indicant when we were all pulled into a fictional Sherwood Forest by a spell cast on Henry’s curse.

        He told us he was in a jail cell in Egypt after he had been knocked on the head by somebody with super-strength (who he had through was a man but he caught a glimpse of skirt just before he was knocked out) and bound in unbreakable chains by someone (who, unhelpfully, wore a mask) who could make them liquid and twist them. He had been thrown on a boat and taken to Egypt. The messages sent through Apollonet has been sent by a friend, he doesn’t have access to the geas is still in effect.

        This was connected to Ophelia’s potion visions which show an image of The Gates of Horizon in Amarna, Egypt.

        He was rescued from a cell where he’d been put by agents of Ares and Ptah.

        See also:
        • Investigation: Missing Artefacts & Altered Files

        Investigation: Anti-Magic Kevlar & the Colani Gang

        Significant other entries related to this investigation:

        • Artefact: Anti-Magic Kevlar
        • Group: Colani Gang

        Incident 1

        A group of armed men wearing magic-absorbing kevlar assaulted Vauxhall police station in a, presumed, attempt to murder Henry. They were equipped with automatic weapons.

        Incident 2

        Michelle & Elliott raided a Colani warehouse in South Bermondsey to rescue a “friend” who owed money to them and who called Nate when she realised what sort of people she was dealing with.

        The armour appears to be part of the Colanis’ expansion.

        Additional

        A search of SATT records didn’t turn up any other incidents, so it doesn’t seem to have spread far yet.

        Mirror

        While discussing the armour with Jaxom through a mirror, Henry touched it to the mirror which disrupted the communication. It seems to flip through the views from a series of mirrors before Henry pulled back.

        1. A blonde, long-haired woman with wing tattoos down her arms in a living room
        2. Jaxom
        3. A bedroom containing ironwood furniture, axes, furs (on the bed), and dogs — Berron says the description matches his mother’s room.
        4. Jaxom
        5. A throne (empty)
        6. An open field with lots of people training (weights (beyond human level), swords, guns). While this image was visible someone on the other side pulled the matching mirror off the wall to end our vision. See The Ares / Ptah Army.

        Hephaestus

        Henry passed the armour along to Hephaestus to get his opinion of it. Details are in the kevlar entry.

        Police

        DS Fields is going to have a word with the organised crime unit to see if they know anything about the Colani gang. We should liaise with her so we don’t end up working cross-purposes with OC.

        Location unknown

        While SATT rescued Britannia they moved all their operations to locations unknown.

        Further actions

        • See what Robert Colani can tell us
        • Find them
        See also:
        • Boscastle

        • Henry in Flames
        • Raid on Amarna

        Investigation: Ashmolean Artefacts

        During the Ashmolean incident Berron noted that several artefacts on display there were magical. They should be further investigated.

        • A feathered headdress in a cabinet of curiosities.
        • The Ballyshannon Sun-disc
        • A 1892 replica of a sculpture of Helios the Sun God in the Greek/Roman sculpture gallery

        Heb-Sed Mace

        There is also a replica Heb-Seb mace on display after the original was stolen by thieves and then stolen from them by SATT and secured in a vault. The origin of the replica is unknown.

        Investigation: Cossack Graves

        See fig. 1

        A grave site in Prosenik, Bulgaria that was originally investigated in └────────────┘ by Dr Melissa Frankel was reinvestigated in 2021 by Dr. Menston Enstine (who worked under Frankel when studying for his PhD).

        This is a missing persons case and possible haunting.

        The original dig took place ahead of plans to build a spa / health hotel. After reporting of hauntings, workers refused to continue, the company behind it got cold feet, and both excavation and construction plans were abandoned. A masters student, practising with some bones recovered from the site before then, discovered that they were looking at the remains of a woman. This reignited interest.

        Since the dig restarted, the hotel application has been withdrawn.

        The graves that were thought to have been filled with Cossack warriors have, on re-examination, turned out to have been filled with women who were buried with full battle honours, bows, horses and (20, some closer to the surfaces than others) European-style swords.

        There were also Turkish tulips among the grave goods.

        A sword from the site was sent to me for investigation and verification.

        Sword

        It is a type XV sword with a plain basic guard, Damascus blade and disk pommels. The design is very workman-like, there’s nothing special about it beyond it being in the wrong part of the world (given where the blades were found, we’d expect this to be a guard-less curved blade).

        XV swords are designed to be wielded single-handed, and have a strongly tapered blade profile with an acute point and a flattened diamond cross-section. They were popular (aside from a brief blip in the first half of C15) up until around the mid-point of C16.

        The metal appears to be Wootz steel, middle-eastern in origin, typical of Damascus blades that were then drawn out of ingots that were shipped all over the known world. From the C3 to the C17, steel ingots were being shipped to the Middle East from South India.

        The hilt had the remains of a leather wrap on it. DNA analysis suggests it originated from herds in the south of England in the first half of C16.

        The trade routes of the period weren’t really set up for the distribution of this style of weapon to that part of the world.

        Given the connection to warrior women, I tracked down a story about a giant woman with a shock of white hair walking into the docks where they were unloading a boat from India that had bars of Damascus steel on board. She demanded to buy all bars and said that she would pay handsomely. She signed with a seal ring imprint on the papers: Crossed bow and sword with a horse at gallop. She paid in gold and silver and drove the cart away herself.

        Following up that line of enquire kept pulling up stories of Amazons.

        Tulips

        The grave goods included Turkish Tulips, also from the first half of C16. There isn’t any known precedent for this.

        Tulips were symbols of wealth and power in Turkey and during the sultanate. They were first cultivated in Persia.

        I’ve been unable to find any association between tulips and death, and only a couple of weak connects to local deities.

        I even reached out to an expert on botany and the afterlife; she was equally baffled.

        It isn’t an unusual part of the world to find such flowers though, it is quite close to Turkey.

        Bevo

        The goddess Bevo is reported to have had a female personal guard — I can’t find a name for her — who carried a dagger with a tulip on its sheath in her belt. She doesn’t start appearing in stories until the 1600s. Possibly this grave site has some connection to what she did before becoming Bevo’s bodyguard.

        Some depictions show the bodyguard with long red hair, others with white hair.

        Lada

        (Pronounced Larder)

        There is a legend that Lada once turned to ash a man that tried to woo her with multicoloured tulips.

        NB: Not to be confused with Leda, despite it being entirely on theme for her to kill a man for showing her romantic interest.

        Lada tried to get Henry to be her knight.

        Women

        The ethnic groupings of the deceased are eastern Slavic, Danube, and North Turkish, so they didn’t travel particularly far from their birthplaces (unlike, say, the Varangian Guard).

        When they died they were aged between 15 & 38, and in relatively good health for that period. Many had broken and healed bones. They did lots of riding, sword-fighting and training.

        Dating

        Everything that can be dated so far fits the period of the first half of C16. Some elements have a much wider range, but the tulips and leather narrow it greatly.

        Politics

        At the time, Russia believed that groups of Cossacks were working for the sultanate and vice versa.

        Missing persons

        Petre Asmario left the dig, saying it made him uncomfortable, but is continuing to work on his Masters in archaeology.

        Two others have disappeared — no posts on social media, missing person reports filed, families haven’t seen them but don’t know why they disappeared because they were away at university.

        Eliza has long brown hair, is gangly, and has a horsey face. The other student is balding on top even though he is only 24.

        They told the Dr. Menston Enstine they didn’t enjoy working there and thanks for the opportunity but they were going home.

        Ghost stories

        Stories from the original dig mention howling and the sound of things bashing against rock.

        A couple of students from the second dig have quit saying that they didn’t like the site.

        Speaking to Petre Asmario I got the impression he was holding something back. He did say that students had seen things moving in the dark when nobody was there, and that there were loud howls echoing across the landscape. The local villagers will, apparently, not venture outside at night, even the local pub shuts at sundown.

        A bestial vampire was slain in the area after SATT arrived to investigate.

        Finances

        The university seemed to be providing an excessive amount of funding to the dig and to Enstine. On the surface it appeared that the money was coming from relatives of former students, but the relatives didn’t exist and the money could only be traced back as far as a couple of shell corporations.

        Misc

        Viktor Yahontov was seen in the area.

        Speculations

        There is precedent for warriors to travel extraordinary distances for work dating back at least as far as 874 when the Rus’ provided the earliest members of the Varangian Guard, which was later made up primarily of Scandinavians.

        This could be a previously unknown military force, possibly mercenary in nature.

        The tulips may represent a love of the leader if this group, a symbol adopted by them. This plays well with the possible connection to Bevo’s guard.

        Different hair? Familial role?

        Alternatively, they may be a sacrifice of wealth, either to show someone’s opinion of the worth of the fallen or as wealth to be carried into the afterlife.

        Investigation: Heb-Sed Ceremony

        The meeting

        Taranis arranged a meeting between the team, himself and “other parties we had battled in the past” about a matter he claimed would be of mutual interest. He made the approach via Michelle and we met with him at Mac’s.

        The other parties at the meeting were:

        • Susan Grey representing the Phoenix Library.
        • A cloaked figure representing the Hand of Isis. We never did see her face, but she shared an accent with Vanessa.

        They explained that they had made a pact to ensure that every 3000 years a special Heb-Sed ceremony would take place. The next time the ceremony is due to take place is approximately one year from time of the meeting (which puts it in September 2023).

        The consequences of the ceremony not taking place would be Set and his scions losing their powers. This could allow Apep to break though.

        The children of Apep would likely try to prevent this from taking place, so we need to be on the look out for Michael and Travette.

        If we want to keep any of the artefacts after the ceremony we would need to become signatories to the pact. Artie has suggested that SATT doesn’t sign up, but that possibly Maggie’s Library and/or the Watling Estate do instead.

        • A mace (probably the one formerly in the Ashmolean) and now at SATT.

        Investigation: Henry’s Curse

        Helen and George

        While protecting Helen and George, Henry fought a creature of smoke and darkness near Edinburgh and was killed.

        During the fight Henry said “You shall not have them!” as he fought the creature, which breathed flames. This melted The Watling Sword almost down to the hilt but he continued to strike at it. The creature forced him to the ground tearing at his chest, he burned his hands, then forced the remains of the sword through the creature’s forehead. Then he was crawling towards a door. There were bright lights and a dark figure and then death.

        Note: For some reason, this makes me think of the dragon in Beowulf. It is a sheer a sheer gut feeling and I can’t figure out what brought it to mind.

        There was a mark where he fell, but this disappeared after Mina cast Aphrodite’s spell.

        Henry’s body was so damaged during the fight that it took him about half a century to return and cost Aphrodite a lot of power to make it happen.

        At this time, and it isn’t clear if it was directly connected to the fight or not, Henry was cursed with a necromantic spell. It is designed to consume the body with flames and allow the caster to control the body. As far as we know, only Jade Fox is powerful enough to cast the spell.

        Shared Memories

        Half a day later, Artie arrived, found Henry’s body very slowly dissolving and cut himself on the remains of the Watling sword. This appears to have mingled his blood with Henry’s and the creatures and caused him to have nightmares in which he relived Henry’s various deaths ever since.

          Investigation: Phoenix Servers

          Someone claiming to be Phoenix ran a bank of servers out of a hat shop, owned by Dominique Strondel in Vienna.

          She allowed them to be hosted there after her husband kidnapped their daughter.

          Maggie managed to extract data from the servers before the ICE caused them to self-destruct.

          The data included:

          • Client names
          • A list of art caches
          • The auction website Mordred Jr. was invited to in Vienna
          • Intrusion countermeasure software that was able to self-destruct the servers

          People invited to the auction included:

          • Mordred Sr.
          • Frederic Hundertwasser
          • A total of about 20 people who were known to be at the opera and 10 others

          Why were the Phoenix servers in the basement of a hat shop?

          • They put them there by means of kidnapping and threats, which is an extreme measure when they could just rent some space.
          • It’s uncharacteristically unprofessional of them. Phoenix can afford secret underground bunkers or whatever else they need to really keep servers secure.
          • It’s been going on for a year so it can’t be a sudden lack of funds that they are using the auction to compensate for.

          Operation: Save Happy

          My younger brother, Mordred, was (until I met Berron and Artie) the only member of my family I gave a damn about. I’d very much like to see him free of our father’s influence, but he has grown up under that influence and I don’t know if he would betray me if I were to give him a hint of my real loyalties.

          The Wren Prophecy

          Roxanne, the Amazon’s Seer, has seen that a wren will be very important to Alexia.

          There was a follow up prophecy:

          The seer has seen the wren burning to ash or ash covering the wren.

          It is very rare to have a second vision on same subject.

          On the flight back from our Bulgarian investigation we had a related vision: A wren on mound of ash, the bird flies through the ash and emerges as statue of wren.

          Facts & Legends About Wrens

          Wren derives from a middle english word.

          Greens knew them as king, smallest but fiercest of birds.

          They have few mythological connections.

          Wrens capture small frogs & lizards, so a very tenuous link that might cast them as the enemy of Apep; there are lots of small fauna that eat frogs and lizards though.

          One obscure Spanish fable has the wren “destroying the future”.

          Generally a good, respectable bird.

          How the Wren became the King

          The wren was also known as the kuningilin (‘kinglet’) in Old High German.

          In certain fables it is considered to be the king of the birds.

          Many years ago all of the birds of the world gathered to decide which one of them will be crowned King of the birds. After much debate, the owl; being the most wise, decided that the bird that flies the highest shall be king. At this, the Wren thought to himself: “The owl thinks he is the wisest of all birds but I’m wiser than he is, as I already know which bird will fly highest” . During the competition, the strong Eagle only took one flap of its wings to send them soaring high in to the sky. The timid Wren grew weak and tired and flapped for all its worth to keep up.

          The Wren made a brave effort and was cheered on by those below who admired a courageous underdog. However, only the Eagle prevailed as it climbed higher into the sky. The Eagle decided to conclude the contest and for its big finale, it aimed like a dart through the clouds using his big powerful wings.

          The Eagle smugly congratulated himself and then began his descent. However, as he did so, he heard a small, joyful voice above him cheering “I am king! I am king!” It was the Wren, who had seemingly clung to the Eagle’s back and thus flew higher than him. The Eagle was furious at this, but was too exhausted from the competition to fly any higher.

          When the Wren landed, the small songbirds were overcome with joy and surprise. The larger birds were enraged and claimed that he only won through trickery and cunning. The Wren replied, “The Eagle would have won through strength and brawn, why is that better than cunning and intelligence? If you have your doubts name another challenge and I will win once more.” The birds then acclaimed the Wren king, and the Eagle flew back to the mountains in disgust; beaten by brains, not brawn.

          This fable was already known to Aristotle (Historia Animalium 9.11) and Pliny (Natural History 10.95) and was taken up by medieval authors such as Johann Geiler von Kaisersberg, but it most likely originally concerned kinglets (Regulus) and was apparently motivated by the yellow “crown” sported by these birds (a point noted already by Ludwig Uhland).

          Gaelic Mythology

          The wren is considered a “most sacred bird” and called Drui-en or Druid bird in Irish Gaelic. In Welsh the word Dryw means both druid and wren.

          The wren is (as is the Druid) known to be cunning. The wren could soar to heights while also navigating hedges and underbrush.

          It is said that the Druid’s house was the wren’s nest and that the wren’s nest was protected by lightning.

          Whoever tried to steal wren’s eggs or baby wrens would find their house struck by lightning and their hands would shrivel up.

          The wren was hunted and killed in a ritualistic way, enacting the idea that the death of a god bestows strength on his killer, a variant of the belief that in the killing of the old king, his powers will be passed on to his successor.

          The wren symbolised wisdom and divinity. It is difficult to actually see a wren. At New Year it is said that the apprentice Druid would go out by himself into the countryside in search of hidden wisdom. If he found a wren he would take that as a sign that he would be blessed with inner knowledge in the coming year. Finding a creature small and elusive to the point of invisibility was a metaphor for finding the elusive divinity within all life.

          Auguries were drawn from its chirping. The direction from which it calls is highly significant.

          The bird was sacred to Taliesin.

          In Scotland it was the Lady of Heaven’s Hen and killing it was considered extremely unlucky.

          In Ireland it was known as ‘Fionn’s doctor’.

          Lightning was the weapon of the thunder bull-god Taranis, who often inhabited oak trees, and the wren was sacred to Taranis.

          Aphrodite

          Aphrodite is an ancient Greek goddess associated with love, beauty, pleasure, passion and procreation. She was syncretized with the Roman goddess Venus. Aphrodite’s major symbols include myrtles, roses, doves, sparrows, and swans.

          She is married to Hephaestus.

          Patron of The Eternal Knight, she gifted Tizona to him and provided the unentwining spell.

          She says Britannia is “a very good friend of mine”, and was masquerading as her in her absence.

          Now that Britannia has returned, she barely recognises her sister.

          Greek god of war. Father of Whisper / Lancelot, Leda, and Hippolyte. His other children include Thrax, Discord, Terror (Deimos), Fear (Phobos/Strach), and Bloodshed (Enyo). Also Bernardita and César. Grandfather of Llŷr ap Leda.

          Believed to covet the Horn of Winds.

          In an alliance with Ptah. They have a facility in Amarna.

          Described by Aphrodite as a “vicious, backstabbing, conniving bastard”.

          Mordred Sr. claims he wants to replace Zeus, has a beef with one of his siblings over a bet or something, and that the god likes a drink (and his scion’s may too).

          Artie

          See fig. 4

          Alias

          • Beari, Captain Aurtoro

          Head of SATT’s Section 13. Reincarnation of King Arthur. Scion of Britannia. Wielder of Gram, which fits his hand like an extension of his own body and is able to carry it unnoticeably (although I have no idea if that is his ability or one of the sword’s). He is a highly capable swordsman and can summon a suit of amour when needed.

          Reincarnation

          He has resurrected multiple times over the years, each time with different names, faces, and skills.

          Relationships

          Has had an ongoing relationship with Freya for a long time (according to Whisper, he fell hard for the goddess when he was a scribe in the 1200s) and is the father of Berron. (I’m starting to suspect that the whole thing with Lancelot and Guinevere wasn’t entirely one-sided).

          At SATT

          Usually puts on a stutter.

          Keeps a secure office some distance from Patrizia’s — down the corridor, left, left again, half way down the corridor, then the application of a gesture and verbal command to unveil the door.

          The study is furnished in classic 1940s style, heavy on the leather arm chairs (which appear to be enchanted for comfort), leather bound books and pictures (mostly not leather bound). The one nod to the modern world is a high end coffee machine.

          Notable pictures include:

          • A candid B&W photograph of Whisper
          • A recent photograph of Vanessa (their exact relationship isn’t known)
          • WWII flyboys
          • WWI tank crew
          • A pencil drawing of the Eternal Knight circa the 3rd crusade. He is short, broad and has wispy brown hair. The coat of arms is presented here.
          • Several of a Roman-style goddess — Britannia — one conceals a classic tumbler driver combination safe.

          He was reliving Henry’s deaths in nightmares, which were related to the curse.

              Dearg-Due

              After an arranged marriage to an abusive and controlling clan Chieftain, she become depressed and wasted away. Her husband took another wife before her body was even cold.

              One man cared and visited her grave every day praying for her return, but it was out of anger and retribution that she climbed from her coffin and returned to her childhood home where she sucked the life out of her father.

              Next she returned to her husband and was enraged to find him surrounded by lovers. She latched on to him and drew every breath and every ounce of blood from his body.

              She now had a hunger for blood that could not be sated. She lures young men into her arms where she can feed on them.

              Ally of Mordred.

              Declan Holt

              See fig. 7

              Alias

              • Barbatos

              The Red Dragon lists a Barbatos as a subordinate of Satanachia (commander-in-chief of Satan’s army). and he gets a mention in The Lessor Key Of Solomon and Pseudomonarchia Daemonum. The name derives from the Latin barbatus, meaning “bearded”. The demon is reputed to be able to speak to animals, tell the future, conciliate friends and rulers, and lead men to treasure hidden by the enchantment of magicians.

              It’s possibly that he took the alias because of his beard and then gave his team animal code names in response to the legend. On the other hand, he is new to the Colani gang like the Lieutenant. It might be a good idea to get a look at him and test him for magic.

              A thug and enforcer in the Colani gang brought in by Lou and on the Met’s watch list. He was seen speaking to Jade Fox outside Berron’s release party.

              Like the Lieutenant, He is new to the Colani gang, and wasn’t connected to them before Lou took over.

              He has a distinctively huge beard.

              He is known to work closely with four people loyal to him. They are only known by the aliases Falcon, Wolf, Kestrel and Fox.

              Kestral and Fox were not seen by the Met for three months and were presumed dead by then. SATT saw them more recently, but they were killed in the destruction of Profane.

              Berron reports that there was a magical link running between Barbatos, Kestrel and Wolf.

              He has been known to frequent The Green Man at Bermondsey and the Elephant and Castle.

              Co-owner of Profane (although that means little after the nightclub’s destruction). The site appeared to have been being used for the extraction of blood for use in the production of anti-magic kevlar.

              See also:

              • Jones

              John Dee

              John Dee (13 July 1527 – 1608 or 1609) was an Anglo-Welsh mathematician, astronomer, astrologer, teacher, occultist, and alchemist. He was the court astronomer for, and advisor to, Elizabeth I, and spent much of his time on alchemy, divination and Hermetic philosophy. As an antiquarian, he had one of the largest libraries in England at the time. As a political advisor, he advocated for the founding of English colonies in the New World to form a “British Empire”, a term he is credited with coining.

                  Eris

                  Greek goddess of chaos, strife and discord. The daughter of Zeus and Hera. Mother of the Strifes.

                  Eris played an important role in the events that eventually led to the Trojan War. All of the Olympians had been invited to the wedding of Peleus and Thetis, who would become the parents of Achilles; however, Eris was not invited, due to her inclination to cause discord. As a means of revenge, Eris dropped the golden Apple of Discord into the party, which had the words To The Fairest One inscribed on it. Hera, Athena and Aphrodite started quarrelling over who the apple should be given to, so Zeus appointed Paris, Prince of Troy, as the person to solve the dispute. The goddesses offered Paris various gifts, but he eventually picked Aphrodite, who promised him the most beautiful woman in the world; Helen, wife of Menelaus, king of Sparta.

                      Guerrier, Madeline

                      An American bartender and forger based out of Club Rio in Albuquerque.

                      She is the daughter of a Haitian Vodou priestess and was nearly taken by The Asclepius Institute when they came for her mother. Thanks to her mother holding them off, she had a chance to escape and found herself on the streets at the age of 16. She fell in with a gang and took to crime to survive, she quickly became an expert pickpocket.

                      After a few years, she was taken in by a forger who was losing the dexterity in his fingers to arthritis and needed someone nimble to handle the detailed parts of his work. After some years, she returned from grocery shopping to find him dead in a pool of blood. An unhappy customer had caught up with him.

                      She fled with the skills she had learned and ended up in Albuquerque where she set herself up in business.

                                    Lada

                                    Lada is a goddess in Baltic and Slavic mythology associated with beauty and fertility. Her masculine counterpart is called Lado. Lada and Lado are sometimes seen as divine twins, and at other times as a mother goddess and her son. They are commonly mentioned together in songs related to planting, harvesting, and weddings. Together, Lada and Lado form one aspect of a multiple deity, whose other names and aspects relate to the Sun, water, and grain, respectively.

                                    Worship of Lada and Lado is attested in Russia between the fifteenth and eighteenth centuries during springtime fertility rites, as well as in Polish church prohibitions on pagan rituals. Some scholars have suggested that Lada and Lado are not the names of deities, but simple refrains in songs and poetry. However, a number of songs and historical chronicles provide evidence for a cult of worship.

                                    There is a legend that Lada once turned to ash a man that tried to woo her with multicoloured tulips.

                                          Mordred (Sir.)

                                          A sorcerer and titan. The betrayer of Camelot and the Round Table. Son of Arthur and Morgan Le Fae. His aunts are Elaine and Morgawse.

                                          According to Sam he was driven mad by the worship of Mithras.

                                          He has many children trained to act as his operatives, although most of them are dead.

                                          He ordered the Antonovich Elimination to kill Nikolai.

                                          Owns Clarent which he used to wound Arthur at the Battle of Camlann. His mother gave him a dagger of disease.

                                          He takes a direct interest in the financial state of his Empire, which includes the shell company Prime Advisors Inc.

                                          One of his schemes involves a priestess.

                                          He considers himself the rightful owner of Ireland, which has put him in contention with the Fomorians.

                                          His castle exists in a pocket dimension, surrounded by rolling green hills. Known exits from it are listed in the section on portals.

                                          Until recently has been, grudgingly, working for his father (e.g. during in the Antonovich Elimination which got General Pushkin his job). He is currently on secondment to SATT where he has an office near Alexia’s and has found himself working for his grandfather.

                                          He has several siblings and generic testing has confirmed he shares a father (but not a mother) with Llŷr ap Leda.

                                          Currently living with Michelle at his home in Lambeth.

                                          His mother was (according to his father) a temple maiden but he knows nothing more of her, and was punished by his father when he asked about her. There is nothing about her recorded in the book of births, although that isn’t the case for many of his brothers.

                                          Later he and Isis claimed she was his mother.

                                          His actual mothers are Zana and Nephthys.

                                          Jonny of Jötunheimr is his twin.

                                          He bears Kladenets (but is not sure why his father gave it to him) and Brainbiter (after drawing it from SATT’s keystone).

                                          See the Pendragon Family for details of his siblings although, of them, he only really gets along with Happy and Metty now he knows her true nature.

                                          He feels a certain kinship to Mark via shared parental issues and has started to take the young scion under his wing.

                                          He was trained in piloting by Charles Nungesser.

                                          Known associates include:

                                          • Benny
                                          • Dr. Richard Mayweather
                                          • Michelle Devereaux
                                          • Seb
                                          • Jeremy Brand

                                          Mordred’s office at SATT is a standard SATT office across the corridor from Alexia’s into which he has put some nicer furniture (with leanings towards mahogany and leather). There’s a whiteboard positioned where it cannot be seen from the window, vaguely sensitive documents are locked away when he isn’t there, and really sensitive documents are destroyed.

                                          He keeps a couple of books in a drawer — The Prince (which he finds a useful reminder of his father’s state of mind) and the Merchant of Venice (which resonates with him) — and his work laptop gets dropped on top of them and locked away at night.

                                          He keeps a deactivated pistol the used to belong to a mobster as a reminder of lessons learned during an early mission. It used to live inside a puzzle box before it was moved for security reasons.

                                          Sometimes copies of academic papers he is working can be found there.

                                          There are a few bottles of alcohol locked away in various drawers, but most are used for bribing people (such as Jerry). The bottle of mead in his desk drawer is the exception.

                                          He claims to have woken up in the Paris catacombs after one night of particularly heavy drinking. This is true, and as a consequence he is an associate member of Société du Cinéma Secrètement Parisien.

                                          He is the subject of a prophecy about swords by Roxanne.

                                          A member of White’s.

                                          The Morrígan

                                          The Morrígan or Mórrígan, also known as Morrígu, is a figure from Irish mythology. The name is Mór-Ríoghain in Modern Irish, and it has been translated as “great queen” or “phantom queen”.

                                          The Morrígan is mainly associated with war and fate, especially with foretelling doom, death or victory in battle. In this role she often appears as a crow, the badb. She incites warriors to battle and can help bring about victory over their enemies. The Morrígan encourages warriors to do brave deeds, strikes fear into their enemies, and is portrayed washing the bloodstained clothes of those fated to die. She is most frequently seen as a goddess of battle and war and has also been seen as a manifestation of the earth- and sovereignty-goddess, chiefly representing the goddess’s role as guardian of the territory and its people.

                                          The Morrígan is often described as a trio of individuals, all sisters, called “the three Morrígna”. Membership of the triad varies; sometimes it is given as Badb, Macha and Nemain while elsewhere it is given as Badb, Macha and Anand (the latter is given as another name for the Morrígan). It is believed that these were all names for the same goddess. The three Morrígna are also named as sisters of the three land goddesses Ériu, Banba and Fódla. The Morrígan is described as the envious wife of The Dagda and a shape-shifting goddess, while Badb and Nemain are said to be the wives of Neit. She is associated with the banshee of later folklore.

                                          Ophelia has summoned her twice and said that the next time she will appear as The Night Hag. Presumably this means that each summoning brings a different one of the trio (whether they are individuals or just aspects of the same person)..

                                            Philibert Aspairt

                                            During the French revolution, a doorman at the Val-de-Grâce hospital by the name of Philibert Aspairt got lost on the way to fetch a certain liqueur from a cellar and entered the Paris Catacombs instead. He never came out.

                                            It wasn’t until 11 years later that his body was found, and only identified by the hospital keys on his belt. He was burred where they found him.

                                            Every November 3rd, his spirit haunts his grave.

                                            The rest of the time, he can usually be seen at the Société du Cinéma Secrètement Parisien where he retells old stories in exchange for bar money.

                                                  Rowland, Annabelle

                                                  Was a member of SATT section 5 (the warriors’ section). People stopped volunteering to be part of it after various botches led to deaths (including members of the team). Annabelle was the last member of section 5 at which point she transferred to section 9.

                                                  In 18?? she experimented upon two vampires — Mina Harker and Nathaniel — against their will and to within one inch of their existence. This took place in Boston, Lincolnshire, England in a large warehouse behind St. Guthlac’s Church near Church Green Road. The League put an end to that.

                                                  Mina’s description of her: About 5’6” very long brown hair hazel eyes. Smelt of lavender. She used to lean over us to check our status and you could smell it thick enough to choke on. She liked gold jewellery. She had a thick gold chain with an amber pendant with three beads at the top that she wore under her blouse. She walked with purpose and you could. You could hear her approaching. Clack clack clack.

                                                  Sam

                                                  Alias

                                                  • Gawain (Sir.)

                                                  A Titan spawn known as Sam. Sam is incredibly well respected among the Titans. His Patron is Hyperion (treats him with respect and he has been given many gifts during his very long life.).

                                                  SATT’s first recorded interaction with him was in 520 AD leading a fighting force in what is now Germany.

                                                  Likes honey cake, fine wines and Indian food. Dislikes daffodils raspberry and orange.

                                                  Sam lives at a villa in the south of France. It is built using modern materials and techniques but in the Roman style. It is decorated with images of Lancelot du Lac, Guinevere, Arthur and Roman Senators.

                                                  He has a passion for history. The guest rooms feature old masters. The library is full of leather bound books (many about history).

                                                  The computer centre is a serious piece of work.

                                                  His training room has scorched targets but no sign of projectile weapons. There is also a suit of armour, with no livery.

                                                  At the heart of the villa is a pool featuring a mosaic of Britannia with a sundisc overlooking her.

                                                  He has a London residence at 41 Gloucester Place.

                                                  Sir. Gawain was a knight of the the Round Table.

                                                  Due to their affair, he killed Sir Lamarok and Morgawse (although the latter was secretly saved). Sir. Avalon tried to poison him in revenge.

                                                  At the final battle he threw Excalibur into the lake, then met Lancelot and got into a fight, which he lost. He cried out and was saved by the Titans who earned his loyalty.

                                                  He can probably be counted on to send aid against Ares and Ptah.

                                                    A Seelie Fae and former ruler of that court: “The King of Light and Illusion” and “Lord of Fire and Beauty”. He is strikingly beautiful.

                                                    While ruling, Mirtasha was his champion.

                                                    He is a signatory of the Heb-Sed Pact.

                                                    He believes Alexia should be his bride (in part, at least, due to his interpretation of the prophecy regarding the Seelie Curse). She disagrees.

                                                    Berron removed his left hand at the elbow (and the powers associated with it, it isn’t known if that is the powers associated with Fire or with Beauty).

                                                    Disposed during the Seelie Coup; the loss of his arm makes him imperfect and ineligible for the throne. He probably wants to be the power being the throne and may be throwing his backing behind Vanya.

                                                    He reported to be a long term ally of Unseelie Princess Cel.

                                                    He seems to be recuperating in Switzerland. He wears clothes that are beautifully tailored to fit, despite the missing forearm.

                                                    He is the instigator of SATT’s Heb-Sed Investigation.

                                                    See also:
                                                    • Heb Sed Progress
                                                    • The Fête of Watling
                                                    • Meeting Taranis
                                                    • Selecting a Monarch of Seelie
                                                    • Vienna

                                                    Theia

                                                    In Greek mythology, Theia is a Titaness, a daughter of Gaia and Uranus, associated with sight and the shining light of the heavens. With her brother Hyperion she is the mother of Helios, the Sun, Selene, the Moon, and Eos, the Dawn.

                                                    See also:
                                                    • Gawain in London

                                                    Themis

                                                    In Greek mythology, Themis is a Titaness, a daughter of Gaia and Uranus, who personifies divine law, order and justice. She is associated with prophecy and wise counsel, and with Zeus she is the mother of the Horae, who represent order and the seasons, and, in Hesiod’s account, the Moirai, or Fates.

                                                    See also:
                                                    • Gawain in London

                                                    Theon

                                                    Head of SATT’s Section 4. Husband of Juna. Doesn’t get on with Artie.

                                                    See also:
                                                    • The Fall of SATT

                                                    Thom

                                                    A villager from Jötunheimr.

                                                    Son of Finaya and brother of Latrixia.

                                                    See also:
                                                    • Visiting Jötunheimr

                                                    Thor

                                                    Norse god of thunder, lightning, storms, sacred groves and trees, strength, the protection of mankind and also hallowing and fertility.

                                                    He was unable to kill Tallana the Ice Giant Princess in combat.

                                                    His chariot is pulled by the goats Tanngrisnir and Tanngnjóstr.

                                                    See also:
                                                    • A Tricky Christmas
                                                    • To the Land of Ice
                                                    • Magnus

                                                    Thrax

                                                    Alias

                                                    • Thracian, The

                                                    Son of Ares. A couple of myths claim he is a god but he may just be a powerful scion.

                                                    He has a presence that demands attention.

                                                    Owner of a gym.

                                                    He was reportedly cast out by his father after refusing an order on the battlefield. This raises questions about why he seems to be doing so well compared to Lance who was only allowed out for part of each century and got stuck with one of the Strifes.

                                                    It makes me wonder if the nice meeting rooms that are at the gym are really part of an intelligence gathering operation for Ares.

                                                    See also:
                                                    • Michael and the Gym

                                                    Tinanai

                                                    Member of the Seelie Court. She considers herself to be a mover and shaker (she is in a minority in this).

                                                    Has a power that can make a man (and probably a women) infatuated with her (although those in love may be immune). She was completely lacking in subtlety as she tried to get members of the Arbiter’s party under her influence.

                                                    Reportedly ,her power doesn’t work upon those who are in love.

                                                    See also:
                                                    • Selecting a Monarch of Seelie

                                                    Travette

                                                    Sister to Maggie, Guthywn and Michael (who considers her a zealot). Daughter of Apep.

                                                    Currently in Jötunheimr where she is engaged to be married to Prince Sepin with whom she appears to be in love.

                                                    Scrimshaw

                                                    There exists a 1908 carving of a WW1 nurse — Mary Beth Williams (she was killed by a shell attack in 1915) — at the IWM. It is labelled Travette.

                                                    “To my love Travette, may giant guardians protection you in the field”

                                                    Mordred raised her spirit and we determined that she was definitely dead.

                                                    Twins

                                                    From an interview with a new up & coming actor:

                                                    “Yes, this is my big break so excited to have this chance to work with the director on this big movie. Of course he was going to ask me to play the role twice but I said I had found someone that looked almost identical to me in a coffee shop in New York. Meet Philippa who plays my twin in the movie.”

                                                    “Hi yes im a biology student at Harvard but doing this was a great chance to expand my horizons.”

                                                    They also look identical to Travette.

                                                    See also:
                                                    • Michael the Book Dealer
                                                    • Investigation: Heb-Sed Ceremony

                                                    Uilia

                                                    An Ice Giant of Jötunheimr. Advisor to King Reum. Vassal to Sir. Mordred.

                                                    Jus does not like him.

                                                    See also:
                                                    • To the Land of Ice

                                                    Vanessa

                                                    Leader of SATT’s Section 6.

                                                    Alexia thinks Vanessa has some kind of grudge against her, and she did drop the team into things with the Seelie Coup Affair. She definitely [dislikes Maggie](#identity games).

                                                    She has a coin bearing the symbol of the leader of the snake-hating Hand of Isis hidden in the ceiling of her office which is defended by Egyptian guardian statues.

                                                    She also has a number of possible artefacts in the room:

                                                    • Shabti is shape of Bes
                                                    • Girdle of Isis AKA Tyet
                                                    • A Was-sceptre
                                                    See also:
                                                    • Investigation: Heb-Sed Ceremony

                                                    Vanya

                                                    Alias

                                                    • Lady of the Wind and the Rain

                                                    Lady Vanya is a Seelie Fae: “The Lady of the Wind and the Rain”. She is likely to be given an official position of Champion by King Kavath and Queen Letia.

                                                    She is reported to never leave Seelie.

                                                    Vanya is known to be incredibly skilled with the sword but, in 1720, she lost a duel with Love’s Champion when he represented Kavath. This left both of them injured, Vanya on her left leg which she now always keeps covered. The scars took three centuries to heal.

                                                    She was connected to Taranis but he bored of her after the injury. Despite that, Mordred Sr. thought he was backing her for the throne.

                                                    Cel took her as a lover and manipulated her as part of her plot.

                                                    She was attacked by Mirtasha and scared. They will heal in 3-400 years.

                                                    Verdas

                                                    Alias

                                                    • Plant Sorcerer, The

                                                    Former head of the Druids of England. He wanted to control Britannia and was gathering power to do so, part of his plan involved sacrifice.

                                                    Father of Jade Fox and Charlie Watson.

                                                    His magic allowed him to manipulate plants, shapeshift into animals and draw power from the henges of Britain (e.g. Stonehenge and Seahenge). His magic was usable in combat and he was physically strong.

                                                    He might have had a druid grove. If it could be found, destroying it might weaken his power. There are many groves around the Iron-Age and Early Neolithic Long Barrows. (Possibly Lincolnshire).

                                                    He appears in various ancient poems about druids. He once had a wife - the Great Bardess of Cornwall. The story goes that their breakup started when she cut him with her necklace made of tourmaline. The tourmaline was cracked, and it damaged him. This revealed his true nature - power hungry and ruthless - and is what led to their divorce.

                                                    He finally imprisoned her in Boscastle, in Highcliffe. (Using the same sacrifice magic that has been used to bind him. She’s possibly bound in the rock).

                                                    He was trapped in a pocket dimension with the access point being a room in Porton Down. There was an effort to release him during the Stonehenge Incident. A later effort by his daughter saw him freed.

                                                    He is not known to have any allies. It’s possible that whomever (suspects include Mordred and Wally) is trying to release him is another enemy of Britannia, or anyone who wants Britain destabilised or anyone who thinks they will be able to control him.

                                                    The team that trapped him took on various geas as part of the binding and consisted of:

                                                    • Alexia (Geas broken)
                                                    • Bad Moon (Killed)
                                                    • Click (Killed)
                                                    • Magnus (Geas intact)
                                                    • Scarab (Missing; Geas appears broken)
                                                    • Seb Andrews (Unknown if he took on a geas or not: Check with Alexia)
                                                    • Other druids

                                                    The geas could be recast with more people, Or someone could be sacrificed to make the spell stronger. A willing sacrifice would be strongest.

                                                    He seems to be caught up in the curse on Henry. It seems to have been initiated by his daughter, but he may have been involved in the casting of it.

                                                    After escaping from Porton Down, he was weakened when the various circles he was drawing power from were diverted by Mordred and some of the power released as backlash. He was then hunted down by the SATT team and died after Mordred stabbed him in the back and Alexia caved his skull in. He was looking after the sword the could free Britannia at the time.

                                                    See also:
                                                    • Mordred’s Tribute
