                                                    Villa

                                                    A Titan Spawn.

                                                    Vivian

                                                    She who reportedly sealed Merlin into a cave (or possibly a tree).

                                                    Ally of Mordred. Believed to be an ally of Morgan Le Fae.)

                                                    See also:

                                                      Watling, Henry

                                                      PC: Simon

                                                      See fig. 13

                                                      Aliases

                                                      • Henry (Sir)
                                                      • Eternal Knight, The
                                                      • Viscount Sidmouth
                                                      • Love's Champion
                                                      • Every, Henry
                                                      • Avery, Henry (Originator)
                                                      • Horse sword of the Cossacks, The
                                                      • Lord of Watling
                                                      • Lairde Crosby
                                                      • Knight of many titles
                                                      • Wielder of Tizona
                                                      • Sword and Shield of the Knight of the Isles
                                                      • Protector and Saviour
                                                      • The Champion of Love and Fear
                                                      • Cupbearer to the Wren

                                                      Knight of Aphrodite. Currently on secondment to SATT, section 13.

                                                      Resides at Froyle Park, Ryebridge Lane, Alton, GU34 4JY. A National Trust property that is closed to the public when the family is at home. The grounds are in the process of being reopened.

                                                      He is in a relationship with Ophelia and Mina.

                                                      Legend records him as a figure who shows up every century or so, demonstrates incredible strength of arms while doing something stupidly heroic for the good of the realm and then disappears.

                                                      Aphrodite granted him several gifts including:

                                                      • Resurrection: when he dies, his body disappears and he always comes back to life. The length of time depends on how much damage was done, but a hail of bullets didn’t stop him for more than a few hours.
                                                      • He wields Tizona.

                                                      He has lived and died many times, fighting against the creature impersonating his first wife and lending his sword to other causes when she isn’t tormenting him.

                                                      12th Century

                                                      1148

                                                      Secretly married Mary.

                                                      1149-1152

                                                      He was knighted by Richard the Lionheart and took part in the Crusades leaving his wife behind. She followed him, but died from The Black Death en-route.

                                                      Henry died in battle during the Crusades. He found himself in a dark place — the home of the Void Demons and prayed for a second chance.

                                                      It seemed his prayers were answered. It appeared to be 1148 again and he was with someone he thought was Mary. This time he didn’t leave for the Crusades and stayed with her (running away to Wales), but he realised that something was wrong and drowned his sorrows. He was killed in a bar brawl.

                                                      He woke thinking it was 1148 again. At some point he realised that the woman was an imposter and killed her.

                                                      For over a century he lived through this cycle. Sometimes he died. Sometimes Mary did. Always there was heartbreak and misery.

                                                      14th Century

                                                      1319

                                                      Henry was travelling from Lincoln with False Mary. They rode north through a heavily forested area while she aired such complaints as “Why did you not get us any land at Lincoln?”, “Why did you not win them favour?” and so on.

                                                      Henry noticed a strange woman off to the side of the road when it came time for them to camp and offered to let her share their shelter. The woman was Everis — a centaur wearing a glamour — who was investigating Henry’s situation for Aphrodite.

                                                      They had heard of a knight who kept dying and returning with the same woman. Everis noticed False Mary slip something into Henry’s food so the centaur put something in Henry’s drink that would counter the effect of the poison. When he fell unconscious she was about revive him and steal away with him into the night.

                                                      Everis took him to meet Aphrodite who asked Henry questions. Slowly they pieced together what had been going on. As they did, Henry slowly fell for his Goddess and began his worship of her in many ways; they came to the Eternal Knight agreement.

                                                      His training was continued by Everis, who explained the world to him and told him of his duties. They carried out Henry’s first mission together: the killing of one of Aphrodite’s enemies. Klifnia was a scholar and scion of Ares who was trying to breed a perfect warrior using unwilling women.

                                                      When his training was complete, Everis left Henry to wander the world on his own. From time to time they continue to see each other (gossiping like two old friends).

                                                      1321

                                                      An incarnation of Artie was delivering messages to forts in North Wales when he was attacked by two scions — one male and one female.

                                                      Henry was travelling home to the estate when he saw what looked like two people attacking a scribe on the road. He charged in and met them in combat. One of the scions hit out, cracking & breaking Henry’s shield and forcing him back.

                                                      Henry discarded the remains of the shield, roared, charged and thrust his sword upwards. The death of the male attacker was brutal, and his partner fled the field.

                                                      Henry started to pursue but returned to treat Artie’s wound and escort him on the rest of his mission. They spent the next couple of years together running messages around the country.

                                                      Henry died, saving Artie’s life, in a shipwreck as they were taking a message to an Italian scion by the name of Flitaia.

                                                      15th Century

                                                      1412

                                                      Henry woke in his tomb but was quickly bundled out of the estate by the maidens before he could ask what was happening.

                                                      Once they were in a safe place, it was explained that he had been called back to the estate because it had been taken over by a rival sect. They wore black armour (possible Ares connection?). Henry needed to retake his home before they desecrated the temple. He was, of course successful. When he killed one of the women, she and her armour turned to gravel and sand.

                                                      1414

                                                      Henry dies falling off a bridge while helping the local villagers repair a broken plank.

                                                      1425

                                                      Henry awoke in his tomb and received a very warm welcome from Aphrodite. She then sent him to Germany to help the widow Gräfin (a title equivalent to a Countess) Elizabetha. She was being pressed to marry an eight year-old duke as part of his father’s bid to claim her lands.

                                                      Henry challenged the father to and defeated him in a duel (a joust). His conditions of victory were that Elizabetha could keep her lands and the Duke would defend her in all circumstances until she died or chose to remarry.

                                                      He quickly departed to avoid the offers of marriage that Elizabetha began to bestow upon him.

                                                      He spent a number of years helping make improvements to the estate and village before being slain repelling a raid on Watling by a group of robber knights.

                                                      16th Century

                                                      1511

                                                      In Montepulciano (Tuscany), Henry went to the aid of Machesa (Marchioness in English terms) Barbaro who was besieged by Italian noblewomen wanting to take her lands from her. She had never married but had set up a protected commune for abused women.

                                                      Henry arrived with money to pay off debts and carry on her work.

                                                      One of the women taking refuge there was the wife of the local Duke who had arrived to lay siege to the place with a small army.

                                                      Henry taught the women how to defend themselves and challenged the Duke to a duel. The nobleman sent his second to face the Eternal Knight in a duel with swords, and Henry killed the man before challenging the Duke once more.

                                                      The Duke fled and spent his remaining days hiding in isolation in his castle.

                                                      Unknown to Henry, Aphrodite used the commune to set up as a training facility for her maidens, where they would learn numerous skills.

                                                      1531

                                                      Henry went to Russia to distract some Russian troops from Artie’s business. He was following a caravan but keeping his distance when it was raided by some Cossacks. He galloped forwards to intervene but it wasn’t enough to stop some of them escaping with valuables and some of the women.

                                                      The Knight stayed to help the wounded and was quickly talked into joining a rescue party. When they caught up, Henry discovered that the raiders were treating the women poorly and “got a bit angry”.

                                                      When he came back to himself the women were surrendering to him.

                                                      Over the next months, with the aid of one of the women — Zasha — who spoke some English, he trained them in combat and learned their language and culture.

                                                      Dissatisfied with the local blades, Henry imported western-style swords from England.

                                                      They began to launch their own raids, and Zasha proposed marriage to Henry. He turned out down but asked her to be a leader of the people. This didn’t stop the stories told centuries later from claiming they were husband and wife.

                                                      In time, they heard of a Turkish sultan who kept a harem of slaves at the Topkapi Palace and resolved to rescue them. They did more than that and came away laden down with treasures.

                                                      With the palace weakened, Russian troops moved in and took control of it. They also captured one of the tribe’s own. The battle that followed was brutal, and twenty of the women died during it.

                                                      They gathered tulips from the palace garden and left to mourn the fallen.

                                                      Days later, near Prosenik, Henry recovered — or was at least roused from it by the bucket of water Zasha threw over him — from the drunken stupor he had fallen into. One of their patrols was missing and the two rode out to find it.

                                                      There had been four women in the patrol, but they found three bodies and a trail of blood which led the a stone covering on a mound. The stone had been smashed open — possibly by gunpowder — and was surrounded by the bodies of soldiers. Henry felt a profound sense of evil. He sent Zasha back and ventured inside, sword drawn.

                                                      There he faced a creature: it stood about the height of a man, its hands appeared malformed, its eyes were almost pure white and it appeared to be eating something. It didn’t respond in a civilised way when Henry challenged it, and the resulting combat bought the roof down on both of them.

                                                      Henry and Zasha are still remembered in song.

                                                      1535

                                                      When Henry resurrected and went back, he couldn’t find the tribe. They had encountered Bevo and become her Tulip Guard.

                                                      17th Century

                                                      1610

                                                      False Mary arrived in the Tudor court plotting to gain power in England by killing Robert Carr, Earl of Somerset. Henry saves Carr and kills the imposter. He is rewarded with the hand of Marquess Joan Crosbie; Henry initially refuses until James I orders him to marry her to cement relations between Scotland and England.

                                                      1613

                                                      For some reason, Michel seems to have taken an interest in his building.

                                                      Henry got into a disagreement with a gentleman by the name of Woods and built The Watling Tower to wind him up.

                                                      It still stands to this day, although the name has been changed.

                                                      1625

                                                      He met Lancelot in Hereford, and they recognised each other as old souls. They travelled together to Wales and got extremely drunk. They woke up in a cowshed and parted ways.

                                                      1693

                                                      Henry is called by Aphrodite to investigate a scheme by False Mary that involved the raising of a pirate navy.

                                                      1694

                                                      Henry, taking the alias of Henry Every or Avery, joined the crew of Charles II as a sailor and quickly worked his way up to being first mate. They had hoped for a letter of marque but did not receive one.

                                                      With the crew discontent, on 7 May 1694, Henry and a few other conspirators organised and carried out a successful mutiny and, setting Captain Gibson ashore, left for the Cape of Good Hope appointing Henry as Captain and renaming the ship The Fancy.

                                                      Henry took a number of prizes, mostly out of False Mary’s fleet, but then hit upon a plan to recruit her pirate navy as his own.

                                                      1695

                                                      After recruiting more ships and crew from False Mary’s fleet and killing her in a showdown, Henry launched an audacious raid on the Grand Mughal’s fleet. He netted somewhere in the region of £91.9 million (in today’s terms) and decided that would be his one last big score as a pirate.

                                                      He passed the name Every, command of The Fancy, and the pirate flotilla to his second in command. This is a tradition which has continued with Nate being the current Avery.

                                                      To this day, Henry sports a tattoo of Avery’s flag on his arm.

                                                      This was probably for the best as he caused considerable damage to England’s fragile relations with the Mughals, and a combined bounty of £1,000 was offered by the Privy Council and the East India Company for his capture, leading to the first worldwide manhunt in recorded history.

                                                      1698

                                                      Henry’s second in command contacted him with a plea: He wanted help hiding and offered Henry share of plunder. Watling set him up as a wealthy merchant, renamed Jonathan Avery.

                                                      Henry was killed later that year by drowning when a merchant ship was destroyed in a storm.

                                                      18th Century

                                                      1720

                                                      Henry was summoned by Aphrodite and sent to the Seelie court to protect a fey called Kavath. He gained the name Love’s Champion when he duelled Lady Vanya on his and Letia’s behalf.

                                                      He is later killed when jumped by armed men on Midgard.

                                                      19th Century

                                                      1806

                                                      Aphrodite told Henry to enlist in the 67th South Hampshire Regiment and to then buy a commission in the Light Company of the 60th Rifles.

                                                      1808

                                                      Henry was shipped to Portugal as part of the British Peninsular Force. His company was assigned to help Spanish rebels on the Portuguese border.

                                                      Aphrodite came to him and informed Henry that Salvador De Balbao must meet Isabel Bolain as their child will be of great importance.

                                                      Salvador was part of a guerilla unit surprised by a French cavalry unit. They were saved when Henry’s rifles intercepted the cavalry at range and killed all of them.

                                                      Henry stayed by his side through the first victory at Rolica.

                                                      Later Salvador meets Isabel at a local village. The two were married and had two daughters. One became a great leader and poet and one a war historian.

                                                      1809

                                                      Henry rose to the rank of Captain and took part in the battle of Grijo. In May he commands a forlorn hope and is the first to go into Porto. It was his sheer anger and forcefulness that carried him through the breach in the wall.

                                                      Henry was spotted out walking with a beautiful blonde woman — Aphrodite — in camp who was never seen unless by his side. This grew into a legend about a beautiful shadow of death that would visit soldiers.

                                                      In the battle of Talavera, Henry was shot, wounded and sent to the rear to recover and carry out “fetch and carry” duties. He spent some time working with captured French baggage trains.

                                                      1810

                                                      Recovered, Henry retakes command of the Light Company, and they acquit themselves well in the Battle of Bussaco.

                                                      1812

                                                      Henry returned to the peninsular in March and was invited to dine at the tent of Lord Herbert Leveson-Gower. At a dance Henry observed the lord striking a maid. He intervened on her behalf and Leveson-Gower challenged him to a duel for his pains.

                                                      Henry selected swords and butchered Leveson-Gower. He is officially reprimanded by Wellington and also privately thanked: Wellington had a problem in Leveson-Gower who was causing issues amongst the troops.

                                                      Henry returned to the Regiment and is promoted to Major. He led another forlorn hope into Ciudad Rodrigo; once inside he rushed the French defenders and held the opening long enough for British troops to pour in before being overcome by his wounds and dying just inside the city walls.

                                                      1825-1826

                                                      Henry met Nunnehi and saved John Reid.

                                                      1845-1855

                                                      Henry travelled to Africa to look for False Mary, and met Allan Quatermain who he helped fight an evil shaman. In return, Allan helped him track False Mary who was travelling the world and setting schemes in motion all over it.

                                                      She was involved in the antiquities trade and money laundering. During the years that Henry and Quatermain were following her, she became quite powerful. Henry died from poison from a blade she used in the final battle after they tracked her down. It was left to Allan to defeat her.

                                                      1860-1865

                                                      Henry met the rest of The League of Extraordinary Gentlemen over this half decade. Occasionally he would help out on jobs. He was killed when helping Allan track Calvin Desmond, a scion of Mithras with super-strength and delusions “he could conquer all”, who defenestrated him.

                                                      1895

                                                      In Weihai, Henry was killed protecting the families of English sailors when the Japanese invaded.

                                                      20th Century

                                                      1901

                                                      Henry engages False Mary in one-on-one combat. She killed him, but not before he inflicted a mortal injury on her.

                                                      1906

                                                      Mina Harker invites Henry to join the League of Extraordinary Gentlemen. They go on to stop a demonic invasion of Shoreditch which was establishing a bridgehead in a Chinese warehouse owned by one Zhong Wei. He was killed holding back the horde at the gateway.

                                                      By 2022 the warehouse had become a nightclub and the demons were up to their old tricks.

                                                      1915

                                                      Henry is resurrected once more and receives a mission from Aphrodite to protect a small village in southern France; he dies when charging a machine gun but not before allied troops arrive to help the village.

                                                      1917

                                                      On Aphrodite’s orders, Henry became an officer in the army. When he is recruited he is surprised to be reunited with Artie.

                                                      The pair of old companions were taken prisoner after a trench raid went wrong. Aphrodite told Henry to keep Artie alive so he sacrificed his own meagre rations to make sure Artie was fed. Henry is killed by a bayonet thrust from a guard when he intervened to stop him beating Artie.

                                                      Rhubarb

                                                      WWII era RAF code for a mission where fighter or fighter-bomber sections, at times of low cloud and poor visibility, cross the English Channel and drop below cloud level to search for opportunity targets such as railway locomotives and rolling stock, aircraft on the ground, enemy troops, and vehicles on roads.

                                                      1939-1941

                                                      Henry joined the RAF and survived the Battle of Britain but was shot down over France in 1941 while taking part in a “rhubarb”. He died while on the run.

                                                      1943

                                                      Henry was asked by Aphrodite to protect her temple from the Nazi occult squad who are stealing artifacts from all over Europe. He was wounded and re-assigned to a squad in the 25th Bomb Disposal Company where he has to deal with UXBs in the Lambeth area.

                                                      There was a 2500lbs bomb underneath the church that would later become Mordred’s home. A man on Henry’s squad, named Scupper, tried to defuse it and managed to remove the fuse from the device only for it to detonate in his hands and kill him just as — in Henry’s version of the story — Henry descended to the crypt to try to stop him. Other reports say that Henry survived.

                                                      1945

                                                      Henry was killed by a booby trapped mine on Eastbourne pier.

                                                      1951

                                                      This does not appear in the temple’s official records to spare Henry from the memories.

                                                      While searching for leads on False Mary, Henry witnessed a woman collapse in a shop with symptoms he recognised as being The Black Death.

                                                      Recognising the plague, he isolated the shop and the husband and called in help. It came in the form of Seb and other druids who helped cleanse the area. Henry stayed to nurse the wife and her husband until the end so they could stay together.

                                                      The disease was tracked back to Porton Down where someone had been careless with a test tube.

                                                      1955

                                                      False Mary was up to her old tricks and and Henry returned to stop her. He spent some time in the UK learning about modern times and helping out on the estate.

                                                      1960

                                                      Henry returned to the United States to renew his links with the Nunnehi but was killed in Las Vegas when he was shoot by a mugger.

                                                      1975

                                                      False Mary made another move, which Henry foiled without much effort. Left to his own devices, he spends time on the estate and is pursued by women seeking a rich husband.

                                                      During this time he met Mac at his bar in London.

                                                      Between 1975 and 1955 we have two foilings of Mary in a row which were “easy” and lack details. Is something odd going on?

                                                      1978

                                                      Under orders from Aphrodite, Henry was protecting Alexia’s parents — Helen and George Campbell. He was killed by a Mazoku.

                                                      See Death of Alexia’s Parents.

                                                      Viscount Sidmouth

                                                      The title of Viscount Sidmouth, of Sidmouth in the County of Devon, was created in 1805 for the former Prime Minister, Henry Addington.

                                                      1982

                                                      This does not appear in the temple’s official records.

                                                      Henry inherited the title of Viscount Sidmouth due to a number of relatives passing away (although not under suspicious circumstances) leaving him at the sole male heir to the title which passed to him though his ‘ancestor’s’ marriage to Joan Crosby.

                                                      21st Century

                                                      2022

                                                      Henry went to Oxford Circus to deal with False Mary but fell into the trap detailed in Meeting the Knight.

                                                      Afterwards he acted as a consultant for SATT for a time before Aphrodite arranged an official secondment for him to join Greg’s team so he could keep an eye on, and protect, Artie.

                                                      Over this time he travelled to China and helped free Arnemetia, was attacked by spectral knights at his estate, and helped dismantle the unsavoury parts of Justin Burland’s businesses that Michael had set up. Later he would follow Michael back to America to investigate further there.

                                                      He and the team solved the mystery of the Labyrinth of Chelmsford, supported Greg in his position of Lord Arbiter of the Seelie Succession, and tangled with Verdas and his children in a complicated arrangement of incidents.

                                                      Henry reacquainted himself with Mina Harker and entered a relationship with her and Ophelia.

                                                      They recovered the Heb-Sed Mace, freed the Great Bardess from a magical prison in Boscastle, tangled with Jade Fox at Berron’s album launch party, and rescued Scarab from Amarna.

                                                      He built a home in Jötunheimr.

                                                        Wren, Christopher (Sir) (Deceased)

                                                        A scion of Loki.

                                                        Sir Christopher Wren PRS FRS was one of the most highly acclaimed English architects in history, as well as an anatomist, astronomer, geometer, and mathematician-physicist. He was accorded responsibility for rebuilding 52 churches in the City of London after the Great Fire in 1666, including what is regarded as his masterpiece, St Paul’s Cathedral, on Ludgate Hill, completed in 1710.

                                                        He built The Sheldonian Theatre in Oxford where Alexia found a stone wren that came to life in her hands. One of his lesser known works is a wing at Alexia’s house.

                                                        He carved his name on Stonehenge.

                                                        d’Éon, the Chevalier

                                                        Alias

                                                        • de Beaumont, Charles-Geneviève-Louis-Auguste-André-Timothée d'Éon

                                                        A swords-person who has been around since the 18th century and is capable of switching gender (at least) at will.

                                                        He is involved in a secret organisation that has access to a set of prophecies about the SATT team.

                                                        An official history

                                                        A celebrated 18th-century soldier, diplomat and spy, the Chevalier d’Éon lived openly as a man and as a woman in France and England at different stages of life, drawing much public interest.

                                                        Beginnings

                                                        The Chevalier was born on 5 October 1728 to a minor aristocratic, but poor, family in Tonerre, Burgundy, France.

                                                        He excelled in school and moved to Paris in 1743 where he studied civil and canon law, attracted notice as a political writer and then held a number of political positions over the next decade or so.

                                                        Le Secret du Roi

                                                        The King’s Secret was a spy organisation set up by Louis VX that served his interests directly, sometimes even in opposition to the official policy of the French foreign ministry or to treaties signed by France. In 1756, d’Éon joined.

                                                        Russia

                                                        He and Chevalier Douglas — a Scottish Jacobite in French service — were sent to Russia to meet Empress Elizabeth, foster good relations with her and get her support for Louis’ plan to put his cousin, the Prince de Contri, on the Polish throne.

                                                        At this time the English were attempting to deny the French access to the Empress by only allowing women and children to cross the border into Russia. d’Éon claimed, probably apocryphally, that he travelled disguised as Lia de Beaumont and served as the Empress’ maid of honour.

                                                        Eventually, Douglas became the French ambassador to Russia, and d’Éon was secretary to the embassy.

                                                        The 7 Year War

                                                        Meanwhile the tensions between England and France erupted into the 7-year-war. In the later stages of the war, d’Éon returned to France and served as Captain in the French Dragoons.

                                                        The war was not going well for France and so Louis called for peace talks. In 1762 d’Éon was sent to London to help draft the peace treaty that ended that conflict. He was rewarded membership of Order of Saint Louis, a huge honour for someone who was only 35 at the time and which came with the title Chevalier, the equivalent to an English knight.

                                                        Britain

                                                        With the treaty signed, France was stripped of its North American colonies, laden with debt, and thirsty for revenge. The Secret was reformed with new purpose: To invade Britain. d’Éon was named minister plenipotentiary — interim ambassador — to the British court; a useful cover for gathering intelligence and cultivating allies among the opposition party at Parliament.

                                                        Things were looking up. There were just a few issues. He embraced London life a little too hard — and was reprimanded by cash-strapped France for importing too much wine (this wasn’t pure excess, he was wooing members of the British aristocracy). Then there was the fact he wasn’t the real ambassador. That was the Comte de Guerchy (not well liked, not very competent) who, humiliatingly, demoted him to the rank of secretary when he arrived in London.

                                                        Falling Out

                                                        d’Éon was not happy with the situation. Especially with his work for the Secret putting him at odds with his Guerchy. He sent a series of increasingly angry letters home.

                                                        Six months after he’d been given the job, he was fired and ordered home.

                                                        Concerned that he might be headed for the Bastille, he refused. A letter he wrote to the King claimed that the new ambassador tried to drug d’Éon at dinner at Monmouth House.

                                                        Louis XV ordered d’Éon extradited, but the British foreign minister refused. The French Foreign Ministry attempted to kidnap and arrest him; several times.

                                                        He retaliated with threats of a ‘tell all’, and fired a warning shot. He published secret diplomatic documents in Lettres, memoires et negociations, one of the most scandalous books of the time, some of which was penned by Louis XV himself. This made the Chevalier an instant celebrity in London.

                                                        The French Foreign Ministry were appalled but stymied. d’Éon had held back with his publications and still had some devastating documents with which to blackmail his government. Louis dealt with it by giving him a 12,000 livre annual pension in exchange for the remaining documents, reports on British politics, and staying in political exile.

                                                        A Woman?

                                                        There had long been rumours in both Britain and France that the Chevalier was a woman, which developed into intrusive public interest. London bookmakers took bets.

                                                        People’s curiosity wasn’t diminished by d’Éon declining to prove it one way or the other, saying that an examination would be dishonouring, whatever the result. It reached a point where d’Éon couldn’t leave his home without guards as so many people wanted to see him naked to get an answer to the growingly popular question. This went on for years.

                                                        In 1772 a French secretary in the service of the Secret allegedly came to London to investigate the claim that d’Éon was a woman; he left in June, fully convinced that d’Éon was indeed female because “that’s what d’Éon told him”.

                                                        From that point on, the French government acted as though d’Éon was a woman.

                                                        Plans to Return

                                                        Louis XVI inherited the throne in 1774. He saw no use in having two foreign policies nor in invading Britain and so had no use for the Secret which he dissolved.

                                                        A representative, Pierre Beaumarchais, of the French government approached d’Éon and negotiated his return to France and — more importantly — any documents he still possessed that carried information about his work as a spy.

                                                        After several months of discussions, d’Éon signed an agreement: He would give up all papers and return to France, and the new king would pay off some of his debts and his pension as well as publicly recognising d’Éon as a woman.

                                                        The Transition

                                                        It isn’t clear why d’Éon agreed to be recognised as a woman. It isn’t even clear if it was her idea or if it was forced on her.

                                                        There are a number of theories.

                                                        One is that it was instigated by Beaumarchais as a means to politically neuter d’Éon… and win the bet on her gender.

                                                        Another is that she saw political life itself, backbiting and detestable, as the cause of her misfortunes and her gender transformation was a reaction to the hyper-masculinity of diplomacy and politics of the Old Regime. Certainly she, during her period of exile, had collected books on famous women and feminist through. d’Éon came to believe that women were more virtuous than men and saw living as a woman as a means to transform himself morally.

                                                        We’ll probably never know the truth.

                                                        Arrival in France

                                                        It was in 1777 that she returned to France. The story she told was that she was raised male by a father who wanted a son (and couldn’t inherit from his in-laws without one) and was now coerced by the new king and propriety to adopt the appearance of her birth gender.

                                                        She was supposed to return to France in female attire, but was still wearing her Dragoon captain’s uniform when she stepped of the boat. Several months later she was finally coaxed out of it.

                                                        She told Rose Bertin, famously the clothing director of Marie Antionette, “Truthfully, Mademoiselle, I do not yet know what I need… I only know that it is more difficult to equip a lady than a company of Dragoons from head to foot.”

                                                        She was eventually presented at court, and drew many snide remarks as to her appearance and attitude.

                                                        Madame Campan wrote, “The desire to see his native land once more determined him to submit to the condition, but he revenged himself by combining the long train of his gown and the three deep ruffles on his sleeves with the attitude and conversation of a grenadier, which made him very disagreeable company.”

                                                        With France involving itself in the American War of Independence and finding her political voice muted by her gender, she petitioned the government to allow her to put her uniform on again. They were unmoved and when her requests failed to cease they pressured her to enter a convent before arresting her when even that didn’t work. She was released after 19 days on the promise that she would stop asking.

                                                        London again

                                                        In 1785 she moved back to London to escape the life she had in France. She was welcomed into society as a heroine.

                                                        In 1789 the French Revolution broke out. The revolutionary government put a stop to her pension and confiscated her family’s property. She found herself strapped for cash and was forced to sell off personal possessions, including her extensive collection of books.

                                                        That was only a short term solution though, so a couple of years later she resorted to performing fencing exhibitions in women’s dress, astonishing audiences and becoming a popular personality once more. This lasted until 1796 when an injury forced her to retire.

                                                        Death

                                                        In old age, the Chevalier lived with a widowed friend, Mrs Cole, in modest circumstances (interrupted by a five month stint in debtors prison). Despite the fame and notoriety that had accompanied this remarkable life, d’Éon died in poverty in May 1810, at the age of 81.

                                                        Post-mortem

                                                        The surgeon who examined d’Éon’s body said she had “male organs in every respect perfectly formed,” while at the same time displaying feminine characteristics. A couple of characteristics described in the certificate were “unusual roundness in the formation of limbs” as well as “breast remarkably full”. It’s likely that d’Éon might was been intersex.

                                                        She was buried at St Pancras Old Church but her grave was disturbed in 1865 by works to construct the Midland Railway terminus at St Pancras railway station. You’ll find her name on the Burdett Coutts Memorial Sundial which commemorates around 70 people who had their graves disturbed by the railway work.

                                                            Chinese Courts

                                                            The celestials in China and surrounding regions are divided into courts. There are four dragon factions led by a dragon-king, and various gods (such as the well-known Monkey King).

                                                            In 2021 there was a failed attempt by the azure dragons to overthrow the king.

                                                            Colani Gang

                                                            Mid-sized London street gang based in Bermondsey with an angle on moving weapons and a possible sideline in people trafficking.

                                                            Led by Lou who took over from his father, Robert, after forcing him out in 2021.

                                                            Lou brought in outside people (including “the Lieutenant” and Barbatos) and is actively recruiting. Their expansion has pushed a couple of smaller gangs out of Bermondsey or absorbed them completely:

                                                            • The Bobby Boys have been absorbed, their old leader was found dead.
                                                            • A Russian gang run by Konstaninos has been absorbed. Konstaninos has disappeared without a trace.

                                                            They have a warehouse in South Bermondsey:

                                                            • At the front are large double doors along with a smaller, person-sized door.
                                                            • There is another entrance at the back (this is where Michelle entered and ran into trouble).
                                                            • The upper floor has offices, storage, and something at the back that M & E didn’t get a chance to see.
                                                            • As is typical for warehouses there is a large open area in the middle with a gantry around it and a skylight above it.
                                                            • There’s a padlocked area at the back of the ground floor.

                                                            Have access to:

                                                            • Automatic weapons
                                                            • Magic-absorbing kevlar
                                                            • A surprisingly large number of people
                                                            • At least three people who trained in the use of swords (very unusual for a mortal gang)

                                                            Weasel-face has visited their warehouse. The organised crime unit of the Met have him listed as a known associate, but they haven’t managed to identify him.

                                                            False Mary is an associate of theirs.

                                                            Jones is their accountant.

                                                            Dragons

                                                            The dragons work for both sides of the war depending on their natures. There is little known about them and their ruling council as they are very secretive but they are also very powerful if allied with you.

                                                            In China, the dragons are significant players in the four courts.

                                                            There are 13 great dragons that protect London. They seem to spend most of their time as statures (and were unaffected when something was bringing statues to life in London a few years ago).

                                                            See also:
                                                            • Night Out with the Girls

                                                            Druids

                                                            Druids come in many flavours, most worship a central figure that represents nature, in modern terms the green man or mother nature. Their rites are oral and you are not allowed to know their mysteries unless you are inducted. In France there are a sect of druids who claim the Mithraic rites are the same as their druidic ones and have adopted Mithras as the leader of their sect.

                                                            • Andrews, Major Seb
                                                            • Sin Mai Otak
                                                            See also:
                                                            • Investigation (Closed): Verdas

                                                            Fae

                                                            Otherworldly beings who are divided into two courts:

                                                            • Seelie
                                                            • Unseelie

                                                            Specific notes on the courts are in their entries, this section contains the general information.

                                                            Be careful about gifts. Accepting them can imply obligation. Refusing them can run contrary to the rules of hospitality. Giving them can also imply obligation, for which you may be repaid in ways you do not expect or like.

                                                            Promises also impose obligation. The fae take them very seriously.

                                                            Fae food and drink and trap people there. If you are an invited guest that hospitality rules mean that you should be safe, but be careful.

                                                            Being intimate with a Fae can bind you to them in strange ways.

                                                            The leader of a given court is considered to be all-powerful.

                                                            The fae are swift in rendering judgement, so be on best behaviour and dress formally.

                                                            Be discreet within their realms as they have eyes and ears everywhere.

                                                            Rudeness may be met with a challenge. This could take the form of a dual to first blood, third blood, or death — even a duel to first blood could end with an “accidental” killing.

                                                            Plant life should be considered dangerous and possibly sentient.

                                                            Fae magic is centred in their hands. One or both may have power, and that power can be highly varied. Their titles may suggest what kind of powers they have.

                                                            Fae give people titles when their actions become significant to the courts. We don’t know if the courts share these titles or if they grant them and respect them independently.

                                                            They dislike iron, but it doesn’t kill them or take away their powers.

                                                            See also:
                                                            • Greenstone, Berron

                                                            Fomorians

                                                            Aquatic race that considers themselves to have a claim to Ireland from which they were banished to the hidden island of ????. Since Sir. Mordred considers himself to have a claim to that land, this puts them at odds with each other.

                                                            See also:

Some of the pantheons don’t really get along and the individual gods are even worse. Put Thor and Ares into the same bar at the same time for example and something is bound to go wrong!

                                                            Liminal

                                                            A liminal deity is a god or goddess in mythology who presides over thresholds, gates, or doorways; “a crosser of boundaries”. Special types include dying-and-rising deities, various agricultural deities, and those who descend into the underworld: crossing the threshold between life and death representing the most fundamental of all boundaries. Vegetation deities in particular mimic the annual dying and returning of plant life, making them seasonally cyclical liminal deities. In contrast, the one-time ordeal typical of the dying-and-rising myth, or legends of those who return from a descent to the underworld, represent a more narrow scope of liminal deities.

                                                            Eric seems to be one.

                                                            Hand of Isis

                                                            A radical group of Egyptian God devotees who believe the prophesy that snakes will destroy the world. They believe all snakes should be under their control or killed.

                                                            They are a signatory of the Heb-Sed Pact.

                                                            Vanessa has a coin with the symbol of the cult leader on it — Isis holding a snake in her fist and sitting on a thrown a top a snake corpse — suggesting she may be a member, or is perhaps its leader.

                                                            Maggie says they are connected to Phoenix symbols. Taranis claims Phoenix are a group that splintered from the Hand of Isis at some point in the last three thousand years.

                                                              Ice Giants

                                                              One of the Jötunn people of Jötunheimr. The Ice Giants of Norse myth; a form of Titan Spawn. They are reputed to protect Jötunheimr from the Asgardians.

                                                              They have not been receptive to SATT’s attempts to open diplomatic relations.

                                                              Their system of government involves having two rulers (because one could die at the hands of Asgardians at any time), usually one from each of the two ruling families. The land is split in two and the rulers are supposed to act in balance, but it takes agreement from both to send the nation to war.

                                                              At present there are two kings, but there have been two queens or one of each at other times.

                                                              • King Reum (his wife is Jus)
                                                              • King Leonartine (married to Bek)

                                                              NB: The wives of kings are not queens; only a ruling lady would be granted that title.

                                                              Jus is said to be the nicest of all the nobles.

                                                              Their children (although it isn’t clear to which family any of them belong are) Princess Tallana (a noted warrior), Princess Phelio. Prince Sepin (also a noted warrior) and Prince Hepan (recorded as “very actively warlike” in SATT documentation). There is also a third princess but we don’t know her name.

                                                              Uilia, chief advisor to King Reum, is loyal to Sir. Mordred. Jus is known not to like them.

                                                              Trial by combat is part of their justice system. Speculation: Is this used to resolve disputes between kings?

                                                              The only other ice giant of note that we are aware of is Glenava.

                                                              The Wandering Merchant Inn has a barkeep named Felindre who might be helpful.

                                                              If SATT were to turn up we’d likely be mistaken for Asgardians.

                                                              Legend personifies certain concepts, including old age and thought as ice giants. I don’t know how literally we should take such warnings.

                                                              See also:

                                                              Jötunn

                                                              The peoples of Jötunheimr. They include the Ice Giants.

                                                              Sam describes them as having a passion for life and growing things.

                                                              Kobolds, Germanic

                                                              The Germanic Kobold is a short creature with long ears. They come in several varieties and it is unclear if they vary only by where they live or if there is something deeper.

                                                              They are an independent people, not of faerie and so do not owe allegiance to Seelie or Unseelie.

                                                              Domestic or House Kobolds are associated with a building. One living in The Vienna State Opera was known to deliver messages by slipping them into the pockets of audience members.

                                                              They are very touchy, care a great deal about honour and dislike being mocked. If they are not taken care of, it is said to be unlucky.

                                                              It is possible for one to offer to work for you if you have shown it kindness.

                                                              It is also possible for a homeowner to entrap one. He must go on St John’s Day between noon and one o’clock, into the forest. When he finds an anthill with a bird on it, he must say a certain phrase, which causes the bird to transform into a small person. The figure then leaps into a bag carried by the homeowner, and he can then transfer the Kobold to his home.

                                                              Seafaring Kobolds live aboard ship and help the crew. They may appear as a short man in the position of ship’s carpenter.

                                                              Mine or Cave Kobolds, unsurprisingly, live underground. They are akin to Bluecaps and Knockers. It is from them that cobalt gets its name.

                                                              The Ladies of the Lake

                                                              Scions of Britannia. According to Artie, “They go where they are needed”.

                                                              Famously associated with Excalibur.

                                                                Mazoku

                                                                A type of demon most usually found in Japan. They hate mankind and are happy to work for pain and blood (from which they grow in power).

                                                                They are organised into clans, each led by a Mau (King) who is the strongest member of the clan. When one is killed the next strongest takes its place.

                                                                Jade Fox summoned one and cursed Henry with it for several decades. He described it as a monster wrapped in shadow and fire. It was killed but its clan is likely to seek revenge.

                                                                Mortals

                                                                The knowledge of the war between titan and god is kept from most mortals. However, the heads of countries and some their governments know about it, as do selected individuals with skills that either side need.

                                                                Every country treats the gods and titans differently. In America it’s dangerous to be a Scion or Titan Spawn as The Asclepius Institute and certain other government agencies are likely to try to capture you for experimentation. In India, Titan spawn and Scion alike are met with reverence and respect. Italy and France actively seek out Scions of beauty deities and invite them to stay and work in the fashion industry.

                                                                Nāga

                                                                The powers of Nāga vary depending on which pantheon you talk to. In general, they appear to have powers over storms and seas. Some believe that Nāga dwell in the underworld, or an underground kingdom, and they only come to the surface to benefit humans.

                                                                Some Nāga are believed to be the guardians of treasure.

                                                                One particular Nāga, in Hindu myth, is believed to be the King of all snakes. He has power over all serpents, and is called Takshaka.

                                                                I would imagine that the Hand of Isis are not particularly keen on Nāga, but they have had no interactions that I’m aware of.

                                                                The Pearl of a Nāga is known to be able to heal most things, but it has to be given willingly. This comes from Thai and Indonesian origin.

                                                                Nāga are sometimes substituted in the medical seal with either the Rod of Asclepius, or the incorrect Caduceus, in the place of snakes. The seal of the Thai student medical society is one notable example, with Nāga around the Caduceus.

                                                                In the Philippines, Nāga are believed to cause Earthquakes and Eclipses.

                                                                Nāga blood is known to be a potent poison.

                                                                They are often seen in rivers, under bridges. In Indonesia, they sometimes live in blessed temples. There is a kingdom in Northern Thailand, called the Singhanavati Kingdom, that was supposedly built with the help of Nāga. It’s possible there might be a few still living there.

                                                                There is a Cambodian myth of a King who had a Nāgi skinned to steal her pearl. He wore the skin and pearl like a cape, believing that it would help him heal anything, and live longer. However, because the pearl was not given willingly, he died in battle from an arrow which went through the Nāgi’s skin, killing him. The Nāgi then reclaimed her skin and pearl.

                                                                Cambodians believe they are descended from a human and a Nāgi falling in love. They started the dynasty of Funan, and the Khmer people, which later became Cambodia. Just like the celts and King Arthur, they also believe that this Nāgi will return in the time of their greatest need.

                                                                Nāga are very unlikely to die of old age, and can heal most damage, including being skinned.

                                                                  SATT

                                                                  See fig. 17

                                                                  Alias

                                                                  • Scions Against Titan Terrorism (among the Gods)
                                                                  • Special Agency Terrorism Taskforce (among Mortals)

                                                                  An organisation that deals with supernatural threats. Has semi-official government recognition within the UK (at least).

                                                                  History

                                                                  It has been around, in one form or another, since the 400s.

                                                                  Camelot for the original version. Camlann saw an end to that.

                                                                  After that battle, the Gods wanted something to prevent wars. Most of them thought the idea was too impractical but a few decided to try anyway.

                                                                  William Adrihll (a scion of Britannia) took the lead in the 600s. He pulled together a force of scions to make a difference. The oath was witnessed by Hecate and Britannia.

                                                                  Then Lady Margaret Swinmor after that one was destroyed. Artie involved himself again in the 1320s.

                                                                  Options

                                                                  Agencies, monsters, gods and other realms tend to hate SATT. They are seen as “interfering busybodies that come from Britain to bugger up their lives” (rather like the CIA). Add to that that they were founded by a reincarnation of King Arthur back in the 600AD and they are not popular. The other gods can see them as the goddess Britannica’s police force and army and have worked together to systematically kill agents or shut them down in the past.

                                                                  The “curse”

                                                                  The Seelie have spent the last century barron. This appears to been a plot — with a Dagger of Disease as the instrument — between Cel and Mirtasha designed to place the two of them on the throne.

                                                                  Leadership

                                                                  The current rulers are Kavath and Letia.

                                                                  Previously, they were ruled over by Taranis, the King of Light and Illusion, but he was disposed after Berron rendered him imperfect by cutting his forearm off.

                                                                  Normally the next monarch would be from the line of Taranis but thanks to the Seelie being barren, there aren’t any. Failing that, the rank would fall to whomever killed the previous ruler, but he is still alive: just ineligible and it was Berron — who isn’t fae and has obligations to the Unseelie — who cut his forearm off. Failing that, someone of the line of the previous ruler could take the throne but, again, there aren’t any.

                                                                  Consequently, SATT were asked to mediate in the selection of the new ruler and Greg selected Kavath and Letia to rule jointly.

                                                                  Shèn (蜃)

                                                                  A type of “clam-monster”, and lesser dragon, that miraculously transforms shapes. They are associated with Indian Nāgas.

                                                                  Their natural form is more crocodile than dragon and they are not associated with the courts.

                                                                  They sometimes have a pearl (around their necks or in their shells).

                                                                  It is possible for a human to be transformed into a Shèn by a spell.

                                                                  Their favourite food is the swallow.

                                                                  Société du Cinéma Secrètement Parisien

                                                                  Founded by Glói as a place for those of unusual appearance to gather for mutual protection towards the end of World War I, the Société du Cinéma Secrètement Parisien is a combination of social club and mutual back scratching society.

                                                                  Members tend to prefer not to show their heads above ground level, enjoy films, and seek or provide employment that can be legitimate or illegal.

                                                                  They operate out of a rooms dug out of the Paris Catacombs. The original location was discovered by police in 2004 prompting the group to scatter for a couple of months before reconvening at a new location on the other side of the tunnel network.

                                                                  The new Cinéma Secrètement is better equipped than the old, with the move being treated as an opportunity to “do the place up properly” with rather more effort being made to make the place comfortable, with a full kitchen, larger bar, and routinely refreshed glamours to divert mortals who wander by down other tunnels.

                                                                  Notable members include:

                                                                  • Philibert Aspairt

                                                                  Glói has been re-elected Président every two years since the founding of the group.

                                                                    Many of the smaller groups of creatures really don’t want to take a side in the war. Minor races for example are Kobolds, Bluecaps, Pixies, Redcaps, Centaurs and Dryads.

They welcome any to their ranks that are powerful enough to stand with them in their life long fight against the Seelie Fae. They try to stay out of the Titan war as much as possible although occasionally make relics and assist either side when paid in favour or manpower.

                                                                    Vampires

                                                                    Known Vampires include:

                                                                    • Nate
                                                                    • Mina Harker
                                                                    • Viktor Yahontov

                                                                    Life Cycle of a Vampire

                                                                    The creation of a new vampire is a deliberate act; not a side effect of feeding.

                                                                    A newly formed vampire is bestial in form and nature.

                                                                    They tend to have elongated arms and claws instead of hands.

                                                                    All must hunt and kill – if they do not drink blood they will wither and die — but some have enough wherewithal to focus on a specific type of person as their prey. This phase lasts for between 2 and 20 years. There are few vampires as most get slain during their part of their lives.

                                                                    Afterwards, they become saner and more what one would expect from traditional vampire legends.

                                                                    Vulnerabilities and Myths

                                                                    Garlic has no effect.

                                                                    Wooden stakes can injure, but it takes one made of hawthorn to kill.

                                                                    Most will die if beheaded.

                                                                    Fire is capable of injuring a vampire and magical fire may kill one.

                                                                    See also:
                                                                    • Investigation: Cossack Graves
                                                                    • Watling, Henry

                                                                    Void Demons

                                                                    Creatures who live in a mysterious void to which souls sometimes find their way. They feed on stories.

                                                                    Legends of them refer to them variously as demi-gods, creatures, but most often as demons. In the legends people who have sound them are sometimes returned, either to life a better life or to deal with unfinished business. Afterwards they have gone on to life lives of a normal length before dying.

                                                                    There is a spell which can summon them.

                                                                    Their numbers include:

                                                                    • Meluuran
                                                                    • Parmtilir — Went to seek Arkgila and is now missing (we are trying to track him)).
                                                                    • Aldarial — known to life happy endings
                                                                    • Arkgila was once one of their number but no longer.

                                                                    Aldarial told us that four of them had escaped the “chaos of the realms and found the tree”. The Gods were not pleased and bound them to the void. Sometimes spirits find their way to the void, and the demons have the power to send them forward or back.

                                                                    They are bound by a pact. Few details are known, but it allows them to be summoned and forbids them to tell of where a soul has moved on to.

                                                                    Arkgila had managed to escape using the power she drew from Henry’s spirit.

                                                                    Parmtilir went looking for her and is now missing. Aldarial and Meluuran have been seeking a sorcerer to summon them so they can look for him.

                                                                      Places

                                                                      Amarna

                                                                      See fig. 18

                                                                      An area of historical significance in Egypt.

                                                                      According to Allan Quatermain, there is powerful magic associated with the area since Pharaoh Akhenaten took his people there.

                                                                      Before he was Akhenaten, he was Prince Amenhotep. Cyril Aldred thought he might have been a High Priest of Ptah. It makes sense that a scion connected to him might have the power to turn chains to liquid and reform them unbreakably, like the one Scarab mentioned.

                                                                      Ares/Ptah facility

                                                                      Ares and Ptah have a facility there which is focused around a huge, permanent portal to Warewiel where they appear to be staging an army.

                                                                      Art Gallery Contemporary Tapiezo

                                                                      A very “hands-on” gallery of contemporary art with a focus on combining ochre (mined locally) with “technological” materials.

                                                                      It is situated in Roussillon, about 100km north of Marseille and 50lm east of Avignon.

                                                                      The owner and curator is Pierre Bessemer.

                                                                      In 2022 it was robbed by Morgan.

                                                                      It housed the mace depicting Narmer’s Heb-Sed before it was stolen.

                                                                      There are several other artefacts of power on display including The Ballyshannon Sun-disc.
