                                                                          Jötunheimr

                                                                          Home of the Jötunn. It is very cold.

                                                                          It features “fantastic rock formations”, Sam warns not to confuse them with Ice Giants who live mainly in the north

                                                                          Sir Mordred has an exit from his castle to this realm.

                                                                          It is a source of Urudanite, possibly the only source. Henry is of the opinion that the Norse Gods have been running a propaganda war against the Jötunn in order to oppress them and raid their supplies of Urudanite.

                                                                          They use gold and silver rings, sometimes split into quarters, as currency for large purchases. Smaller trades are done purely through barter.

                                                                          Honey is rare — there are few flowers for bees — and a valuable trade good.

                                                                          It seems that villages tend to be named for their head-person.

                                                                          The capital is divided into three circles of increasing importance as you head towards the centre. The Bush and Rose Inn is there.

                                                                          2023 (as Midgard measures time) was a year in which there was a flood in the east which caused problems with the fruit copy. There seems to have been more flooding in recent years. Is this is a sigh of climate change?

                                                                          Profane

                                                                          Alias

                                                                          • Misunderstand

                                                                          A nightclub in Shoreditch.

                                                                          Formally another nightclub called Misunderstand was on the site. It went out of business, so it seems that Profane is its relaunch, possibly under new management.

                                                                          Misunderstand was a hotbed of dodgy deals, and since there is a connection between it and Barbatos, that is unlikely to have changed.

                                                                          Co-owned (via lots of shell corporations) by Declan Holt and a Ms. Petrou.

                                                                          The League of Extraordinary Gentlemen and Henry faced a demon portal in 1906 in a Chinese warehouse owned by one Zhong Wei. Profane stands on the same site.

                                                                          It was being used to drain blood for the production of magic resistant armour.

                                                                          In 2022 a team from SATT destroyed it during the course of a fight with demons.

                                                                          As of March 2023 the remains had been razed but nothing had been built on the site. There are problems with the insurance payout as it isn’t clear if there was a structural problem or if the building was destroyed deliberately, there are suspicions that it is an insurance scam.

                                                                          Letter provided to Maggie by Michael when she met him for afternoon tea:

                                                                          Wood,

                                                                          Ah yes I see now who I am dealing with, Well sir if you will not conduct yourself honourably I have no choice but to carry on building “My monstrosity as you put it, If oxford is to be a town of education then it needs knowledge, I am building a tower for books sir and I will be providing 2 scholarships for the townspeople you “merchants” had forgotten all about,

                                                                          In the interests of civility I would suggest you contact me no more

                                                                          Lord Henry Watling

                                                                          Apparently, Woods wanted to by the land so he could walk from Oxford to somewhere in the south without leaving his land. Henry built an eyesore on it to wind him up. And they say the gods are petty and cruel.

                                                                            Thrax’s Gym

                                                                            See fig. 21

                                                                            Owned by Thrax who takes a personal interest in ensuring his members are happy.

                                                                            Access is via portal opened with a membership card, activated with the members’ blood and then tapped against a wall. Likely a specific wall such as an office at White’s.

                                                                            The interior is extremely nice. It is very clearly a place for people with significant money. It isn’t shy on branding either with the T between bars everywhere.

                                                                            Signposting on the walls is in multiple languages:

                                                                            • Latin
                                                                            • Greek
                                                                            • Two I didn’t recognise
                                                                            • Svartálfar (Dwarven runescript)
                                                                            • English

                                                                            There are no windows anywhere in the place as far as I could see.

                                                                            The entrance level includes reception and the swimming pool.

                                                                            Lifts lead up to studios for dance and sword practice, along with a sword corridor.

                                                                            Down takes you to the restaurant, coffee shop and transport hub.

                                                                            Reception is well-equipped with phones and computers. There aren’t enough monitors for the amount of CCTV I could see though so there is clearly a dedicated security office somewhere.

                                                                            The receptionist — Even — looked quite capable of handling himself until backup arrived though.

                                                                            The swimming pool is decked out with bronze and marble. It has the luxury of the rest of the place. There’s a lifeguard, saunas and masseuse.

                                                                            The sword practise rooms are equipped with just about every kind of blade you could wish for, with a standing off to special order anything a member desires that isn’t already in the collection.

                                                                            Known members include:

                                                                            • Michael
                                                                            See also:
                                                                            • Michael and the Gym

                                                                              White’s is the oldest gentlemen’s club in London, founded in 1693, and is considered by many to be the most exclusive private club in London.

                                                                              It is housed at 37–38 St James’s Street, London, SW1.

                                                                              Mordred and Michael are members.

                                                                              Artefacts

                                                                              1897 pattern sword

                                                                              Artie lost two of these during WWI.

                                                                              One was gift from Field Marshal Bernard Law Montgomery. Jade Fox used it to make the Crystal Casket. After it was retrieved from Verdas we were able to use it to free Britannia. It is currently hanging in Maggie’s library.

                                                                              Aleister Crowley’s Jewel-studded Unicursal Hexagram Amulet

                                                                              See fig. 22

                                                                              Five of these were made. One was used by Jade Fox to attack Berron’s launch party.

                                                                              They create a smoke-like spectral projection which attacks people nearby. Physical attacks tend only to separate the smoke into multiple monsters. A high-C note can dissipate them.

                                                                              See also:

                                                                              Almace

                                                                              Alias

                                                                              • Almice
                                                                              • Almacia

                                                                              In the legendary Song of Roland, Almace is the sword of Turpin, Archbishop of Reims, one of the last three Franks to die at the Battle of Roncevaux Pass, along with Roland (Orlando in Italian) and Gualter de Hum.

                                                                              It appears in the story of Wayland and Charlemagne and was forged by that smith.

                                                                              Anti-Magic Kevlar

                                                                              This is subject to an ongoing investigation.

                                                                              This first showed up being worn by men attempting to assassinate Henry. A second incident was reported by Michelle and Elliott when they tangled with the Colani Gang who appear to be behind its manufacture in mass quantities.

                                                                              Results of Testing

                                                                              • It is highly resistant to magic being used against it
                                                                                • Including magic weapons: It appears to not only limit the effectiveness of magic imbued in a weapon, but is also more resistant to the mundane properties of such a weapon.
                                                                              • It disrupts powers used in its vicinity rendering them unpredictable.
                                                                                • Alexia lost control of a fire and damaged her office while wearing it
                                                                                • Henry’s sword, when summoned while he stood next to the kevlar, appeared in the air moving at high speed instead of to his hand.

                                                                              Berron examined it with his sight and says that magic on it looks the colour of old blood and surrounds the whole thing.

                                                                              Creation Process

                                                                              Jaxom’s theory

                                                                              Jaxom is of the opinion that, with his entire team, it would take him 19 years to craft a piece of armour like this, and only if he could find:

                                                                              • Suitable special metal
                                                                              • Another dragon to help provide the fire
                                                                              • The tears of a maiden to douse it in
                                                                              • The blood of a scion — or being of similar power — to quench it in

                                                                              Hephaestus’ theory

                                                                              Hephaestus said that dragon fire was not used in the construction of it, and that the anti-magic properties affect the entire jacket, not just the armoured plates.

                                                                              Whatever process is used to construct it, it isn’t typical for legendary items and the anti-magic properties will likely dissolve after about a year.

                                                                              Brigette’s thoughts

                                                                              Brigette could not discern the exact process used to make it, and suggested it would need a large space, possibly a warehouse (and we know the Colanis have on in Bermondsey).

                                                                              Profane

                                                                              The raid on Profane showed that the demons had someone strapped down and surrounded by medical equipment including IVs.

                                                                              Nearby they had a store of blood, saline, and Dr. Jekyll’s the formula.

                                                                              Presumably, they have been keeping this scion, titanspawn, or whatever alive and continually feeding him the formula to enhance the power of his blood and then draining him.

                                                                              Since he is dead and the Profane destroyed, they will have to find a new source of blood to create the armour with.

                                                                              See also:
                                                                              • Sally and the Kevlar
                                                                              • Raid on Amarna

                                                                              Art of Witchcraft

                                                                              A volume by Betty Lawson and published by Statten Publishing was found in the Boscastle Witch Museum’s library. It is a genuine spellbook and contains information on:

                                                                              • The creation of potions, including explosive ones
                                                                              • Summoning spells
                                                                              • How to bind an animal to you

                                                                              The Ballyshannon Sun-disc

                                                                              See fig. 23

                                                                              One of the artefacts found at the Ashmolean by Berron.

                                                                              It’s mystical properties are currently unknown.

                                                                              The museum’s public documentation on it says:

                                                                              This gold disc, decorated with simple raised decoration (repoussé), was probably discovered in a prehistoric burial monument in Ballyshannon, County Donegal, Ireland. It is recorded as having been found by men who were searching for a grave described in an Irish song as belonging to a giant wearing gold ornaments.

                                                                              Dating to the centuries around 2500–2150 BC, such objects are known as ‘sun discs’ although there is no direct evidence for their identification as sun symbols. More than 30 examples are recorded from Ireland, Britain and various parts of Europe including France, Spain and Portugal. The design on the Ballyshanon disc of a cross shape surrounded by circles and geometric patterns is typical of these objects. Similar decoration is also known from ceramic vessels of the same date. Many discs are pierced in the centre with two holes that may have been used to sew them to a piece of clothing or a head-dress, perhaps in pairs. It had been thought that the gold may have come from Ireland, but a new scientific technique developed at Southampton University suggests that the metal for at least some of the discs may have originated in Cornwall.

                                                                              The Ballyshannon ‘sun disc’ has been in the Ashmolean since the late 17th century. It was first illustrated in the 1695 edition of William Camden’s Britannia, a chronological survey of Great Britain and Ireland, making it among the earliest documented discoveries of a prehistoric artefact from the British Isles.

                                                                              Cursed Muramasa

                                                                              Artie’s once wielded a Muramasa blade.

                                                                              The swordsmith, Muramasa, was cursed by gods with a bloodlust curse. He discovered that he could forge a blade which inherited his curse to free himself from it for a year.

                                                                              When Artie realised that the blade gave him bloodlust, he threw it into the sea near Japan.

                                                                              Dagger of Disease

                                                                              This is a dagger which infects any who are wounded by it with a fatal disease. Two are known to exist.

                                                                              The first is in the possession of Mordred and was created for him by Morgan Le Fae.

                                                                              The second was used to kill the roses of Seelie as part of a scheme to render them barren. It is currently kept at SATT.

                                                                              Durendal

                                                                              Alias

                                                                              • Durandal

                                                                              The sword of Roland, legendary paladin of Charlemagne in French epic literature. It is also said to have belonged to young Charlemagne at one point, and, passing through Saracen hands, came to be owned by Roland.

                                                                              It appears in the story of Wayland and Charlemagne and was forged by that smith.

                                                                              The Encyclopaedia of Ancient & Forbidden Knowledge

                                                                              A book, first published in 1971, by Zolar.

                                                                              A digital copy was slipped to Mordred by a waiter at the Mordred/Cel party on the Isle of Wight. The editing history traced it back to a copy of Adobe Acrobat licensed to March Hollis.

                                                                              The following paragraph in the dedication was highlighted:

                                                                              There’s not a pulse beat in the human frame which
                                                                              Is not governed by the Heavens above us.
                                                                              The blood, in all its ebb and flow,
                                                                              Is swayed by them as certainly as
                                                                              Are the restless tides of the salt sea
                                                                              By the respendent Moon; and at thy birth.
                                                                              Thy Mother’s eyes gazed not more stead-fastly on thee
                                                                              Than did the Stars that rule thy destiny.

                                                                              Excalibur

                                                                              Artie’s most famous sword. It was last seen being thrown, near Wadebridge, into the River Camel by Gawain. He didn’t see if the Lady of the Lake retrieved it or not.

                                                                              See also:
                                                                              • The Fall of SATT

                                                                              Girdle of Isis

                                                                              Alias

                                                                              • Tyet
                                                                              • Knot of Isis

                                                                              The tyet resembles an ankh, except that its arms curve down. Its meaning is also reminiscent of the ankh, as it is often translated to mean “welfare” or “life”.

                                                                              The power of the Tyet is described in a spell in the Papyrus of Ani (AKA Coming Forth by Day AKA The Book of the Dead):

                                                                              The blood of Isis, the spells of Isis, the magical words of Isis shall keep this great (or shining) one strong, and shall protect him from whosoever would harm him do to him such things as the abominateth.

                                                                              In the modern era there have been reports of tyet as a restraining item or even a magical spell casting relic.

                                                                              See also:
                                                                              • It Happened One Night
                                                                              • Investigation: Rededication

                                                                              Gram

                                                                              Alias

                                                                              • Nothung
                                                                              • Wrath

                                                                              Gram (meaning Wrath) is the sword that Sigurd used to kill the dragon Fafnir.

                                                                              The sword is not a standard broadsword, but is a two-handed blade with a short pommel, and is undecorated save for a simple leather wrap on the hilt.

                                                                              Gram is primarily seen in the Volsunga Saga used by men in the Volsung line after Sigmund. Sigmund receives it during the wedding feast for his sister, Signy. Part of the way through the feast a strange man appears carrying a sword. Although unknown to Sigmund, this is the god Odin. He thrusts the sword into the Barnstokkr tree that grew in the middle of the hall and said, “The man to pull out this sword from the trunk shall receive it from me as a gift and he will find out for himself that he never bore in hand a better sword than this.” Soon after he departed every man made his attempt to pull the sword out of the wood. All fail except Sigmund who easily extracts it.

                                                                              The similarities of this legend to that of The Sword In The Stone should not be underestimated.

                                                                              Wielded by Artie.

                                                                              See also:
                                                                              • A Day in the Life

                                                                              Heb-Sed Mace

                                                                              See fig. 24

                                                                              A mace depicting Narmer’s Heb-Sed. It may be the first depiction of the ceremony in history and seems likely to be be the missing artefact needed to perform the special Heb-Sed festival.

                                                                              It was on public display at the Ashmolean before it was stolen by unknown thieves and then liberated from them to SATT by Mordred, Berron, and Greg.

                                                                              It has since been “returned”, but since the original is safely locked up at SATT, this is a copy. The source is unknown and warrants further investigation.

                                                                              See also:
                                                                              • Investigation: Heb-Sed Ceremony
                                                                              • Meeting Taranis

                                                                              The Horn of the Wind

                                                                              An untested artefact, it is believed to be like a bag of winds: It can summon of one the winds or cause the wind to do your bidding.

                                                                              It has been around since the time of the Phoneticians / Minoans.

                                                                              Ares has had his eye on it for a while and sent people to steal it on multiple occasions.

                                                                              It is currently missing from SATT archives.

                                                                              See also:
                                                                              • Investigation: Missing Artefacts & Altered Files

                                                                              The Hyde Formula

                                                                              Dr. Jekyll’s formula for transforming an individual into an out-of-control, violent, regenerating Übermensch.

                                                                              A variant of it is being used by Asclepius (without the rage or healing properties).

                                                                              See also:

                                                                                The Khopesh of Light

                                                                                The name given to two swords made by Wayland the Smith.

                                                                                Both measure 96.5 cm (38 in) long and 19 cm (7 1⁄2 in) wide at the handle. About 2.5 cm (1 in) of the steel blade’s tip is missing; the end is jagged. The blade features a decorative “running wolf” mark which originated in the town of Passau, Lower Bavaria, Germany. It has a gilt-iron hilt, a wooden grip bound in wire.

                                                                                The first, which appears in the story of Wayland and Charlemagne has mind controlling powers that make people nearby friendly to the wielder. It also glows.

                                                                                This one turned up in the Phoenix sale of Nazi treasure and was recovered and is now at SATT. It is thought to be the same as the unnamed regalia sword purported to be Tristan’s sword.

                                                                                The other was given to Wayland’s apprentice.

                                                                                The Crown Jewels of the UK includes a 17th century replica (is that a lie? Or was Wayland still about in C17 to make this replica?) with a squared off end. It is a ceremonial sword used at the coronation of British kings and queens. The blunted end symbolises mercy.

                                                                                It is tied up in the sovereignty of the nation in a similar fashion to the ravens at the Tower.

                                                                                Its leather sheath is bound in crimson velvet with gold embroidery and has been remade several times since the 17th century. The current one was made in 1937.

                                                                                There is a claim of Curtana being the sword of Edward the Confessor but that is probably spurious.

                                                                                  Witchblade

                                                                                  Most of this report concerns the original Witchblade. Any information on copies is called out explicitly.

                                                                                  Origins

                                                                                  The Witchblade dates back to pre-history. There are claims that in the time before the gods, two opposing primal forces clashes so violently that they risked destroying the nascent universe. To save to save it they agreed a peace between themselves and the Witchblade was the result of their union — a living weapon designed to keep the peace between the Light and the Darkness.

                                                                                  Appearance

                                                                                  The Witchblade appears to be made of steel with a large ruby embedded in it. When inactive it takes the form of an armoured gauntlet but is capable of changing its form to anything made of metal.

                                                                                  Commonly it will appear as a bracelet (still with the ruby) when its owner desires subtlety and expands back to the gauntlet form with some kind of embedded weapon — usually a blade — when the owner is threatened. As danger heightens it expands further (up to and including a full suit of armour).

                                                                                  Protection

                                                                                  The amour is stronger than any mortal forged metal.

                                                                                  It has been speculated the the level of protection is directly related to the threat the bearer feels they are under (i.e. it is connected to their emotional state). This means it provides poor protection against surprise attacks.

                                                                                  Even when in the simple gauntlet form, the bearer gains either the instincts or reflexes to move their forearm between themselves and danger; to deflect gunfire for example.

                                                                                  Flight

                                                                                  One report claims the Witchblade, when expanded to full armour, grew wings and allowed the bearer to fly.

                                                                                  Sensory Enhancement

                                                                                  The Witchblade enhances the perceptions of the bearer.

                                                                                  A surviving fragment of a journal documenting the Witchblade claims:

                                                                                  You can use the witchblade to pierce the veil of the senses, to seek in an entirely new way, to extract more information from the universe than the normal human sensorium allows.

                                                                                  Other reports claim the bearer receives prophetic dreams — both while sleeping and, on occasion, while awake — and visitations from the spirits of the dead.

                                                                                  The visions make some Wielders of the blade paranoid but you should trust them. They show you things that are real as what you would normally see; if not more so.

                                                                                  Control

                                                                                  The Witchblade is a living weapon with a will of its own.

                                                                                  The journal mentioned above also said:

                                                                                  There appear to be two general approaches to master the Witchblade. The straightforward approach is the direct application of Will.

                                                                                  The Will is the link between the soul and the universe.

                                                                                  The other is to form a symbiosis with it and operate in partnership, keeping in mind that the Witchblade’s desires may not always be in line with the bearers.

                                                                                  The most successful wielders of the blade seem to have found a balance between the two paths.

                                                                                  Bloodlust is the power of the blade. Desire for revenge. Desire for control. Can you control that desire or is it better unleashed?

                                                                                  Many of them fail eventually though:

                                                                                  It has a habit of slipping from the owner’s grasp at the moment they need it the most.

                                                                                  It clearly desires to be used, one piece of advice I scraped up said:

                                                                                  Use it or lose it. If you don’t deserve it it will abandon you.

                                                                                  Risks

                                                                                  Taking up the Witchblade is a risk. Those it rejects have been known to lose the hand they wear it on.

                                                                                  There are also records of women being unable to remove the Witchblade. Possibly where its will is stronger then theirs and they found themselves to be an unwilling host for it.

                                                                                  Women

                                                                                  All the recorded bearers that I could find documented were women. The explanations for that that I’ve found have been contradictory.

                                                                                  One claim is that women are more elemental than men and being closer to nature the blade finds them superior.

                                                                                  Another is that women are better at handling pain, which they suffer due to the threats the Witchblade faces.

                                                                                  It could be that the Witch in the name is literal, and the application of Will mentioned above requires witchcraft. The relative scarcity of male witches would explain the lack of successful bearers of that gender. Given the consequences of rejection, that isn’t something I want to test.

                                                                                  History

                                                                                  France 1429-1431

                                                                                  Joan of Arc carried the Witchblade. The reports of his powers of prophecy were especially strong in her legend.

                                                                                  She was executed by burning on 30 May 1431 and the Witchblade taken by agents of the Vatican’s Ordo Veritas and locked in the Black Vault.

                                                                                  Interim

                                                                                  There are stories of the Vatican issuing the Witchblade to its agents for special missions involving battles with supernatural evil. They say that none of the wielders were ever the same again, although how much that has to do with the Witchblade and how much with the horrors they fought I can’t say.

                                                                                  West Indies 1717

                                                                                  Anne Bonny, a pirate and treasure hunter, found the Witchblade — I can’t find any explanation for how it arrived in the West Indies — and fought with it for several years. She was a noted enemy of Blackbeard.

                                                                                  In 1920 she was killed by members of the Ordo Veritas and the Witchblade returned to The Black Vault.

                                                                                  Europe 1938

                                                                                  Rumours claim that the Witchblade was traded by the Vatican to Adolf Hitler as part of a mutual non-aggression pact ahead of WWII.

                                                                                  I can’t find any further reports of the Witchblade until it resurfaced in New York at the turn of the century.

                                                                                  It wasn’t reported as being in any of the collections controlled by Hitler or the Thule Society that were acquired by Allied forces after the war. Ordo Veritas internal documents were leaked in 2004 which showed budget allocations between 1980 and 2000 for a project named Gladius patieris dolósi assigned to Acquisitions.

                                                                                  New York 2001

                                                                                  Sara Pezzini, a New York police detective came in possession of it after a shoot-out at a museum featuring an exhibition of artefacts relating to Joan of Arc (all of which were loaned anonymously).

                                                                                  Given her background, it is unlikely that she would have stolen it so it seems likely that the Witchblade bonded to her of its own volition.

                                                                                  During that incident, her partner — Danny Woo — was killed.

                                                                                  She appears to have been active with the Witchblade from March through to June of that year before disappearing for three weeks. The next records mentioning her show her being involuntarily committed to the care of the Asclepius Institute with notes that she is violent, considered a danger to herself and others, and rants about seeing her dead partner, Danny.

                                                                                  The current location of the Witchblade itself is unknown.

                                                                                  Other Witchblades

                                                                                  Similar weapons have cropped up from time to time over the centuries, none has ever had the staying power of the original.

                                                                                  They have always gathered the interest of collectors and groups with a desire for power or control.

                                                                                  Miscellaneous

                                                                                  Asclepius Report for Mordred Sr

                                                                                  Summary

                                                                                  Current status of Asclepius

                                                                                  I’ve been unable to uncover any certain information on this so far. Given more time I may manage to dig something up.

                                                                                  The general agreement is that Asclepius was attacked and either killed or gravely injured. Either way, he has been taken out of the picture for the time being.

                                                                                  Who is responsible is even less clear. The popular theories are:

                                                                                  • A SATT death squad. (My attempts to verify that have been rebuffed; I’m going to try to cultivate friendly contacts there).
                                                                                  • The Unseelie. (I raised the question with their Queen’s champion and received threats for my pains, but that could mean he was offended that I thought it possible or angry that I was close to the truth.) (I’m sure this sentence will be true after Saturday real time)
                                                                                  • Apollo taking out his own son. Their disagreement is well-known.
                                                                                  • Ayida-Weddo and Boli Shah resuming an old feud that Aceso touched off in the 1980s.
                                                                                  • An internal power play.

                                                                                  I’ll provide an update if I learn anything new.

                                                                                  Identity of leadership

                                                                                  The current leadership of the Asclepius Institute is opaque. Emails recovered from servers from the Hood River, Oregon site make mention of Asclepius’ children Aceso and Aegle which implies they have taken over from their father.

                                                                                  Everything I’ve found has suggested that they have been largely passive in the past, attending meetings with their father but not taking an active role.

                                                                                  Whomever is in charge is taking a more active role than Asclepius’ did.

                                                                                  There’s no information to determine if they are simply off the leash or if someone is using them as a front.

                                                                                  Again, I’ll provide an update if I learn anything further.

                                                                                  Openness to an alliance

                                                                                  Tobias Redman, the security coordinator for the Hood River, Oregon site had an open investigation into Lisa Urmin — the heightened security that Morganette ran into was because the case had put him on the alert — he had found some financial irregularities in her accounts. While he is likely distracted right now, if he continues the investigation it will lead him back to Prime Advisors Inc. If anyone connects them with us, that will work against any possibility of an alliance.

                                                                                  We should cut that investigation off as soon as possible to reduce that risk.

                                                                                  Once done, we should allow some time to let the dust settle. Then, given lack of information about the leadership, our best approach would likely be through Katherine Lambert. She acts as the public face of the organisation and may be able to to direct us to the right people.

                                                                                  Recommendations

                                                                                  • Eliminate Tobias Redman to put a halt to his investigation.
                                                                                  • Shut down Prime Advisors Inc. to remove any trail back to us.
                                                                                  • Further investigation into the identity of the new leadership.
                                                                                  • Approach Katherine Lambert.
                                                                                  See also:
                                                                                  • Family in the Light

                                                                                  Dealing with the Fae

                                                                                  A briefing by Alexia

                                                                                  Right guys, a quick briefing to make sure you are all aware of some of the rules when dealing with the Fae, as the Seelie Court are a special type of bastard if you ask me!

                                                                                  Most importantly; be careful when accepting gifts. This is what got us into trouble in the first place as we got tricked into delivering a hospitality gift to the Unseelie court which was actually an exploding boar bomb; did a lot of damage to their court and we almost took the blame for it! However, hospitality rules are likely to be in play so not accepting a gift might also be dangerous, seen as impolite or rude to the host.

                                                                                  Be wary about giving gifts –they might consider there to be an obligation attached, or they might start trying to “help” you balance a gift without you asking or realising in order to gain something for themselves, such as a favour or obligation.

                                                                                  The leader of the court is considered all powerful. Bear in mind that we are there as Greg has been asked to help arbitrate the power struggle that resulted from Tyranus challenging Berron and being defeated.

                                                                                  Dress to impress / dress nicely. They are judgy mother-fu… um, sorry, they will judge us on our appearances and they are stuck up a****oles.

                                                                                  They have eyes and ears everywhere, their servants and guards will report back to them and the spymasters. They might use anything indiscreet against us if they choose. (Yes I’m aware I will not be able to call them a****oles whilst I’m there!)

                                                                                  If they consider that we are being rude then they have the right to challenge us to a dual. As many of you know, duals can be first blood, third blood or death. I doubt there is much we can do to prove an “accidental” death wasn’t intended in a third blood or first blood dual, so try to avoid giving them the chance!

                                                                                  The plants there may or may not be sentient, (Ophelia, I’m not sure how this changes your powers, as taking control of sentient plants might be more difficult and probably will be considered rude.) I know some of you were aware of the roses that are used in executions for the Unseelie court. Think giant and carnivorous.

                                                                                  The Seelie Fae are barren and can’t have children. They have not been able to have children for 100 years or so. We believe it’s because Tyranus was cursed, but it’s not proven. He had the stupid idea that I would make a perfect brood mare for him, so we don’t help him in any way! Do not talk about children; it’s definitely likely to be a touchy subject for all. Repeat: DO NOT TALK ABOUT CHILDREN.

                                                                                  Don’t eat Fae food and drink; it gets used to trap people there. Hospitality rules are likely to mean there should be safe food provided, but be careful and exercise caution.

                                                                                  Being intimate with a Fae can bind you to that Fae is odd ways. (I’m looking at you, dearest Berron. Think about what Frost’s (or the Queen’s) reaction would be if you turn up with even more swirls to your tattoos.)

                                                                                  Fae power is usually based in their hands – they can have one or two hands of power, and their titles are usually a good indication of what those powers are. For instance, Tyranus was the lord of Fire and Beauty, he has lost one of those hands thanks to Berron, but we don’t know which. Rose if the Lady of the Thorn and the Knife; we know she can form a dagger from a thorn she shapes from her hand, but I’m assuming she can do other things as well. Not sure what Malcolm can do but his title is Lord of the Hand of Pain, so he has powers. These titles give you an idea of how strong the Fae are and what they can do.

                                                                                  Fae take titles seriously, and they assign titles based on your story. If they don’t give you a title, don’t take offense, it’s just that your story hasn’t involved them enough for them to notice (remember I said they were judgy!) They might assign titles to you as they see fit, I tend to try and ignore the titles of the Seelie court as quite frankly they are a bit on the presumptive side. I don’t think the courts have to agree on titles so they might not reference the titles the Unseelie court granted us. I’m not sure how important this is unless they refuse to accept the assistance of Greg, but he is Dragon recommended rather than Unseelie recommended in this case so there might not be a problem

                                                                                  Fae take promises really seriously, so can I check whilst the last party was going on, did any of us promise any of them anything? (I was a bit distracted at the time and not in on all the conversations that were happening behind the scenes).

                                                                                  I’m also assuming that as there is currently a power vacuum then Tyranus has been shown the door. We may have to tread carefully around accusations of a SATT led coup, which is blatantly ridiculous for us, but there might be others who would prefer that tale rather than admitting that they were serving an egomaniac that wouldn’t back down and help his people out because it went against his pride! (Again, I’m aware I’m biased, I’m dealing with it, okay! Right, time for a coffee…)

                                                                                  Heb-Sed Festival (Special)

                                                                                  A normal Heb-Sed festival must be performed every 30 years to renew the power of the Pharaoh so he can regain magic and continue the fight against Apep. Failure to carry out the ritual will cause him to lose power, in which case the priest of Amenhotep will kill the Pharaoh so a successor, who will have access to the magic, can take his place.

                                                                                  Every 3000 years a special Heb-Sed must be carried out to renew the power of Set himself. This allows him to support Ra.

                                                                                  At the festival Set gives presents to the top gods, especially Ma’at. He is blessed by Sekhmet and Hathor and presented with:

                                                                                  • A sacred bull’s (missing) tail
                                                                                  • Three Egyptian crowns (the type one wears): white (upper), red (lower) and blue (war)
                                                                                  • A was scepter (possibly the one currently in Vanessa’s office, which puts it in the hands of the Hand)
                                                                                  • A mace (missing)
                                                                                  • A bow (missing)

                                                                                  He must raise a djed pillar then fun four laps of a sacred course.

                                                                                  The previous times the ceremony has taken place there has been a cultural acceleration for Egypt and (possibly) the world in general.

                                                                                  If the ceremony were to fail then all scions of Set would lose their powers and a powerful ally in the fight against Apep would fall. This might be enough for Apep to break through to Midgard.

                                                                                  The Hand of Isis has been “the holder and the guardian”. When Phoenix split from the Hand at some point after the last Heb-Sed, they took some items with them, and others were lost in the chaos. They are asking for help because they are down to one year before the ceremony must take place and they haven’t managed to find some of the items.

                                                                                  The Hand, Phoenix and Taranis have a pact to ensure the ceremony takes place.

                                                                                  See also:
                                                                                  • Investigation: Heb-Sed Ceremony
                                                                                  • Meeting Taranis

                                                                                  Heb-Sed Pact

                                                                                  The Hand, Phoenix and Taranis have a pact to ensure that the Heb-Sed Festival that empowers Set takes place every 3000 years.

                                                                                  The details are carved on a stone tablet:

                                                                                  The undersigned shall with all their power lest they lose their power assist The Great God Set in performing his Heb Sed Festival of 3000 years so that he may perform his duty in defending Ra and the realms.

                                                                                  It is written in Gaelic, New Kingdom Egyptian hieroglyphs, classical Greek, and old medieval English.

                                                                                  It is signed by:

                                                                                  • Jedith in perpetuity of all his descendants
                                                                                  • The Head Priestess of the Hand of Isis in perpetuity of the Hand
                                                                                  • The Phoenix Library in perpetuity
                                                                                  See also:
                                                                                  • Investigation: Heb-Sed Ceremony
                                                                                  • Meeting Taranis

                                                                                  Investigation (Closed): Morganette

                                                                                  Last time I reported to Father, he was in the process of giving my sister, Morganette a serious beating which he implied was because she had failed at a mission in America. He said she should have known better than to get caught by the magic police and get into a fight with a bird.

                                                                                  He was right, she should have known better. Either something went very sideways or she fucked up on purpose.

                                                                                  When I got back to London, I did some digging.

                                                                                  Michelle confirmed that something happened at an Asclepius facility and was dealt with by the magic police, but doesn’t know the details.

                                                                                  Henry’s US contacts knew nothing.

                                                                                  I went back to talk to Morganette who claimed she had been given bad intel and the girl that she was supposed to kidnap was much better protected than expected. Morganette barely got out with her life and the girl was killed.

                                                                                  Justin Burland was able to find out that there was a fire, terrorists were blamed and there were several people who were killed but could not be identified due to the fire including two children: Klara Zadornova and Ivan Sedonvia.

                                                                                  I focused on Klara since it was a girl that Father wanted kidnapping.

                                                                                  She is 16, 5’8”, blue eyes, athletic, pale, and had short-cropped, blonde hair. She was smuggled into the US from Russia by the Asclepius Institute using back channels. She is said to have illusion powers and was called a witch back home in Russia. Ivan was smuggled in at the same time but he had super strength and illusion.

                                                                                  A passport was recently forged, for someone matching her description, in the name Zoya Ovechkina.

                                                                                  She was booked on a flight to Gatwick landing on Tuesday at 1400 local time. There’s no sign of a connecting flight or hotel booking, so I assume she is going to meet someone and be taken to a safe house.

                                                                                  It looks like Ivan’s new identity is Gregory Zino but he wasn’t booked on the same flight. As far as I can tell, she is travelling alone.

                                                                                  Someone has been rescuing people like this for about 20 years, which happens to be about the same length of time as Father has had Morganette out doing missions.

                                                                                  Case closed. Mina’s coven has been running an underground railroad to get people, mostly children, out of the US. They’ve been working with Morganette for two decades.

                                                                                  See also:
                                                                                  • Investigation (Closed): Morganette

                                                                                  Joan Crosbie scholarship, The

                                                                                  The Joan Crosbie scholarship award is given to two people of Oxford from low income families to go to any Oxford College that will accept them. It is awarded by the Rogers Library. The myth goes that the Lord who bought the land the library was built on and set up the endowment to fund the scholarship only did so to anger a member of St. John’s College.

                                                                                  Museums and Historical Sites

                                                                                  Gods, Titans, Scions and Spawn can gain power from visiting museums. Not only do many of them hold powerful relics that have accidentally made their way through history to the museum but they are also places of worship for the old ways which makes them extremely important. Spawn and Scions have been fighting over access to Museums and sites of power since the war started.

                                                                                  On the Express Train to Utophia

                                                                                  Apr 2022

                                                                                  A newspaper article published late July 2022.

                                                                                  One of the benefits of being a music journalist is you get wind of secret or impromptu gigs. This isn’t always a good thing, I’ve had the dubious pleasure of attending some awful affairs in the dingiest of places. However, this week was one of the good ones. Colt Express and their irrepressible frontman Berron Greenstone have been quiet for a while. Or, rather, quiet by his standards. After their raucous Ragnarok ‘N’ Roll tour of Scandinavia we were left wondering what was next and when we’d get something new to get our teeth into. Well this week we were treated to a taste. A whisper went round that Colt Express were playing an intimate gig to test some new songs. With less than 24 hours’ notice it should have been very intimate but that would be underestimating the appeal of one of the current best live bands around, making for a very crowded Half Moon. And, we weren’t disappointed.

                                                                                  So, I hear you ask, what can we expect?. Well, dear reader, it seems there might be a slight softening in our erstwhile archetypical rock and roll bad boy. A new number, “She Burns Me” that was, dare we say it, almost a ballad (well, in comparison to Colt Express’s normal repertoire). Has someone tamed our wild boy or is this the rest of the band’s influence? Not that we had much time to ponder this question as they went straight into another new song, “The Cold Edge of Death” that was full of the power and raw exuberance that we associate with Colt Express. Although they describe themselves as Folk Rock the influences of Creedence Clearwater and The Band, with the obvious Dylan touches, stand out and you’ll be pleased to know these continue to shine through in their new numbers.“In the Court of the Queen” is a fun party time number that epitomises the band’s fundamental tenets of enjoying life. I can’t imagine that our Queen has anywhere near as much fun as Colt Express opine. “Hometown Blues” is clearly much more collaboratively written, it has less of Berron’s whimsical influences and is more, dare we say, grounded but they then followed with “Livin’ Life on the Edge” where the whole band at one point or another were cavorting with a very appreciative and ecstatic audience. While it was clear that these new numbers were fresh off the press, the band weren’t as slick and jointed as normal, when they performed their staples they were as hot and vibrant as usual. Throw in the odd cover version (Riders on the Storm was certainly an interesting choice) and you had an almost perfect gig of old, new and borrowed but definitely nothing that left you blue. Of course, as per usual the gig ended up in a riotous celebration of life where the band and the audience became as one as the raw energy and power of the band, and Berron in particular, overpowered the senses.

                                                                                  As a taster of things to come it was certainly a night that left everyone fortunate enough to be there eager for more and desperate to get their hands on the new album. The only downside was not getting any firm release dates or even a title. Berron’s only clues were “sometime soon” while a teasing introduction to their cover of “Too Old to Rock and Roll, Too Young to Die” that hinted at a concept album. We shall just have to wait and see but frankly, on this showing, the Colt Express is starting to pick up steam again. All aboard!

                                                                                  • Night Out with the Girls

                                                                                  Pan-Realm Trade

                                                                                  After our encounters at the palace in Jötunheimr I started formulating a business plan to take advantage of the Princes’ new-found love of mead.

                                                                                  Goals

                                                                                  • Gain a political foothold in Jötunheimr
                                                                                  • Funnel information from there to us
                                                                                  • Improve the fortunes of the people of Finaya’s village (they were welcoming to us and I assumed that Henry and Ophelia would want to improve their lot)
                                                                                  • Improve our fortunes (mine in particular, my expenses seem to be mounting up and I’ve not been running as many side schemes as I did when I wasn’t spending most of my time wearing a white hat).
                                                                                  • Create a working relationship with Llŷr that I can use to try to rehabilitate him and/or interfere with Ares & Ptah’s plans

                                                                                  The last of those came later when I realised that he’d be ideal for handing the logistics on the Midgard side of things, at least if he didn’t turn around and betray us.

                                                                                  The product

                                                                                  Essentially this boils down to forming an import/export firm which ships, initially at least, two products from Midgard to Jötunheimr:

                                                                                  • High Quality artisanal mead, produced by Elliott, which will fetch a premium price among the nobility
                                                                                  • Lesser quality mead, Elliott insists on something better than Tesco Value and is going to talk to a contact he has to find us a supplier, which will capitalise on the market on the good stuff by being available at a lesser price and thus react the tables of people who want to emulate their betters.

                                                                                  Obviously, we can’t just give this away and need to have something to bring back to Midgard. Jötunheimr currency doesn’t carry much weight here and they don’t have access to dollars or sterling. We’ll need to import goods or materials and sell them locally. There are a couple of likely candidates.

                                                                                  • Gemstones are something Jötunheimr appears to have in relative abundance. We’ll need to sort out the provenance of them — it wouldn’t do to be accused to dealing in conflict diamonds! — but Elliott and I both have contacts who can help with that.
                                                                                  • High end textile work — embroidered clothes, rugs, etc — is more common an art form over there than here so we should be able to find craftspeople who can supply us. If we get things rolling we could hire them to work to order, how does opening The House of Margaret as a fashion house sound? Perhaps we could persuade this Madame I keep hearing about to provide some designs?

                                                                                  Logistics — Midgard

                                                                                  This is where Llŷr comes in. Tod des Schwans can handle pretty much everything from this site. Llŷr, it turns out, is a highly competent businessman… he just turns to jelly in the social situations or in the presence of attractive women.

                                                                                  He can even supply a mage to open the portal, but the cost is prohibitive and would make profits marginal. It’s a useful way to get started while we look at alternative ways to generate the portal (and the coin I have in the lead box in my safe is looking increasingly attractive).

                                                                                  Logistics — Jötunheimr

                                                                                  We will need a location to portal to and from in Jötunheimr. Ideally it should be reasonably close to the capital as that is where the primary market is.

                                                                                  We also need people on the other side to handle things. I expect Thom would love it, but is probably to inexperienced for the job. He could be good as an apprentice to whomever gets put in charge though.

                                                                                  Security. Gremog and Adels expressed an interest in joining Lady Margaret’s cadre of fighters. They are probably a good place to start with recruiting guards. We’ll have to include some training in their contracts though, but between us we have plenty of capable sword teachers.

                                                                                  We still need someone to run the operation though. I don’t know if any of the above have the skills, but we can talk to them. If they don’t they might still have some recommendations.

                                                                                  Marketing — Jötunheimr

                                                                                  Travelling bards are the main source of news. We should encourage them to talk about how wonderful mead is and how popular it has become at court after Lady Margaret’s gift.

                                                                                  Puzzle Box

                                                                                  Sitting on the shelf in the cupboard at SATT above where Mordred’s spare suit hangs is a Chinese puzzle box.

                                                                                  Well. It’s not Chinese. It was made in Birmingham in the 1930s. It’s quite a nice reproduction though. Mordred picked it up for a song at an auction when it caught his eye.

                                                                                  Inside is cut out foam with spaces for an 18mm Makarov pistol, magazines, and bullets.

                                                                                  Relics

                                                                                  Items of great power that Scions and titan spawn use to boost their powers. Notable examples include Mjölnir, Excalibur, Hercules’s club, Kusanagi-no-Tsurugi and the Cauldron of Plenty.

                                                                                  Safety in America

                                                                                  Given the power of Asclepius in the US, some safety suggestions are worth following.

                                                                                  Rule 1: Don’t go.

                                                                                  Failing that:

                                                                                  • Travel under false identities. Use different false identities while you are there.
                                                                                  • Hide your tattoos.
                                                                                  • Avoid the magic police. You can recognise them by their badge: Green background, Sun symbol, Rod of Asclepius.
                                                                                  • Do not use magic. They have machines (their range and duration is limited) which can detect it. If you have to use magic, leave the area immediately > afterwards.

                                                                                  The Sins of the Father

                                                                                  Yes, truly, for look you, the sins of the father are to be laid upon the children. Therefore I promise ye I fear you. I was always plain with you, and so now I speak my agitation of the matter. Therefore be o’ good cheer, for truly I think you are damned. There is but one hope in it that can do you any good, and that is but a kind of bastard hope neither.

                                                                                  The Merchant of Venice, Act 3 Scene 5, William Shakespeare

                                                                                  My notes are, for the most part, practical observations with the occasional piece of commentary. Here I break from the pattern to simply include a quote from The Bard which speaks to me of my current situation (I write this shortly after meeting Whisper for the first time). I hold out little hope that my father is not my kin and must take satisfaction in that stepping back a generation I can find some semblance of good in my bloodline. One day I may even find true acceptance with those more distant relations.

                                                                                  Gargh. The soppy nonsense that I write late at night. I shouldn’t let myself near a pen.

                                                                                    Wayland and Charlemagne

                                                                                    Legend (specifically the Karlamagnus saga) says that Wayland the Smith presented Charlemagne with three swords.

                                                                                    Charlemagne tested the swords by seeing how far they would cut into a steel mound; Kurt penetrated “a hand’s breadth” but was notched, Almace penetrated a hand’s breadth without damage, and Durendal penetrated “half the length of a man’s foot”.

                                                                                    Charlemagne gave Kurt to Ogier the Dane and Almace to Bishop Turpin, and initially kept Durendal for himself. (Later he was told in a dream to give Durendal to Count Roland.)
