                                                                                                  Lancelot

                                                                                                  Jun 2022

                                                                                                  As planned, Henry and I met up with Whisper. I made sure to arrive a little late to allow them time to catch up before I put myself in her presence. She isn’t comfortable with me yet.

                                                                                                  I was a pleasant afternoon, although I was a little miffed to learn that Lancelot was The Knight Eternal — this was mostly because I had spent quite a few hours the previous night trying to figure out who that title belonged to and had just started to get close when I decided that bed was calling.

                                                                                                  That, at least, explains why Hecate thought Ophelia’s beau was a son of Ares.

                                                                                                  Other stories were exchanged, including what happened in Sherwood. Whisper mentioned that there was an outlaw in the 1800s that Ares would have loved to corrupt.

                                                                                                  See also:

                                                                                                    Rule, Aprodite! rule the waves

                                                                                                    Jun 2022

                                                                                                    I went hunting for Artie. He’d been dodging the team long enough and it was getting in the way of our jobs.

                                                                                                    The traditional approach of wandering the halls asking people where he was didn’t work. I also seemed to arrive somewhere shortly after he left.

                                                                                                    Plan B: I lurked in the shadows outside his office, waiting until he felt the need to retreat there. He didn’t show.

                                                                                                    Plan C: Hoping that the band around by thumb would repeat the trick I performed previously — although without offering up a prayer this time; I didn’t feel like getting into more debt when it wasn’t an emergency — I removed my ring and pressed it against the hidden door. Nothing, except a strong sense that whatever magic was concealing it before was now different. As if it had been replaced by someone else.

                                                                                                    Plan D was put on hold. I called Henry instead, and we met at Mac’s.

                                                                                                    I asked Henry to listen to some facts and tell me his conclusions, because I didn’t like the conclusions that I was coming to.

                                                                                                    • Artie was very reluctant to summon Britannia when Berron requested that.
                                                                                                    • Artie has been avoiding the team: In particular members of his family.
                                                                                                    • The magic on the door is different.

                                                                                                    Henry came to exactly the same conclusion that I did: Artie may have been replaced and he should call Aphrodite and ask her to consult with Britannia on the matter.

                                                                                                    Aphrodite is really very bad at being evasive. That she was hiding something was obvious.

                                                                                                    We performed a blood oath so that unless all three of us agreed, none could repeat what was discussed at the meeting.

                                                                                                    Around the time that Alexia met Verdas (18th July 2018), Britannia’s power started fading. Since they she has disappeared and is missing and perhaps bound somewhere. Aprodite has been masquerading as her ever since — but this is a terrible drain on her as she is only one Goddess and there are now more demands on her power.

                                                                                                    This ties in rather horribly with everything we learned about Verdas trying to control Britannia.

                                                                                                    We asked about Helen and George since they seemed to be tied up in this. They haven’t turned up in any of the underworlds which suggests something has happened to their spirits (unless they are still alive, but that doesn’t seem at all likely).

                                                                                                    They may have been trapped in Soul Jars, which are very difficult to make. While they make use of necromancy, Jade Fox isn’t thought capable of their creation as it requires a talent for glass blowing.

                                                                                                    Henry got in touch with Patrick the Dwarf and got his thoughts. People who might have been involved are:

                                                                                                    • Lacay Parrot, a scion of Bridget who works with glass.
                                                                                                    • Killian Morris, scion of Nüwa was boasting about their ability to make soul jars at a conference (this might have been a hollow boast)
                                                                                                    • Ezitl, scion of Huēhuecoyētl, can do them.

                                                                                                    We thanked her and mulled over what we had learned.

                                                                                                    Henry showed me an amulet he was wearing and told me I could use it to contact Ophelia and Mina by holding it and speaking aloud should he become incapacitated.

                                                                                                    A few days later, I did some digging into SATT files to see if we had any records of a scion of Ptah in the vicinity of Amarna. It turned out that he was rather antagonistic towards SATT, which just makes me more suspicious.

                                                                                                    See also:
                                                                                                    • Bringing the House Down

                                                                                                    Berron’s Release Party

                                                                                                    Jul 2022

                                                                                                    This is going to be a rather short report as I have been up all night peering over CCTV footage.

                                                                                                    With the advance on the album, Berron’s drummer bought himself Phil Collins’ old drum kit, which had been a sufficient focus of power that it’s beat prevented the band from stopping and the dancers from dancing.

                                                                                                    It took two and a half run-throughs of the set list before Berron was able to pull himself out of the trance it induced while Maggie and I startled Cel and got into a fight with her (which Berron insisted on continuing long after the rest of us started to doubt her being complicit in the whole thing).

                                                                                                    Meanwhile Jade Fox had acquired a ticket, joined the party, tipped the bar-person with an enchanted amulet and then snuck out to a side-room to portal out.

                                                                                                    The amulet gave us smoke monsters to fight with an annoying immunity to weapons and magical attacks. It took a high-C from Berron to dissipate them.

                                                                                                    Berron went completely off on one.

                                                                                                    I went through all the footage I could find to trace Jade Fox’s path:

                                                                                                    She first came onto a camera leaving an alley — it’s a dead end. She queued up to get into the venue, and talked to a bunch of people who were also waiting. I didn’t recognise any of them, but I’d later identify one as Barbatos. One she got inside, she stayed away from any of us, flirted with the bartender and dropped the amulet into the tip jar, then made sure she was seen on camera. She went into a side room and didn’t pop up on camera again. I’m reasonably certain that she used portals to get into the alley and out of that room, so the trail is pretty dead.

                                                                                                    See also:
                                                                                                    • Watling, Henry
                                                                                                    • Raid on Amarna

                                                                                                    Dancing Lessons

                                                                                                    Jul 2022

                                                                                                    Ophelia wanted some dancing lessons ahead of the ball she, Henry and Mini are hosting later in the year, so we gathered to go over some steps with Michelle and Elliott.

                                                                                                    I took the opportunity to ask Michelle and Elliott about the layout of the Colani warehouse and to sound out everyone about the possibility of giving my brother an opportunity to demonstrate that he isn’t hopelessly loyal to father. Everyone seemed quite happy to help. It’s nice to have friends.

                                                                                                    See also:

                                                                                                      Family Matters

                                                                                                      Jul 2022

                                                                                                      It was time for another of my periodic visits to Father’s castle.

                                                                                                      Happy was in high spirits, Morganette was getting a beating from our father, and he was in a good mood with me still: Any why wouldn’t he? With all the very public strife going on at SATT that I could take credit for.

                                                                                                      Morganette, according to Happy, had been away for three days and just got back and was on day two of taking beatings-by-means-of-training.

                                                                                                      He imparted a little information about Ares after I suggested that Henry might be a traitor working for him (although more investigation is needed before we look to make alliances there).

                                                                                                      He said, “Sometimes demons can be useful, but sometimes such idiots” and pointed me towards the Eye of Solomon and the Red Dragon in his library when I mentioned that there seemed to be some on the lose in London and that I’d like to be prepared in case I ran into one of them.

                                                                                                      Happy’s mission went well, as far as Father is concerned. It looks like Savage hasn’t plucked up the courage to tell him that he lost his book.

                                                                                                      Happy needs some more experience so I promised to look for opportunities to use him. That fit quite nicely with my plans for him.

                                                                                                      He asked if I’d seen Llŷr as he was reportedly in London. I wonder what he is up to? (I’ve since tracked him down to Angel where he has set himself up with an apartment and is making himself out to be a wealthy playboy).

                                                                                                      Asclepius appears to be making a push in the US, something to do with a high-level assassination and new blood with new ideas. It’s a worrying mirror to the Colani gang but I’m probably reading too much into that.

                                                                                                      I get the impression that Morganette was there as I could feel the daggers she was staring at me with when I agreed with father about how only a complete idiot wouldn’t know to avoid the magic police and then get into a fight with some birds. (Michelle confirmed that something happened at an Asclepius facility and was dealt with by the magic police, but doesn’t know the details. Henry’s US contacts knew nothing.)

                                                                                                      My sister is better than that though, so either someone set her up very cleverly or she screwed up on purpose. Both possibilities intrigue me and I’d like to know more.

                                                                                                      I took a look in Father’s library. It has a more complete copy of the Red Dragon — he didn’t trust Savage with the better one, and it seems he was right to — there’s a little more information about demon hierarchies there, I took notes but none appears really relevant to our situation.

                                                                                                      One thing that jumped out as missing from our copy is a note that if a human eats or drinks the blood of a scion who has the ability to wield magic then they become a ghoul when they die. Ghouls are very hard to control, only the most elite of necromancers can do it.

                                                                                                      There are lots of spells that can be powered by dead people’s souls, or by using people as batteries. I wondered about the possibility of using a god as a power source, but it didn’t say anything about that.

                                                                                                      There are ways to link gods together so they can draw power from each other in times of need. The Dioscuri are an example of that.

                                                                                                      They are the twin sons — Castor and Pollux — of Leda. Tyndareus, the king of Sparta, was the father of Castor, while Zeus was the father of Pollux. They were connected so as to draw power from each other in times of need. (And yes, as sons of Leda that does make them brothers of Llŷr).

                                                                                                      I couldn’t find anything to fill in the gaps we have about missing ingredients for the banishing technique, unfortunately. Once I started looking I just kept coming across how witches are traditional enemies of demons, until they go bad at which point them seem to run into making pacts with them instead.

                                                                                                      Perhaps Ophelia could find out more if she asked Hecate.

                                                                                                      I got in touch with Seb when I got back. Something made me want to check on the status of Stonehenge; ever since January the background power levels around there have increased. It is like something stopped drawing power from it.

                                                                                                      The magic imprisoning Verdas was not maintained by power from the henge, so it isn’t due to that collapsing.

                                                                                                      I also took the opportunity to properly introduce myself to Scarab. He’s a little concerned that he might be taken again since he was kidnapped from SATT HQ. I’ve arranged for a safe house for him that isn’t connected to SATT. He may be hard to get in touch with, but I have a number in case of emergencies.

                                                                                                      If I greet him (or vice versa) with anything other than “Hiya”, he is to take it that there is a problem and that the call is monitored or I’m under duress.

                                                                                                      He got the impression that Ares is making a power play (this doesn’t seem like much of a stretch to me, what else are you going to use an army like that for?) and notes that he has lots of children.

                                                                                                      Apparently Phobos and Demos have been seen with him a lot, but Enio has been missing and hasn’t been seen near Ares for going on eight years. I don’t know what the significance of that might be though.

                                                                                                      When I told him how we’d tracked him down, he told me that when a mirror goes haywire like that, it connects only to mirrors it has previously connected to. Our spy has used conference room C to communicate with Ares & Ptah’s forces.

                                                                                                      See also:
                                                                                                      • Identity Games
                                                                                                      • Investigation (Closed): Morganette

                                                                                                      Harpy Hunting

                                                                                                      Jul 2022

                                                                                                      The evening before I was due to help Ophelia and Morgan go hunting for a harpy, Berron decided to reveal himself as a grade A wineb kach. It seems that he took my note that “I’ll help him, but it shouldn’t be just the two of us, we need a plan” to waltz off and confront Barbatos without a plan and only Henry for backup.

                                                                                                      Berron’s approach involved flirting with Kestral so she could see his face and know that SATT were onto them, and then getting jumped by Barbatos and Wolf and nearly getting Henry killed in the bargain.

                                                                                                      I was not impressed. Nor was Michelle.

                                                                                                      The one good thing that came out of this was that a matchbook from Profane was dropped in the fight. It’s probably a trap for us though.

                                                                                                      The next day I checked a car out of the SATT motorpool and went to pick up Ophelia, Alexia and Morgan. We spent a large portion of the trip complaining about Berron. The git.

                                                                                                      Morgan explained about the name Henry Avery and how it connects to Watling and Nate.

                                                                                                      When we reached Margate we went looking for the “rogue Harpy” that Ophelia had permission from the Queen to hunt.

                                                                                                      This was one “Quillena” who turned out to be the harpy princess, and had found the 1970s with much gusto. If you can name a hippy stereotype, she fulfilled it: Taking the name “Goldspark”, living with her human lover “Leafmourn” and getting into poetry.

                                                                                                      Ophelia found she had a lot of common with the harpy (mostly through a shared desire to stay on Midgard and not return home). This may have inspired some poor choices when she took pity on the creature.

                                                                                                      When we left:

                                                                                                      • Ophelia owned the harpy queen an unspecified favour.
                                                                                                      • Goldspark’s portal stone was in Ophelia’s possession (it has one use left and if she doesn’t return it in a year it’ll cost her her eyes).
                                                                                                      • Goldspark is staying here for the next year and improving herself and then going home to negotiate (which we all know means “Have a petulant row”) a longer stay.
                                                                                                      • Morgan was unhappy with the lack of a hunt.

                                                                                                      It wasn’t quite what I had in mind for a day out, but it did stop me tracking down Berron in the corridors and SATT and breaking his nose.

                                                                                                      When I got home I arranged for a copy of the OU’s English Language prospectus to be sent to Goldleaf. If she’s serious about improving herself it will either drive all love of poetry from her forever or send her down a very deep rabbit hole.

                                                                                                      See also:

                                                                                                        Raid on Amarna

                                                                                                        Jul 2022

                                                                                                        Henry and Quatermain scouted the area for us. There was a small collection of buildings and a portal to the field where the mirror had scattered to during the experiments with the kevlar.

                                                                                                        The army on the other side was made up of a mix of people, one group in Spartan armour and one in Egyptian. There was a statue on either side: One of Ares and one of Ptah.

                                                                                                        We travelled to the area, with those of us used to wearing amour disguising ourselves as Spartans.

                                                                                                        Ophelia negotiated with the local rodent life and they scouted the interior of the buildings for us; finding one which sounded like it had prisoners in it.

                                                                                                        Under cover of night, and with an awareness of the guards’ patrol routes, we went to the prison building and made a start on freeing the prisoners.

                                                                                                        The doors were easy to unlock but the prisoners were chained to heavy blocks by chains with no sign of a lock on them — they had been placed there by warping the metal itself.

                                                                                                        Between my ice and Alexia’s fire to weaken the metal, it was easy for Berron to shatter them and we got the prisoners out, even as we knew guards were coming.

                                                                                                        Meanwhile the others were protecting us from the guards via distractions and combat. It was relatively easy to get past and back to Ophelia who was waiting with a portal.

                                                                                                        We had to fight off some scarab beatles that were attacking them though; we didn’t want to be bringing them back to SATT.

                                                                                                        We got the injured to the infirmary and got what information we could from them.

                                                                                                        Two of the rescued prisoners were natives of whatever was on the other side of the portal: They called it Warewiel. They’d been invaded — about 4 years ago — by Ptah and Ares who had conscripted them into their army and weapon’s manufacturing slave groups. Before then they knew nothing of gods and worshipped spirits of air and sun.

                                                                                                        A priest of Sobek had come to lead a rebellion there and they were a (captured) part of it.

                                                                                                        The portal is a new feature. It hasn’t been running long.

                                                                                                        Two of the other prisoners were western archaeologists who had been in the wrong place at the wrong time. I avoided taking my helmet off around them since I recognised Ewan Carter and didn’t want details of my day job spreading any further among academia then it had to.

                                                                                                        Scarab was able to tell us a little more. He’d been taken from SATT itself when he was there doing a job for Bast: He thought they may have had some of the Heb-Sed items and was looking for them. While in the building, he thought he was being followed by a man, but he caught a glimpse of skirt before he was conked out.

                                                                                                        His opinions of our allies in this matter are that the Hand of Isis are wack-jobs “like their patron” but on the up are far as wanting the Heb-Sed to take place (they’d like to give Set even more power). The Phoenix Library are power-hungry, but not megalomaniacs who would rather destroy the world than let someone else control it. They will want the Heb-Sed to take place to stop Apep.

                                                                                                        I felt the need to tell the team about Whisper. I really don’t like breaking confidences, but the amount of circumstantial evidence against her is just stacking up.

                                                                                                        It turns out that Aleister Crowley’s amulet which caused us such fun a few weeks ago was one of five.

                                                                                                        It’s audit time for the artefact collections. Maggie got herself assigned the task of dealing with the storage units where we were filing and misfiling the mace.

                                                                                                        Playing Nice

                                                                                                        Jul 2022

                                                                                                        A day or two later I returned to Father’s home with a couple of bottles of wine to make a peace offering to Morganette and ask if she wanted to talk about what happened in America.

                                                                                                        This put her off-balance and very suspicious. I can’t really blame her for that given our past history and everything that was going through my head.

                                                                                                        I’d gone there with a desperate hope that I’d discover she was secretly one of the good guys.

                                                                                                        I was also hoping to pick up some information that might let me foil one of father’s plans, and while that was a nice bonus for me, I was fully prepared to tell SATT that it was my main reason.

                                                                                                        What I told Morganette was that sibling rivalry was no fun when she was at this sort of disadvantage and that we are supposed to be on the same side; the irony of the possibility of us both betraying father and actually being on the same side did not escape me.

                                                                                                        And tracking at the back of my mind was the story I was going to tell Father if he found me being nice to my sister while he was punishing her: That I was just extracting information so that I could follow his orders and learn some more about Asclepius.

                                                                                                        Sometimes I wonder how I keep all the lies straight.

                                                                                                        She had more books that I expected, including Shakespeare and Blake. My dreams have become haunted by images of her and Goldspark forcing me to sit through open mic poetry reading sessions.

                                                                                                        Morganette blamed the American job on bad intelligence — which Father provided, but she doesn’t know where he got it from. Honestly, he claims he moulds his children to be just like him, but then he keeps us all in the dark and treats us like common grunts. If he trusted us with the bigger picture he might manage to instil some loyalty in us. Fear only goes some way to providing obedience, and at some point people snap.

                                                                                                        There was twenty guards instead of the two she was expecting, she was jumped, the girl she was supposed to kidnap — although why Father wanted her kidnapped she didn’t know — was killed in the crossfire.

                                                                                                        It did sound like a mess. I couldn’t help by remember times when people that father sent me after “died” though.

                                                                                                        She’d relaxed enough at this stage that when I offered to fix her bandages — Father had given her a nasty wound in a hard to reach place and forbidden her to get proper medical attention.

                                                                                                        We toasted the death of SATT and I was left with the very strong impression that she was lying about wanting it. Wishful thinking perhaps?

                                                                                                        On my way out, I told her to get in touch if she was ever in my neck of the woods and wanted to see some Shakespeare. She denied any interest in the subject.

                                                                                                        I gave Justin Burland a call and asked if he could help me find out anything about the Asclepius facility. He was able to find out that it was attacked and terrorists were blamed. There was a fire which burned it down and rendered a number of the dead unidentifiable.

                                                                                                        I told him to call me if I could help with anything.

                                                                                                        Three scientists, four security workers, and two children with “conditions” — for which you can read “powers” — were in the facility.

                                                                                                        The children were Klara Zadornova and Ivan Sedonvia. Since father was interested in a girl, I focused my efforts on her.

                                                                                                        I tracked her history first, she is 16, 5’8”, blue eyes, athletic, pale, and had short-cropped, blonde hair.

                                                                                                        She was smuggled into the US from Russia by the Asclepius Institute using back channels. She is said to have illusion powers and was called a witch back home in Russia. Ivan was smuggled in at the same time but he had super strength and illusion. The smuggler’s name is Yegor Lomtev.

                                                                                                        I started hitting up contacts for any sign of someone matching that description who didn’t exist a fortnight ago and found a passport made for someone of that description by a forger that a connection of yours knows. It was remarked on during a online poker game as “such pale girl”. It cost me a pretty penny, but I got a name: Zoya Ovechkina.

                                                                                                        She was booked on a flight to Gatwick landing on Tuesday at 1400 local time. There’s no sign of a connecting flight or hotel booking, so I assume she is going to meet someone and be taken to a safe house.

                                                                                                        It looks like Ivan’s new identity is Gregory Zino but he wasn’t booked on the same flight. As far as I can tell, she is travelling alone.

                                                                                                        Michelle’s team have been aware of someone rescuing people for about 20 years, but they haven’t looked into it too hard in case they spooked them and they stopped. Rumour is that it is usually younger people who were saved this way.

                                                                                                        “About 20 years” is also the amount of time that Morganette has been out doing missions for Father.

                                                                                                        See also:
                                                                                                        • Investigation (Closed): Morganette

                                                                                                        A Weekend Down in France

                                                                                                        Jul 2022

                                                                                                        I had a pleasant weekend with Sam, Michelle, Greg and Aio at Sam’s villa.

                                                                                                        It was nice to get away and Sam was a charming host, with a rather excellent taste in wine.

                                                                                                        He did accidentally drop a revelation about the source of Father’s power, and was highly apologetic about the insult he felt he had given me. I was rather nonplussed — Father’s typical consideration meant I had no idea about the connection between my family and that god.

                                                                                                        There wasn’t a great deal of information exchanged, but we did get Sam and Greg talking, which is a good start. Hopefully they’ll be in a position before too long where Greg is willing to share our concerns about Ptah & Ares and we can have a proper bit of cooperation between the two “sides”.

                                                                                                        See also:

                                                                                                          Identity Games

                                                                                                          Jul 2022

                                                                                                          Disguising myself — the last thing I wanted to do was spook Morganette if she came in person by letting her spot me — to Gatwick to see who Klara Zadornova was going to meet.

                                                                                                          I asked Ophelia to join me as I thought it might be easier for her to approach the girl.

                                                                                                          When I got there we lurked in arrivals as if waiting to meet someone. That’s when we spotted Henry and Mina. I probably looked quite strange the way I was laughing with relief. Of all the scenarios that I’d considered, my sister’s allies being friends of mine wasn’t one of them, but it was better than any of them.

                                                                                                          Once we’d dealt with the little issue of my sister showing Klara my photo and telling her that I’d try to kill her — I’m assuming that was simpler than explaining what I’d really have wanted to do if I were loyal to Father — we went back to Froyle Park and got caught up.

                                                                                                          It seems Mina had been unaware of my sister’s parentage, but had been working with her for a couple of decades. Her coven ran an underground railroad that focused on helping children like Klara escape.

                                                                                                          I agreed to help. It wasn’t really something I needed to think about.

                                                                                                          Mina wasn’t too impressed with her gossiping forger and asked me for a recommendation. I’m going to put her in touch with Madeline.

                                                                                                          Henry took me down to the forge and we had a chat about the spy at SATT. He is convinced Lancelot is innocent — to be honest, I lean in that direction too, the evidence is too convenient — because he is a knight. He wasn’t pleased when I pointed out that my father is also a knight.

                                                                                                          Henry filled me in on what Annabelle Rowland had been up to a century ago ago. Now I have a rather better idea of why some people aren’t fond of SATT.

                                                                                                          He also summoned Aphrodite and told he that we needed to clear the air with Artie. She practically dragged him in by the ear.

                                                                                                          He is not in a good state. His search for Britannia has weakened him, and he’s been neglecting himself physically too. We forced a scone down and Henry insisted he stay the night on the estate and let the maidens feed him.

                                                                                                          The dreams he was having of Henry’s deaths do seem to have stopped, thankfully. I don’t know if he could cope with them given his current state.

                                                                                                          We need to find Britannia soon, or possibly resort to the power-sharing technique I found in Father’s library.

                                                                                                          I took Mina up on her offer to test if I had any affinity for witchcraft, and it seems I do. Channelling power in that way for the first time was like using a long neglected muscle. It was hard work and I was sweating hard afterwards.

                                                                                                          As she fed me and made me drink whiskey to recover, I asked her about Annabelle. If she’s still active then her description might come in useful.

                                                                                                          She gave permission to bring Morganette to the estate. If I can get her out of the castle then that should help convince her I’m on the right side in all of this.

                                                                                                          I started concocting a scheme to get Morganette away from Father so we could have an honest talk. Our first honest talk.

                                                                                                          Father wanted to know who was running Asclepius these days so he can make alliances, so I’m putting together a report. It’s mostly true, albeit unhelpful, with a nice little lie about their security chief being suspicious of Father’s informant inside.

                                                                                                          With luck, he’ll have someone take out the security chief, and I can blame any future spanners I throw in the works on the investigation that was too far advanced for me to stop.

                                                                                                          Since AI was proving rather impenetrable, I spoke to Vanessa about them, claiming an interest due to Michael’s connections to them. Section 6 are being equally unforthcoming about what happened to Asclepius to her as they are to everyone else. She doesn’t seem to know who the new leadership is either, but noted that they seem to be taking much more of an active role in the organisation that Asclepius did.

                                                                                                          She asked me about Maggie and had to cover her reaction when I told her that Maggie was “more than a little fervent about stopping whatever Apep’s loyalists are up to”.

                                                                                                          Vanessa also asked after Artie; I told her that I’d been wanting to talk to him for weeks. I left out the fact I’d seen him this afternoon. He missed their… coffee. The pause she put before “coffee” made me uncomfortable.

                                                                                                          See also:

                                                                                                            Bringing the House Down

                                                                                                            Aug 2022

                                                                                                            After arming ourselves with weapons Henry forged to deal with demons, we made our way to Profane with the intention of scouting it out before tackling Barbatos and friends while also finding out what Llŷr was up to since his schedule showed that he was coming to the the nightclub.

                                                                                                            Ophelia sent her familiar in to see how the place matched with my memories. The layout was roughly the same, but there had been some refurbishment and we got an idea of what was happening in the staff-only areas.

                                                                                                            Strapped to a bed and caged in one of the back rooms was an emaciated, wizened man surrounded by an IV and other medical equipment.

                                                                                                            Henry, Berron and Maggie took a rooftop approach to getting inside (with added cover provided by Maggie taking control of the CCTV), while Ophelia queued up (and then jumped to the front thanks to being pretty) and Alexia and I took the VIP route in thanks to Maggie adding us to the guest list.

                                                                                                            The papers

                                                                                                            The paperwork we saw was in the name of Tod des Schwans (Death of the Swan, hardly a subtle reference from Leda) for a company named Addasu (Welsh for Adaptation; I was able to trace it back to Llŷr) which is publicly involved in transport, transitions, consulting and construction.

                                                                                                            Clearly this was connected to the army.

                                                                                                            Alexia and I spied on Llŷr when he arrived though the candle flame on their table. It was flickery and we didn’t catch everything, but it was clear that Phobos — who met him to discuss Ares’ and Ptah’s scheme — didn’t think highly of his nephew calling him ‘messenger boy’ and telling him that next time they should meet somewhere more professional. He did hand a briefcase over though.

                                                                                                            Naturally, as he was leaving I walked up behind him and gave him a (just too hard to be) friendly slap on the back and insisted he join me for a drink as he’d been in London for weeks without looking me up.

                                                                                                            He wasn’t overjoyed to see Alexia again, nor when I asked him how he was finding Angel either.

                                                                                                            While he was distracted with my chummy-not-chummy act and the glass of whiskey in front of him, I popped open the locks on his briefcase so once he had steadied his nerves and made his excuses to leave (while I was busy inviting myself to his new apartment) the contents spilled over the floor.

                                                                                                            I was surprised to find my stolen gun in there (it would turn out to have sand and dust from Amarna on it). I pocketed it quickly while Alexia and I “helped” gather up the rest of the contents and glanced through the papers.

                                                                                                            There were also a number of crystals I didn’t recognise inside the case, so I pocketed one to get it checked out. (Cabell, a SATT technician, found it hard to identify them. They turned out to be five of the Strifes.)

                                                                                                            Llŷr made a hasty exit after recovering the contents of the case.

                                                                                                            I pocketed his glass.

                                                                                                            While this was going on, the sneaky party had taken up cover in the stairwell and were waiting for an opportunity.

                                                                                                            Unfortunately, a security guard decided to sneak out to the roof for a crafty cigarette and Henry and Berron had to knock them out to avoid being detected. They then pinched their uniforms and substituted themselves for them.

                                                                                                            Meanwhile Ophelia had caught the attention of a man with rust coloured eyes on the dance floor and been invited back to the VIP area where she and Fox joined Kestral.

                                                                                                            Unfortunately the audible effect of the amulet’s Henry and Ophelia wear gave her away and she was quickly escorted upstairs.

                                                                                                            Alexia and I beat a hasty retreat outside for appearances sake, and then portaled inside.

                                                                                                            We had hoped that the weapons Henry had forged would give us an edge, but they seemed to have only evened the playing field.

                                                                                                            The fight did not go well for us, and while we inflicted some injuries on the demons, only Alexia was unscathed by the experience.

                                                                                                            There was quite a lot of damage during the fight, including fridges containing bags of blood and saline. The blood was probably intended for production of the kevlar.

                                                                                                            The saline, it should be noted, appears to have been quite effective against the demons.

                                                                                                            Unfortunately, Henry lost control after hearing the Ophelia had been injured and went into a berserker rage. He threw Fox (who had shapeshifted into the form of his namesake) into a rack of vials which he had recognised as containing Dr. Jekyll’s Formula. Unable to control himself, he went for the formula and drank it.

                                                                                                            Ophelia called for a retreat, and we dove through her portal. Berron with some… urging from Maggie, and Henry (his body distorting under the effects of the formula) not at all.

                                                                                                            Back at Froyle Park, Berron stormed off.

                                                                                                            I followed Ophelia and Mina into Aphrodite’s temple and shortly after, Henry resurrected there.

                                                                                                            Meanwhile we were getting reports that the nightclub had caught fire, and Maggie showed us what was on the CCTV in the area to supplement the TV news.

                                                                                                            Nobody had been killed, according to the reports, but there were ambulances and fire engines on the scene.

                                                                                                            Barbatos was on the scene, looking very angry, with Falcon and Wolf by his side. Wolf appeared to be making a vow of vengeance.

                                                                                                            There was no sign of Kestral.

                                                                                                            CCTV shows Fox decapitated inside the building.

                                                                                                            The prisoner had been cursed when the ceiling fell in. His expression suggested he was happy in his release.

                                                                                                            Since Henry was back and safe, to much relief. I’d discover later that, with Aphrodite’s power stretched very thin at present, there was a possibility he wouldn’t have returned.

                                                                                                            It was at that point the penny dropped and I realised that Berron was heading in the direction of the cottages. Henry raced there to try to beat him to them, he seemed to be on a mindless rampage so we hoped to be fast enough.

                                                                                                            Sadly, it was not to be as we got there just in time to see Artie racing out in full armour to defend himself from the intruder.

                                                                                                            Berron was… not happy. Artie wasn’t too impressed either.

                                                                                                            We took a Land Rover back to the main house. Henry telling me along the way that Aprodite had agreed to let the rest of the team know what we had discussed when we met with her at that meeting and that he was going to tell them whether I agreed or not.

                                                                                                            He didn’t seem to grasp just how much pain he would have been in if he had tried telling them without my agreement, so it is a good thing I was happy to let them in on the secret.

                                                                                                            Berron’s reaction was anger at not having been told. It wasn’t helped that Henry and I aren’t among the people he likes best, but he didn’t seem to grasp what we were saying when we tried to explain that the blood oath prevented us from telling him anything.

                                                                                                            Maggie took Aphrodite’s caution about not letting other Gods know about the problem to extremes and managed to offend Berron further by implying that Freya was untrustworthy.

                                                                                                            It was all a big mess. Alexia took Berron home, and the rest of us spent the night at the estate.

                                                                                                            See also:
                                                                                                            • Family in the Light

                                                                                                            Family in the Light

                                                                                                            Aug 2022

                                                                                                            I thought I was an early riser, but it seems Henry has me beat. He woke me shortly after dawn for breakfast and to tell me about his problems with Berron.

                                                                                                            Last night seemed to be the final straw with the problems between them, he’d damaged the grounds and carved some nasty gashes into some trees with his axe.

                                                                                                            Henry had decided that he would have to ban Berron from the estate, and would only work with him at SATT under sufferance. When I asked, he said he didn’t know what he would do about the axe tattoo that signified his debt to Berron.

                                                                                                            After breakfast I headed to SATT (via Boots to pick up a swab for my mouth) and dropped the DNA sample and the crystal off for testing.

                                                                                                            Then I collected the file of data from The Asclepius Institute with my own little additions and headed to see father.

                                                                                                            Morganette was in an even worse state than last time I saw her and father was entertaining himself by watching Happy beat her up in the training area.

                                                                                                            I told him that I’d only prepared a preliminary report because there were a couple of matters I thought urgent enough to bring him before I’d got real answers to what he wanted to know. I blamed the “heightened security” that Morganette had lied about on the security chief catching wind of financial irregularities with father’s spy and suggested he get rid of Prime Advisors Inc to stop any trace getting back to him.

                                                                                                            I’d hoped he’d send me to take out said security chief, as it would have given me a chance to plant some evidence for Asclepius to find and hopefully crush any of Father’s plans for an alliance, but it was not to be.

                                                                                                            Instead, I suggested I take Morganette back with me so I could give her a refresher course on intelligence gathering. You can imagine how pleased she was about that!

                                                                                                            We took the train two stops away from Mordred Court. I didn’t want to park close enough for the attendants to interfere with my car.

                                                                                                            Knowing she was unlikely to believe anything I told her, I suggested Morganette take a look at the copy of the report I’d stashed underneath the passenger seat and told her there was a bottle of water and some paracetamol in the glove compartment. Seeing her I rather wished I’d stuck some Co-codamol there instead, but she was too suspicious to take it anyway.

                                                                                                            I drove out to the estate where Mina was waiting for us. Unsurprisingly Morganette took this as a threat to her friend and put a knife to my throat.

                                                                                                            I relaxed and let Mina deal with Metty — my sister has a cute nickname! — who told her to stop being silly, put the knife down, and let her take a look at those wounds.

                                                                                                            We exchanged some stories in the kitchen before Mina put her to bed to rest.

                                                                                                            I headed off to deal with Berron making a couple of stops along the way.

                                                                                                            I didn’t know how my uncle would react so I thought it best to go along with as many approaches at hand as possible.

                                                                                                            A visit to the temple was first, I wanted permission to act as Aphrodite’s emissary if I thought it would help bring Berron around.

                                                                                                            She seemed delighted that I would ask and didn’t hesitate in allowing me. She explained that he came very close to damaging some trees belonging to Dryads that Aprodite had given sanctuary to — if those had been the trees he had hurt then she would have had no choice but to kill him.

                                                                                                            My next stop was home. I wanted to see Michelle and catch her up on some of the news. I told her that I thought it was my turn to try to get through to Berron — every time they have this sort of discussion they seem to come away with bruises and limps but it hasn’t seemed to have changed his approach so I wanted to try something different — but she offered to be nearby.

                                                                                                            I asked her not to be, last time I offended Berron he threatened me with his einherjar, and if I was going to tell him he was being disproportionate again it would have been hypocritical to have the love of my life standing by as backup.

                                                                                                            I did ask what she knew about them. I didn’t fancy my chances of getting away without bloodshed if Berron turned nasty and I was outnumbered, and hoped that I might be able to reason with them directly or call on their honour to have them stay out of things. It was not to be, as far as she knows they are unswervingly loyal to him.

                                                                                                            Going to Alexia’s home, I asked him to join me in a nearby park so that we wouldn’t disturb Alexia.

                                                                                                            It was the strangest conversation I’d ever had with him. He was subdued and clammed up entirely. No threats. No shouting. No openings for me get him to see he had done wrong.

                                                                                                            I offered him any help I could, but he only said that he needed to talk to Greg.

                                                                                                            I ended up saying almost nothing I had intended to say as it would have just been a lecture and not a conversation, and I didn’t think that would have helped.

                                                                                                            Afterwards we went out separate ways. Whatever is up with him and moved to a new phase, and I don’t understand it.

                                                                                                            I got up early again and headed back to the Froyle Park for breakfast and to see how my sister was doing. She seemed much improved, although still not used to the idea that I’m not her enemy. The expressions that flashed across her face when I asked for the butter were a delight as they went though “How do I poison this?” to “I don’t need to poison this!” to “Everyone just saw me plotting to poison this!!”.

                                                                                                            I’d been thinking about Henry’s scheme to blow up the portal at Amarna and had a few suggestions. Probably for the best as he didn’t seem to have twigged that the plane he’d picked out took a four man crew.

                                                                                                            I suggested an upgrade to a Tupolev Tu-160 since I thought Dmitriy Pushkin would be amenable to a bribe in exchange for losing one for a few days and being able to hit Mach 2 would help us get in and out without being detected. Having the hardware for air to ground missiles would be rather helpful too.

                                                                                                            Somehow we got to talking about how Henry hadn’t been flying since they still held planes together with chicken wire and I introduced him to the concept of a flight simulator. I’m going to have to have a word with Helen about setting up a system for one somewhere in the house.

                                                                                                            I suggested we ask Michelle along since the plane took a crew of four, which led to a conversation about how I have a girlfriend. Morganette was delighted to tease me about it. She was even more delighted when she found out that Michelle was The Thief that father still rages about from time to time.

                                                                                                            Mina invited the two of us to come to the estate for the weekend. It’ll be a nice break, and she can be filled in on some of the news.

                                                                                                            Then we got to talking about Berron and Ophelia let slip just enough information that I had to tell Metty (Metty!) about Artie. It was something I’d been planning to hold back until she was a bit more used to the idea of me being a good guy, but that was not to be.

                                                                                                            Henry went to get the whiskey.

                                                                                                            I rolled into my increasingly regular complaint about how writing a thesis on Comparative Mythology: Warrior Kings of Europe is really annoying when you can’t reference primary sources because nobody would believe you.

                                                                                                            And then I had to explain about the Doctorate I was working towards.

                                                                                                            And then she explained about the one she was working on at Leiden University. About materials used in space engineering. Wow.

                                                                                                            Later I went into the office. Frankie came by with the results of the DNA test, Llŷr ap Leda is my half-brother. Oh how lovely. Still, after what happened at Profane, I think I know which buttons to push which might get him to turn on his mother.

                                                                                                            Frankie was also worried about how things were going at SATT these days, I tried to reassure her. One thing she did mention was that doors were appearing and disappearing. I told her that I knew there were a few secure areas which were hidden for protection and asked her to show me where these doors were so I could get them checked on.

                                                                                                            One was Artie’s office. The other by next to the first floor gym, one I didn’t know about. I got in touch with Henry and we raised the issue with Aphrodite who said she only provided power and that she had no control over “doors”. Most of the power is being sent to SATT’s “heart”, whatever that means. Artie has no idea.

                                                                                                            The heart? I thought that SATT drew its powers directly from Britannia? So I’m as much in the dark as you.

                                                                                                            — Artie.

                                                                                                            It bears further investigation. If it is anything like the door to Artie’s private office, then it is more akin to a portal than a door. Just bashing our way through the wall is unlikely to be successful.

                                                                                                            I’ll ask Maggie to set up surveillance and Ophelia to see if she can brew up some kind of revelation or opening potion to get us inside.

                                                                                                            See also:

                                                                                                              Eternal Shadow

                                                                                                              Aug 2022

                                                                                                              Berron has left us. He rejected my attempts to help last night and would only say that he needed to speak to Greg. That was the last time I saw him. Today he wasn’t part of the team.

                                                                                                              Family.

                                                                                                              Henry and I met Whisper for training.

                                                                                                              I say /training/, but I mean /interrogation about her presence at numerous acts harmful to SATT/.

                                                                                                              Henry was convinced of her innocence. He was a great believer in the knightly code. I’m too cynical to trust people simply because they had sworn an oath to uphold the duties of a knight. Not when I’ve had my father as an example for my whole life. However, it did seem too convenient.

                                                                                                              The ladies were lurking in the corridor, largely so that if things went pear-shaped we’d have backup. Whisper was delayed getting into the training room by being unable to resist flirting with each of them.

                                                                                                              Greg was with us, and Whisper none too pleased to see him. This was always going to be the sticking point, she liked the idea of not having to hold back because we knew who she was and Greg … wasn’t supposed to.

                                                                                                              We started to spar, and Henry brought the issue up. When we got to the difficult part, the training stopped. Henry told Whisper that he didn’t think she was innocent, and I said that things were looking so suspicious that I thought it was a set up, but would still like to hear it from her.

                                                                                                              Greg being a human lie-detector can be so useful. Whisper, not knowing him, assumed that he was behind our questioning, so I stepped in and insisting it was my idea.

                                                                                                              It was about then that Greg quietly pointed out that there was something odd about her shadow. Since I knew what to look for, I was able to see it too.

                                                                                                              I quietly retrieved Kladenets and stepped around behind Whisper. Then cut the shadow away from her.

                                                                                                              It didn’t seem to like that, and fled towards the mirror.

                                                                                                              Whisper was stunned. Greg smashed the mirror. Maggie kill the lights. The shadow split into 7 and we each found ourselves facing our worst nightmares. There was an odd smell of applies.

                                                                                                              Alexia identified the creature as Eris, although we later discovered it was Algea, her daughter. That explained a lot, up until the split I had assumed it was my brother.

                                                                                                              I cut the shadow of my father down. My sword felt like it was sticking in the creature.

                                                                                                              Ordinary weapons proved ineffective against the shadows, but Kladenets, fire (they shrunk back from the large portal Alexia conjured) and lightning saw them off with ease.

                                                                                                              Ophelia trapped the last one in a lightning cage, from there it tried to demoralise us with just parlour tricks as taking Artie’s form and telling us that every moment of sadness was a prayer to them.

                                                                                                              It told us that ever since Lancelot had dared to make a bargain with Ares to have time to act as he wished each century Eris had dispatched one of her children to be with Lancelot whenever they were off by themselves.

                                                                                                              Lancelot was horrified, and the creature grew stronger from his pain. We surrounded him with reassurance and love. He enjoyed Ophelia’s kisses and was both delighted by and horrified by Henry’s.

                                                                                                              Overwhelmed by positive emotions, Algea shrank and turned into a crystal.

                                                                                                              Recognising the crystal, I took Greg up to the lab and got it back from Cabell. He was somewhat disturbed by the thought he had been caressing a demi-god. We thought it best not to ask why he was caressing the crystal in the first place.

                                                                                                              There was a piece chipped off that had been sent to Professor Elsie Scott at the Natural History Museum. Greg went to retrieve it.

                                                                                                              We dropped the two crystals in lead lined boxes that Henry produced on SATT’s forge and gave them into the keeping of Poseidon to be deposited in the ocean.

                                                                                                              Then it was time to deal with the mystery door. Henry and Ophelia — with their connection to Aprodite and affinity to portals — explored the power around the door and a window appeared and revealed a glowing sword in a piece of stone.

                                                                                                              I had wondered what had happened to that. Artie seems to have lost more than his share of swords over the centuries.

                                                                                                              Then we took Whisper to the pub since I thought she could still do with some cheering up.
