                                                                                                                The Fête of Watling

                                                                                                                Aug 2022

                                                                                                                The village square had been done up with astonishing amounts of bunting and Ophelia had been working her magic, probably literally, on the roses.

                                                                                                                Henry gave an opening speech, and awarded the prizes for the jam contest — which I assured Henry would be no challenge for me, and then promptly dodged in a suitable revenge for his unleashing the W.I. on me a few weeks ago — to the delight of the winner. The runner up did not take the loss well, to Penelope’s pleasure.

                                                                                                                While we entertained ourselves I became aware of an unusually large number of young mothers (complete with infants). This was explained when Maggie found some almost pornographic footage of Henry on Mumsnet.

                                                                                                                It appeared to have been shot from a video doorbell that really should have been angled so it didn’t film off Mina’s neighbour’s property.

                                                                                                                We were interrupted by a call from Sally to tell us that there were reports of zombies rising on the underground, in the same location that they had done in a previous case that SATT had — before my time — dealt with.

                                                                                                                I was distracted from this by Michelle, who came up and kissed me. It was just like the first time. Which was odd. We’ve become much more practised of late. I followed her and then spotted Michelle elsewhere in the crowd… at which point I lost track of the duplicate.

                                                                                                                Mina went over to Henry, but she was dressed differently too.

                                                                                                                Then Artie called; ghosts had risen in the museum of London… again.

                                                                                                                The past was coming back to haunt us.

                                                                                                                Then I received a call from Morganette’s burner. Happy had started acting like father’s ideal version of himself… and my and my sister’s nightmare. This was different.

                                                                                                                William Shakespeare — a good friend of Ophelia’s — was reported causing an disturbance at the Globe theatre.

                                                                                                                At this point we picked a direction and went to investigate: The Globe.

                                                                                                                We split up. Alexia and I went into the auditorium to find Berron lounging, and looking more fey-like than ever. Alexia rejected him completely — clearly when he quit the team he did some damage to their relationship — and it tried to tempt me into taking over Unseelie with him.

                                                                                                                It was quite an offer, but hardly my style.

                                                                                                                Afterwards, he disappeared in a puff of smoke.

                                                                                                                Meanwhile Michael was offering Maggie her human form back and, in search of answers, she took his hand and disappeared.

                                                                                                                We returned to SATT and Maggie rejoined us. She had escaped via her sanctum.

                                                                                                                The place she had been taken to was a dark void, with whispering. Henry recognised it as the place where he had encountered False Mary.

                                                                                                                The beings who life there desire entertainment. They live on the stories of the people who arrive in their voice. False Mary was different, she wanted to feed on Henry’s pain.

                                                                                                                SATT was, however, under a psychic attack.

                                                                                                                Maggie was able to find out a great deal of useful information about these creates including a summon spell.

                                                                                                                We headed to the basement where SATT has a triple circle and I led a summoning for Aldarial. It went surprisingly well. I seems I have a knack for this type of magic.

                                                                                                                He was less than pleased to have been summoned and gave me little in the way of respect. He had been the last of his kind left in their home.

                                                                                                                Aldarial recognised Henry as “the who who gave her enough power to escape”.

                                                                                                                He told us that Arkgila had broken away from the pact, and that Meluuran had been summoned by a sorcerer.

                                                                                                                Henry asked about Mary but Aldarial claimed to be forbidden to speak of where she had gone after the void.

                                                                                                                Aldarial could sense where his sister was so — after extracting a vow that Aldarial would depart after an evening of stories — I released him from the circle and we went hunting.

                                                                                                                As we left SATT we were confronted by a duplicate of Taranis, followed up by Mina joining him in an embrace, and then Metty arriving in a bruised and beaten state. It was easy to ignore the lies now we’d had a little experience of them.

                                                                                                                We were led towards Westminster — briefly sidetracked by Henry introducing Aldarial to the concept of reading, writing and the preservation of stories — before going into the underground shopping mall by Charing Cross station.

                                                                                                                Mad World had closed down that branch and reopened in Kentish Town a couple of years previously, so we were spared a confrontation with killer clowns.

                                                                                                                We went into a shop that was rented out to Konstaninos, who used to run one of the gangs the Colani had absorbed in their expansion.

                                                                                                                Meluuran was trapped, in agony, in a summoning circle — similar to the one Maggie had seen at Profane — filled with fire and cold. After extracting a similar promise to the one Aldarial gave, Alexia and I freed her from it.

                                                                                                                The Lieutenant had summoned her and forced her to send our nightmares against us — although it took her a while to tune into us properly — and take us to the void.

                                                                                                                It would have been and effective way to get rid of us, if it had worked. It seems that the Lieutenant definitely knows we are onto her though.

                                                                                                                Back in front of a nice fire, Henry told the pair his life story. We could see them looking better with each word. Feeding of stories seems quite literal in their case.

                                                                                                                I let Metty know that the Happy problem was resolved; she reported that he’d emerged from his room and claimed he’d been in there all afternoon, oblivious to what was going on elsewhere in the castle.

                                                                                                                See also:

                                                                                                                  Metty’s Release

                                                                                                                  Aug 2022

                                                                                                                  Henry and I had a catch up with Artie. He’s looking a lot better now that Aphrodite has some support for providing power to SATT and Helen is making him eat properly.

                                                                                                                  I noticed that the photograph of Vanessa was less prominent than is was last time I was in his office.

                                                                                                                  Henry and I told him about Metty “infiltrating” the template of Aphrodite and that I was going to pay father another visit to help her spin the lie.

                                                                                                                  We talked about what I should mention about the goings on at SATT to father, and decided I’d focus on Berron leaving and it having shaken the rest of the team.

                                                                                                                  I not sure how the conversation got around to it — probably Henry trying to give a lesson in keeping a low profile — but I might have mentioned the phrase hashtag diet coke hottie leading Artie and Patrizia to quickly find the video.

                                                                                                                  There is a little joy to be had in moments like this.

                                                                                                                  I arrived at the castle to find father in conversation with a priestess — she had an English accent; very R.P. — I didn’t recognise, she was saying something about the training being almost complete.

                                                                                                                  With clear disgust at having to do so I grudgingly admitted that Morganette’s “scheme” with Aphrodite’s priestess might bear fruit, and that the international reach of the organisation could impart knowledge I couldn’t get at SATT.

                                                                                                                  Besides, it wouldn’t be a great loss if it all went wrong and she was found out, would it?

                                                                                                                  She kept me waiting on the other side of the London portal for an hour, and we bitched at each other for the attendant acolyte to collect some useless but juicy gossip to report back when she did come through.

                                                                                                                  We returned to the estate, relaxing with each passing mile.

                                                                                                                  At the end Metty actually hugged me.

                                                                                                                  She did mention that father’s weapon production efforts were increasing. I really want to know what he is plotting.

                                                                                                                  Ophelia is researching a potion to let me make a memory visible. If it works, it’ll get a better image of the priestess that I could create with photofit — my backup plan — and we can see if we can identify her once I get that going.

                                                                                                                  Henry and I finally had that training session with Whisper. I was having an off-day and they beat each other to a standstill. We then were a little persistent until she finally caved and agreed to talk to Artie.

                                                                                                                  They were both very nervous, so we left them to it in the end. Not, however, before I threw the name Ivan Tsarevich at him and was pleased to get a reaction.

                                                                                                                  See also:
                                                                                                                  • Mordred’s Tribute

                                                                                                                  Cossack Graves

                                                                                                                  Sep 2022

                                                                                                                  I’ve been asked, via UCL, to verify a sword as a number have turned up quite out of place.

                                                                                                                  A grave site, previously thought to have been filled with Cossack warriors is being re-examined and has swords of a very expected style.

                                                                                                                  I’m opening a file to track what I’ve found out.

                                                                                                                  See also:

                                                                                                                    Meeting Michael

                                                                                                                    Sep 2022

                                                                                                                    Maggie asked me to give her a hand with figuring out what Michael is up to.

                                                                                                                    I “coincidentally” spotted Maggie having tea with him at Selfridges and invited myself to join them. Maggie introduced him as Timothy and I repeatedly “forgot” the alias.

                                                                                                                    I littered the conversation with suggestions that Maggie was scheming things, and I was more interested in mutual back rubbing that informing SATT about her activities.

                                                                                                                    After excusing himself to make a phone call he came back rather friendlier towards me.

                                                                                                                    I’m starting to think that I need to be making more of an effort to support Father’s view of me among certain quarters in London if people like Michel have to make calls to work out who I am.

                                                                                                                    I left before much longer to allow him and Maggie some time without be hovering. He did give me his business card: Blank aside from a UK mobile number and the seal of the Phoenix Library.

                                                                                                                    When I saw her again later, Maggie showed me a letter that he had given her:

                                                                                                                    Wood,

                                                                                                                    Ah yes I see now who I am dealing with, Well sir if you will not conduct yourself honourably I have no choice but to carry on building “My monstrosity as you put it, If oxford is to be a town of education then it needs knowledge, I am building a tower for books sir and I will be providing 2 scholarships for the townspeople you “merchants” had forgotten all about,

                                                                                                                    In the interests of civility I would suggest you contact me no more

                                                                                                                    Lord Henry Watling

                                                                                                                    What his interest is in Henry, and why he might want us to know about it for, is a mystery.

                                                                                                                    I did some digging using what I knew about Henry at the time the letter was written.

                                                                                                                    The Joan Crosbie scholarship award is given to two people of Oxford from low income families to go to any Oxford College that will accept them. It is awarded by the Rogers Library (a private library) that was founded around 1615. The myth goes that the Lord who bought the land the library was built on and set up the endowment to fund the scholarship only did so to anger a member of St. John’s College.

                                                                                                                    See also:

                                                                                                                      Deptford Amazons

                                                                                                                      Sep 2022

                                                                                                                      Continuing the investigation into the Cossack grave site, we went to visit the expert Sally recommended.

                                                                                                                      The receptionist was 6’ tall with her hair hair tied back in tight ponytail and had body language of a guard. We were in the right place. In the background, we could hear someone singing a song.

                                                                                                                      We were introduced to Kallah and explained what we were looking for. She mentioned that she hadn’t seen Tulip warriors in a while, and told us a little of them.

                                                                                                                      The Seers (“those who give us messages from the Gods”) asked Kallah to give Alexia a gift. Roxanne, the Amazon’s Seer, has seen that a wren will be very important to her.

                                                                                                                      This was shortly followed by a message arriving through an old-style pneumatic tube saying that “The seer has seen the wren burning to ash or ash covering the wren: It is very rare to have a second vision on same subject.

                                                                                                                      It was at this point that Henry — who I really wish would read the reports I file — decided to tell us that he knew pretty much everything about the situation already as he had been heavily involved back in 1531.

                                                                                                                      On the way out, a short, elderly woman (who we learned as Roxan) came up to me and told me to “Choose the right sword at the right time” before fainting into my arms. This seems to be something of a regular occurrence, to judge from the reactions of the other people there.

                                                                                                                      See also:

                                                                                                                        Bulgarian Dig

                                                                                                                        Sep 2022

                                                                                                                        Continuing the investigation into the Cossack grave site, we went to visit the site itself.

                                                                                                                        When we arrived in Bulgaria, we were met by Julian, a student from the dig studying at New Bulgarian University (which is ranked second in the country). He was born in ’98. How did they get so young?

                                                                                                                        We met Dr. Menston Enstine and had a look around.

                                                                                                                        Henry had to explain to some students that the pots they had found were for cooking, not auguries.

                                                                                                                        It was clear that a lot of money being throw at the dig, especially considering the number of people present there but tracing it turned out to be difficult. The Head of Bequests is Kewin Gajewski, and we found a lot of money being funnelled into the university from people who appeared to not exist (such as fake uncles of genuine former students). The funds eventually traced back to shell corporations and we lost the trail there. I couldn’t see a connection to anyone I knew though (such as the shell corps I know my father controls, or Llŷr).

                                                                                                                        We speculated that perhaps Bevo, goddess of knowledge, was doing the funding?

                                                                                                                        We took a look at the mound. There had been erosion since Henry’s last visit. The entrance, which was on the north-east, had a splatter of two day old blood from an arterial spray on it.

                                                                                                                        We’d been invited to dinner at Enstine’s home but decided to have a drink at the local pub first.

                                                                                                                        The Landlord was happy to have someone in the party who spoke Russian, and we drank vodka. He mentioned that there were evil spirits near the dig and made the sign of the cross.

                                                                                                                        We overheard one of the townsfolk singing the song of Zasha in Russian.

                                                                                                                        Local legend says that Zasha was the right arm of Bevo. They didn’t believe she would be involved with the mound except to defend them from it. She is still remembered in song.

                                                                                                                        The mound was built by the Persians who created it as a labyrinth and kill zone to trap and kill Romans in. The Bulgars lived there and also used it as a kill zone. He said it is “Filled with death. Nothing by death comes from there.”

                                                                                                                        A gentleman, who I would later learn was Viktor Yahontov, was in, downed a vodka and left. He set off Ophelia’s sense of an unnatural relationship with death.

                                                                                                                        We were entertained at dinner by Eskin and his wife, Dayar (who spent the whole evening flirting in my direction). They were able to afford a cook, which speaks again to the level of funding he was getting for this project.

                                                                                                                        Greg was mentioned in passing and his reaction was initially derogatory before he realised the benfits of a possible connection, and his greed took over.

                                                                                                                        Henry snuck off to talk recipes and local legends with the cook.

                                                                                                                        Later that night, outside the hotel, we realised we were being watched from the roof. I slipped up quietly and found a bestial vampire — a young girl and not one of the missing students — preparing to strike. Just as she began to leap for Alexia and Maggie, I beheaded her. Alexia burned the remains.

                                                                                                                        We had a look around the mound again, but nobody followed us and we were left in peace.

                                                                                                                        The next morning, our welcome was rather colder. Enstine was brusk and wanted to take what we could contribute and get rid of us. He claimed the university was unhappy with number of outsiders.

                                                                                                                        Before we left, we summoned Bevo. She arrived via a portal with a Tulip Guard, Iselin, who was descended from Zasha.

                                                                                                                        We explained the situation.

                                                                                                                        Bevo told us that she doesn’t fund the university and they do not pray to her.

                                                                                                                        Henry asked after the tulip guard and Zasha and we learned that the guard had rescued Bevo from “the attack”. Bevo was best upon by what seemed like hundreds but they defended her. Quite a few lost their lives in the process. The attackers wore black armour and swords; she thinks they were of Ares and that she had done something to offend him.

                                                                                                                        I mentioned that Ares seemed to be planning something and Bevo said that she and the Tulips (who now number 200) will stand against Ares if he is on the move again. She gave us each a magic stone to communicate with her and said she wishes to be there when we try to defeat Ares.

                                                                                                                        On the flight home we had a shared vision; A wren on mound of ash, the bird flies through the ash and emerges as statue of wren.

                                                                                                                        See also:

                                                                                                                          Veiled Threats by Electronic Mail

                                                                                                                          Sep 2022

                                                                                                                          I had an email waiting for me when I checked my university account. It was from V@cam.ac.uk and read:

                                                                                                                          Mr Red

                                                                                                                          Forgive me my forwardness as we have not been introduced but I think it pertinent to warn you that certain interested parties are very unhappy with the events that have occurred in Bulgaria.

                                                                                                                          I would suggest that you take more precautions next time.

                                                                                                                          A concerned friend

                                                                                                                          V

                                                                                                                          The account it was sent from belongs to the role of The Traditional Librarian of King’s College, Cambridge. They are identified by a KC with a V seal and get a stipend of 1 bushel of corn a quarter which is donated to the local animal sanctuary. Word in the corridors is that any librarian that wants to have gravitas uses that address.

                                                                                                                          When I checked the headers of the email itself, and begged a favour from an friendly systems administrator, I found it originated from a computer in Grey Collage Library, Durham.

                                                                                                                          There hadn’t been much effort to hide the source.

                                                                                                                          It is probably jumping to conclusions to take this information and the financial shenanigans we were looking into in Bulgaria and come up with an international vampire conspiracy hiding in academia, but I’m putting it on a list of way out there theories.

                                                                                                                          Since I don’t particularly like veiled threats / warnings from anonymous “friends”, resolved to drive up to Durham in the morning and spend some time in Grey’s library, making sure that the librarians there know who I am. My SCONUL card is going to get a workout. They’ve got an extensive Middle East and Islamic Studies collection there which I’d quite like a poke at; it would be interesting to see if I can find any records of when Henry and the Tulip guard raided the palace for flowers.

                                                                                                                          I asked Ophelia to join me, since her ability to spot something off about vampires is likely to come in handy when I try to identify the right librarian there. This soon turned into a team expedition. We’re going to have to take two cars.

                                                                                                                          Since I might need to make a point about why we interfered, I’ve printed out the missing person reports for the students who disappeared from the dig site.

                                                                                                                          See also:

                                                                                                                            Better Location Tracking Through Potions

                                                                                                                            Sep 2022

                                                                                                                            Ophelia was less than pleased with my report on the Joan Crosbie scholarship: apparently she still hadn’t braced Henry for it (anything relating to Joan is still somewhat traumatic for him). I had thought she was going to do that on the way back from Bulgaria, but apparently not.

                                                                                                                            I apologised and we moved on.

                                                                                                                            Starting with the memory potion, which was applied to camera (so why she was worried about the taste, I don’t know, maybe she just wanted me to go cake shopping for her).

                                                                                                                            As I brought to mind the image of my memory of the throne room, she released the shutter and captured an image. It seems my mind had drifted a little and the fellow the inn in Bulgaria was in the background.

                                                                                                                            I cropped father’s priestess out of the image and sent her to Maggie. That was a dud, it was like she had never been on Midguard. Which is information, but not as helpful as I was hoping for.

                                                                                                                            We moved on to trying to locate Parmtilir. Since the only map I had in my office was the one of 16th Century Europe, we headed to the library to raid Maggie’s collection.

                                                                                                                            The crystal Ophelia was using over over the map, spun around it a few times, and then shot across the room to embed itself in a picture of Yggdrasil. This is going to be trickier than we thought. There are lots of realms that he could be in, and a distinct lack of good maps of all of them.

                                                                                                                            I showed the picture of the vampire to Michelle. She was concerned, his name is Viktor Yahontov and he is a big player in the Baltic and Russia. She did say he is fairly civilised, so I’m planning to arrange a respectful meeting with him later in the week.

                                                                                                                            See also:
                                                                                                                            • Bulgarian Dig

                                                                                                                            Durham

                                                                                                                            Sep 2022

                                                                                                                            I had a feeling that tracing that email account was too easy, and I was soon going to learn that I was right.

                                                                                                                            We’d arrived in Durham and I entertained myself by looking up other people’s records of what Henry had been up to in 1531. He appears to have kicked off a century of Cossacks raiding both the Russians and the Turks with each side accusing the other of hiring the raiders. Not one to do things by halves is our Henry.

                                                                                                                            Then we noticed we were being watched by a thin, youngish gangly man who appeared to be in his early to mid-20s… and someone hacked into our comms. Maggie was not best pleased.

                                                                                                                            See also:
                                                                                                                            • Team Meeting

                                                                                                                            Ash Barrow

                                                                                                                            Sep 2022

                                                                                                                            Few days scouting.

                                                                                                                            Tuesday night we penetrate it.

                                                                                                                            Friday talking to Artie.

                                                                                                                            See also:

                                                                                                                              The Crystal Casket

                                                                                                                              Sep 2022

                                                                                                                              Having located Britannia we needed a plan to rescue her. Maggie’s eye in the sky had revealed that Jade seemed to have stepped up security, which might be an issue.

                                                                                                                              There was also the issue of Artie, I refused to keep him in the dark any longer. He’s been running himself ragged looking for Britannia for months and we can’t keep the fact we’ve found her from him.
