                                                                                                                              Happy Comes To Dinner

                                                                                                                              Oct 2022

                                                                                                                              Last night did not go according to plan.

                                                                                                                              Freya arrived first, and she and I made awkward small talk while Michelle hid in the kitchen.

                                                                                                                              The party from Froyle Park arrived next; but it seems that Maggie had managed to lure Artie away from the Crystal Casket without using my suggestion that she tell him Freya would be expecting him.

                                                                                                                              Rabbit. Headlights.

                                                                                                                              That’s when it struck me that he’d been avoiding her as much as the rest of us for the last several months while he was hunting for Britannia. Things got awkward.

                                                                                                                              Nate was last to arrive, just as I was starting to think I should have timed things to be ready a bit later, and gave every appearance of being drunk. It wasn’t entirely an act, but he was exaggerating and I’ve no idea if he was trying to embarrass Michelle or had some other purpose. Words will need to be had.

                                                                                                                              He recognised Mina.

                                                                                                                              It turns out, though one of those very strange coincidence, that Michelle’s Nate and Mina’s Nathaniel are one and the same.

                                                                                                                              Things between Freya and Artie peaked shortly before the cheese course and they made they excuses and disappeared.

                                                                                                                              And it was shortly after then that Ziczzisisieieistsi warning me that there was some trouble down the street.

                                                                                                                              While I was trying to excuse myself to take a look Michelle and I became in need of a glazer as my brother came crashing through the window. Trouble had arrived.

                                                                                                                              Nate found this hilarious.

                                                                                                                              After a brief exchange where I tried to get a sitrep from Happy, the two of us went out to fight the Fomorian that had been pursuing him.

                                                                                                                              After I dropped the creature and my brother finished it off with a sword blade through an eye, and Henry summoned a clean-up crew from SATT, we returned inside for some awkward conversation.

                                                                                                                              After the others left Michelle and I packed Happy off to the spare room, warned each other to be careful, and headed off to bed. Tomorrow would be a day to get some answers.

                                                                                                                              See also:

                                                                                                                                The Happy House Guest

                                                                                                                                Oct 2022

                                                                                                                                Things I did not expect to be happening this year: Having my brother as a house guest.

                                                                                                                                I got up early so I could steal his clothes, under the pretence of cleaning the remains of the Fomorian off them. Since I’m not a monster, I emptied the pockets before throwing them into the washing machine.

                                                                                                                                The contents revealed that he uses the alias Drystan Morganstern. Curious.

                                                                                                                                As far as I could trace his movements, he took a direct root from Milton Keynes to London, crossed by the Tube to Waterloo and then walked to my place and was attacked by the creature en route.

                                                                                                                                I sent a message to Metty to warn her about him being in the area. She thinks Father sent him to check up on us; it wouldn’t surprise me to learn she was right.

                                                                                                                                Patrizia wants a report on the case. I said I’d file one after I’d got Mordred’s side of the story.

                                                                                                                                The autopsy results were interesting. The Fomorian was finished off my Happy’s blow to its eye but was severely weakened by poison: arsenic trioxide, natron and realgar. The creature had ingested it a couple of hours before he died.

                                                                                                                                Ophelia and Mina say this is a very ancient poison, common to Late-Roman Egypt.

                                                                                                                                Henry and Ophelia were quite willing to help me hide my brother’s presence from SATT. It took some convincing that that would be a terrible course of action.

                                                                                                                                He knows that my “cover” as a SATT agent means I’m supposed to mention him in the report. He knows that with another SATT agent on site, there’s no reasonable way I could hide him from the report. Inventing a reason for a Fomorian to end up dead in Lambeth is just completely unnecessary.

                                                                                                                                I asked Henry and Ophelia to remember that Metty was supposed to be just the newest recruit to the Maidens: Having her secret revealed to all and sundry would make her claiming she was undercover rather difficult. And that goes double while Happy is in town.

                                                                                                                                Unfortunately, getting him out of the house didn’t get him to talk particularly freely. I’ve no idea what he real purpose in coming to see me was, other then the suspicion that he was checking up on me for father.

                                                                                                                                See also:

                                                                                                                                  Oxford Camera

                                                                                                                                  Oct 2022

                                                                                                                                  The public are being let onto the estate again. Henry has added swipe cards to to provide access to the private areas.

                                                                                                                                  I arrived early so I could have a quiet talk with Metty. We went out to Winston’s field for some privacy and so I could bribe the “horse”.

                                                                                                                                  Metty says that Father has had her use the poison that killed the Formian sometimes. It’s looking more and more like the work of my brother, although I’m not sure how he got the creature to ingest it yet. She is worried about the timing of our brother’s visit, I can’t say she isn’t right to be.

                                                                                                                                  Mina has a habit of using letters as bookmarks. Metty has learned all sorts of tidbits from them and uses them to wind her old friend up. After our talk I returned the letters she had left in the book she sent me.

                                                                                                                                  There’s a new suit of armour in the hall, Metty warned me that it has something to do with the estate’s defences. I noticed that Henry has restored the old Watling sword and it is mounted with the armour.

                                                                                                                                  Breakfast was fairly typical, and there was much catching up.

                                                                                                                                  We couldn’t get in touch with Seb because he was away on a mission.

                                                                                                                                  Given the connection between Druids and Mithras, this worried me. The whole situation with Jade Fox launching a small attack on Froyle Park while moving all her allies out from where we were able to keep tabs on them smacks of a traitor in out camp. We’d gathered quite a lot of forces and any one of them could have betrayed us, but Seb was among them.

                                                                                                                                  So, skipping ahead for this section:

                                                                                                                                  I don’t want to think ill of him but, thinking back, even how we met could have been a loyalty test set up by father.

                                                                                                                                  I’ve quietly asked around and nobody has seen him or his men. There’s no travel records. Nothing. I resorted to scrying for them and got a ping from Warewiel, just by the portal to Amarna.

                                                                                                                                  Alan is going to scout out the camp on this side of Ares’ and Ptah’s portal and see if there’s any sign of them there? It would be nice to know if they’re destroying the place or bolstering its defences.

                                                                                                                                  In the meantime, I’m going to exercise caution.

                                                                                                                                  Maggie hacked into the army records instead. There was some massive explosion at Porton Down, the cameras blacked out, and an EM pulse sent things “screwy”. When they got their systems back up, the leaf room was open.

                                                                                                                                  Alexia and Henry had been to Ireland and consulted with Bridget. She recognised the magic that was embedded in Henry’s chest. It seems to have involved glass magic. There are shards around his heart that show up on x-ray.

                                                                                                                                  Elizabeth the glass magician came out for a consult. In case Henry caught fire again we went out to Wilson’s paddock to find that he wasn’t there. The public had arrived and he was giving children rides.

                                                                                                                                  She said the heart magic felt familiar, it reminded her of the lab where she was forced to work by Jade Fox and was “worse than a soul jar”. There was a soul jar made by her predecessor that felt like that glass.

                                                                                                                                  We went to find Winston, who was playing “I’m a pretty boy” at the head of a parade. He was a hit with the kids and is going to make the health & safety fairies have heart attacks in the near future.

                                                                                                                                  With several avenues of investigation, we decided to focus on Oxford.

                                                                                                                                  The riots that had broken out didn’t seem to involve two groups fighting each other, just spontaneous violence — none of which was directed at old buildings. Anything predating 1800 was unscathed.

                                                                                                                                  There did seem to be a focus around Radcliffe Square, home of the Radcliffe camera which happens to have aspects of his architecture perfectly match the layout of Stonehenge.

                                                                                                                                  We headed to Rogers Tower (formerly Watling Tower) to get a view of the Camera. From the roof we could see a visible police presence.

                                                                                                                                  There we found evidence that the maidens of Aphrodite had been there, many years ago, including a portrait of Henry and a note hidden in the frame that said he was their knight.

                                                                                                                                  Worried about the apparent henge, I suggested we try to test if there was energy being drawn through it. After consulting with Mina I went hunting for a reference book and Henry went out to find me an up to date map (which we would destroy should we need to).

                                                                                                                                  I was surprised at just how horrified Maggie was that I should have a SCONUL card. Sometimes I think my teammates forget my love of academia.

                                                                                                                                  Meanwhile Ophelia brewed a potion to help with my concentration for the ritual.

                                                                                                                                  Henry got slightly distracted while finding me a map and picked up on a rumour that there had been some Latin chanting going on around Radcliffe Square which was heard by one of the guides for the Ghost Tours.

                                                                                                                                  He also spotted The Sheldonian Theatre, which was built by Wren, which pushed Alexia’s current buttons quite firmly.

                                                                                                                                  They went to investigate the theatre while I did the ritual. Next to where the kiosk once stood in the foyer they found a stone wren carved into the wall. When Alexia touched it, it fluttered under her hand. It didn’t respond to Henry’s touch, but shed a stone feather as they left.

                                                                                                                                  Meanwhile, on the roof of the tower, the spell I cast proved a success. The ink I spilled formed a series of straight lines linking Stonehenge to five other locations.

                                                                                                                                  • Carhenge (Alliance, Nebraska, US)
                                                                                                                                  • Seahenge (Norfolk, UK)
                                                                                                                                  • Hadrian-henge (Rome, Italy)
                                                                                                                                  • The Maryhill Stonehenge (Maryhill, Washington, US)
                                                                                                                                  • Radcliffe Camera (Oxford, UK)

                                                                                                                                  This did not seem good.

                                                                                                                                  We went on the Ghost Tour and Henry got the guide to repeat the chanting he had heard:

                                                                                                                                  media nocte deus, cadente Tauro
                                                                                                                                  uide nos nocturnos, filios tuos, placatus
                                                                                                                                  uias multas fecisti; ducunt ad lucern omnes.

                                                                                                                                  I made an attempt at translating it, but I think Phillip’s version is better. He was also able to confirm my theory about who it was about as the first word was missing from the quote we’d received.

                                                                                                                                  Mithras God of the midnight, here the great Bull dies
                                                                                                                                  Look on Thy children in darkness. Oh take our sacrifice
                                                                                                                                  Many roads Thou hast fashioned — all of them lead to Light

                                                                                                                                  This did not make me happy. I’d begin to believe Father’s claims not be involved in this mess.

                                                                                                                                  I suggested that we put together a plan to disrupt whomever was drawing power from the henges.

                                                                                                                                  Seb disappearing had me worried so I decided to look into it.

                                                                                                                                  None of my contacts could turn up anything, no record of their mission, no flights logged, no passport used, no paperwork I could find except for twenty of his men being listen as being on a six month overseas deployment. There weren’t any reports of armed druids turning up and causing problems, not of any other groups being silenced.

                                                                                                                                  Fearing the worst, I pulled a map of Warewiel from the SATT records from the debrief we gave to the people we rescued from Amarna and drew out one of Father’s dimension. It didn’t take long to source and SAS cap badge to use as a focus from the military surplus store opposite the New Vic.

                                                                                                                                  A couple of dots glowed in Warewiel, right by where the gate was. Then they went dark.

                                                                                                                                  It looks like they just travelled from there to Amarna.

                                                                                                                                  Whether that was from pulled back from a raid into the area or pulling back to set up to defend the portal itself, I don’t know.

                                                                                                                                  I talked to Henry and he asked Alan to go scouting. It didn’t go well. He confirmed they were there, but was spotted by the crows and barely managed to escape. We didn’t manage to establish which side they were on.

                                                                                                                                  I’ve asked Maggie to consult her sister about it. She will hopefully know which side the druids are on.

                                                                                                                                  I’d consulted Mina about the meaning of the dots vanishing and she warned me that Michelle had been over to take a look at the Spitfire and learned about the Urudanite since she had spotted the armour Henry had in the main hall and the Eternal Knight promptly spilled his guts.

                                                                                                                                  I opened a couple of bottles of wine and planned a dinner of comfort food. I thought she might need it.

                                                                                                                                  She had always known Urudanite as Asgardian Metal. It was seen as a reward and a great honour to be given armour of a weapon made of it. If Henry’s believe that the Asgardian’s raid Jötunheimr for it, then that shakes her world view. I tried to ease her worries, but the truth is that neither of us know the truth of the matter. I offered to do what I could to help her find out.

                                                                                                                                  I also asked her about Nate — he’d turned up to the dinner party pretending to be far drunker then he really was. She had no idea what he was scheming. She did say that he didn’t like how so many of her team as getting close to SATT though.

                                                                                                                                  The team had made a plan to split up and get samples from each of the Henges more or less simultaneously. I’d taken on the Rome one, and since I had promised Michelle lunch in Naples I offered to make it a long weekend ending with an early morning spot of nefarious activity in Rome. This brought a smile to her face.

                                                                                                                                  See also:
                                                                                                                                  • Joan Crosbie scholarship, The
                                                                                                                                  • Watling, Henry

                                                                                                                                  Henged

                                                                                                                                  Nov 2022

                                                                                                                                  It was a pleasant weekend in Naples. I saved some pizza to take back to the team. It would be cold by time it got there, but it’s hard to argue with pizza from the place it was first created.

                                                                                                                                  We scouted the area in Rome as tourists. There wasn’t much in the way of security. This was hardly going to be a challenge.

                                                                                                                                  Hadrian was obsessed with Britain and its myths and legends which is why he had the villa and out buildings built. There were even rumours in Rome he was not as devout to roman gods as he should be and made minimal offerings at temple.

                                                                                                                                  We went in at 1am as planned. There was no problems at all but on the way out I noticed a bit of gravel near the base of the wall was glinting silver. Michelle hadn’t seen anything like it, but it was all over the area.

                                                                                                                                  I bagged up a sample to take back with me.

                                                                                                                                  Once we were away from the building, I did a quick test on the gravel. The silver started to fade quite quickly. There was no sign of it phoning home to the henge, so I decided it was safe to take with me.

                                                                                                                                  Michelle was going to stay in Rome for another day or so checking out someone for Nate.

                                                                                                                                  We kissed goodbye and I used Ophelia’s potion to send myself to the safe house.

                                                                                                                                  Maggie had gone to Oxford to get a piece of the henge there and had run into “a creature” in the underground passage. It accused her of being a book thief, which she did not take kindly to. It was sniffing and scraping, suggestive of something that hunts by scent and slithers along the ground.

                                                                                                                                  Alexia had gone to Seahenge where she found seaweed that glowed much like the gravel I’d brought back with me. Not unique then.

                                                                                                                                  She also had cut herself down there and the wound had quickly healed leaving a silver mark.

                                                                                                                                  Ophelia had gone to Stonehenge. She had no trouble with the mission but noticed Happy in the visitor photos, which is a slightly worrying development.

                                                                                                                                  Meanwhile Henry, having done Maryland, had run into John Silver at the airport when he landed to do Carhenge. The investigator had recognised Henry and said that his name was interesting. This does not bode well. Silver is an arse.

                                                                                                                                  Maggie got hold of some footage from the airport’s CCTV system and managed to lip read the phrases “Police escort”, “Carhenge”, and “The Sooty and Sweep Show” (clearly not a fan of the Magic Police).

                                                                                                                                  When he arrived at Carhenge he found it swarming with the Magic Police. They had a number of boxes — no doubt their famous magic detectors — which repeatedly went ‘ping!’.

                                                                                                                                  Something in the area was also triggering the curse embedded in Henry’s chest and he was finding it slightly painful.

                                                                                                                                  He also spotted my brother lurking in the car park eating his lunch. Looks like Stonehenge wasn’t the only one he was taking an interest in.

                                                                                                                                  The Magic Police were the bigger threat though, so Maggie went over to provide a distraction and Ophelia went with her so she could take advantage of it to use an invisibility potion to grab something from one of the cars.

                                                                                                                                  By the time they got there, the police had rounded up the tourists and were interviewing them. Silver was in charge; he didn’t seem to be being helpful. He kept telling them to put their boxes away because “We’re investigating art crime” and he wanted the “Blue car doors back”.

                                                                                                                                  Henry used the time to talk to Mordred, but didn’t learn anything useful. My brother was playing his cards close to his chest.

                                                                                                                                  Maggie’s distraction got under way — she faked a power summoning ritual — and found that thanks to the conditions at the henge she did start calling up power.

                                                                                                                                  This had a few effects.

                                                                                                                                  Maggie got something of a high from the power.

                                                                                                                                  The Magic Police were very distracted at the sight of a spellcasting 8’ lizard.

                                                                                                                                  Henry’s favourite demon emerged from one of the “stones” of the henge and moved to attack the nearest victim, which happened to be one of the Magic Police.

                                                                                                                                  The rest of us portaled to the area. People were in danger. Time for us to do the Magic Police’s job for them as they clearly weren’t capable. I did have the presence of mind to pull on a balaclava before we left, the last thing I wanted want to give Silver another reason to handcuff me to a radiator.

                                                                                                                                  It was a nasty fight. I tried to use the circle to force the demon back to where it came from, but there was too much power and I couldn’t close it. This brought has back to swords. We picked up a few injuries but managed to kill it. I’m not sure if that means it is going to stay dead and gone though; I’ll have to do some research into the subject next time I have access to a suitable library.

                                                                                                                                  Happy got involved, largely helping civilians get clear. Interesting.

                                                                                                                                  After the battle, Silver wanted to question us, and seemed concerned about “Woodrow”. We addressed his concerns by using a portal to leave.

                                                                                                                                  I had three possible endgames in mind for the ritual to ruin the day of whomever was drawing power from the henges and consulted Mina on which would be the best.

                                                                                                                                  Trying to disrupt the power would have a risk of … side effects and was not recommended.

                                                                                                                                  Overloading the person drawing the power risked both providing extra power they could use (rather than more than they could cope with) but also hurting an innocent being used as a middleman.

                                                                                                                                  This left us with the third option: Putting the power somewhere else.

                                                                                                                                  Aphrodite seemed like the best choice, especially since she had had to use up so much of her own power covering for Britannia so Henry went to talk to her.

                                                                                                                                  The Blue Doors turned out to be an art project by Bill Woodrow that was on loan to Carhenge as a special exhibition. Someone had stolen them.

                                                                                                                                  The urge to find them and use them to taunt John Silver is quite high.

                                                                                                                                  I might be being petty.

                                                                                                                                  On the other hand; he handcuffed me to a radiator and didn’t even have the decency to release me himself when he figured out he had no reasonable cause to hold me!

                                                                                                                                  The ritual started out quite smoothly. Then Aprodite wobbled — there were a lot of power being channelled — and scuffed some of the chalk marks in the circle.

                                                                                                                                  The spell collapsed part way through and there was a flood of energy into the area.

                                                                                                                                  The earth turned silver in a large circle around the safe house.

                                                                                                                                  Alexia’s silver marks grew ticker and networked out across more of her flesh.

                                                                                                                                  Earthquakes hit all of the henges — Magnitude 4.5, enough to be noticed but not enough to cause any serious damage.

                                                                                                                                  I was exhausted.

                                                                                                                                  When I woke up, I checked on the news. I was very glad the earthquakes weren’t serious.

                                                                                                                                  Aphrodite definitely had more power. She created a strawberry from nothing and commented that it had never been easier.

                                                                                                                                  The silver earth was usable as a source of power, Maggie has decided she had better not touch it with her bare hands. Henry has had it moved into a grain silo to get it out of sight.

                                                                                                                                  I sent Happy a message to make sure he was alright. He said that he had been looking into the henges for Father who was curious about the rise in power around them.

                                                                                                                                  Of course, this leaves me wondering if Father really is in the dark, if he is dispatching Happy to see how a plan he is involved in is going, or if Happy is in on that plan.

                                                                                                                                  Sometimes I hate being my father’s son.

                                                                                                                                  See also:

                                                                                                                                    Visiting Jötunheimr

                                                                                                                                    Nov 2022

                                                                                                                                    Michelle had spent her life believing that the war between Asgard and Jötunheimr was just and honourable, and then Henry comes along and tells her his theory that it’s really just a con to keep the troops happy while the Asgard plunder the Urudanite supplies.

                                                                                                                                    And thus she joined Henry and Ophelia for their latest trip to that realm to see for herself, and I went along — partly out of curiosity, partly to get a better feel for the politics of the land, but mostly to make sure she was going to be alright.

                                                                                                                                    On the other side of the portal we met Finaya, Thom, and Latrixia and we were offered tea.

                                                                                                                                    They asked if Maggie was related to The Traveller, who we took to be Guthywn, who visited every so often.

                                                                                                                                    It turned out that Henry and Ophelia had built a house in the village. It was oddly organic and I got the impression that it was as much grown as built.

                                                                                                                                    Latrixia told use that the village was in the middle of Jötunheimr sp they were “less wary about damn Asgardians coming and stealing from us”. Giants are found mostly to the north where it is much colder; 7–8 days ride from the village.

                                                                                                                                    The village didn’t appear to go in for books, Maggie was quite discomforted at this, but had a strong oral tradition with a storytelling passing through once or twice a season.

                                                                                                                                    That night we told stories.

                                                                                                                                    Ophelia wanted to collect some radishes for a potion she wanted to brew. Unfortunately they only grew near the cave of a Giantess, Glenava who lived with some snow foxes.

                                                                                                                                    She was not comfortable having a horde of armed people turned up at her door, so only Henry and Ophelia approached, unarmed. She was surprised at the request for radishes as she was under the impression that they grew everywhere.

                                                                                                                                    When she learned he was a craftsman she told him of Brísingamen and how it was stolen from her by dwarves. He agreed to make a replica, but would need to measure her neck for a fit. Not wanting to be strangled by the stranger, she insisted on Ophelia sticking her hand between the jaws of one of the foxes while he did that.

                                                                                                                                    We visited the city, did a little trading. They had storytellers, pottery, gems, and a distinct lack of horses (although they had some ponies).

                                                                                                                                    We did learn that Guthywn had been asking for information about a frost giant princess. This might be a lead that will help us find her.

                                                                                                                                    Back at home, Henry is looking for a new safehouse, and is playing up his discomfort at being at SATT in an effort to draw out our opponents. Artie is still not around.

                                                                                                                                    See also:

                                                                                                                                      The First Test of Love

                                                                                                                                      Dec 2022

                                                                                                                                      Henry has been making a fool of himself — intentionally — and has been wandering the halls of SATT living out some sort of Marlin Brando fantasy involving a leather jacket and flirting with just about everyone he passes.

                                                                                                                                      He still doesn’t seem to have managed to draw out whatever it is at SATT that is wrong.

                                                                                                                                      Meanwhile the coffee pot on the third floor (and only that one) has gone… odd. I checked the purchase order and it has been there for three years. Coffee bean consumption has dropped dramatically in the last two weeks though since the pot refuses to empty. We tried pouring it down the sink and it just kept going.

                                                                                                                                      I was attempting to see what I could learn about the magic affecting it; Henry gave me something he had been working on, an arm ring that expanded to be a magic circle. A nice gift, but one that has started some more rumours as Magnus walked into the kitchen just as Henry presented me with a jewellery box.

                                                                                                                                      Magnus was complaining about a problem with one of the motorpool’s motorcycles — it “laughed” at him when it hit 20mph.

                                                                                                                                      Ophelia, meanwhile, had been testing the coffee it produced. It appeared to be normal coffee.

                                                                                                                                      Nobody had moved into or out of an office near the pot recently.

                                                                                                                                      Elsewhere a printer had been breaking exactly one hour after it had been repaired, repeatedly, for six days in a row, with a variety of different faults. The technician was being driven to despair. So far today there had been a paper jam and then the yellow toner cartridge exploded.

                                                                                                                                      Alexia arrived, having been occupied in the gym while the rest of us had been called in to investigate. She reported that the showers were smelling too “nice”.

                                                                                                                                      Henry passed a cactus on legs and which responded to the name Colin. Ophelia’s little joke appears to have become rather less funny. The least said about him wanting to hug Ophelia the better.

                                                                                                                                      Wondering if this was some kind of luck magic, Maggie summoned Bes who took a tour of SATT and flirted with her outrageously but wasn’t very much help.

                                                                                                                                      Cavel was acting suspiciously when Ophelia wanted to talk to him about something and we eventually persuaded him to tell us how it was he knew about the printer and so on: He had been making wishes.

                                                                                                                                      Wish magic. Always has a habit of going weird.

                                                                                                                                      Following a scream we found a giant fruit bat frightening one of the cleaners. The bat was, of all things, helping clean. Once Willow (the cleaner) got over the initial shock she relaxed. It turns out that it was also her wish that the gym showers now no longer needed cleaning.

                                                                                                                                      Ophelia made use of a shrinking potion and went with Remy to search the walls. Not long after she returned with a a silver bracelet. It was supposed to be in the archives and had belonged to a Scion of Aphrodite.

                                                                                                                                      When it was safely returned to the archives, we were called to the main entrance by the doorman.

                                                                                                                                      Waiting for us were Hecate, Hades, and Selene. This had been one of the tests of the love of Ophelia, Henry and Mina. We’d passed.

                                                                                                                                      And that was when Hecate dropped the bombshell: She offered to train me and said she could do so better than Grandmother.

                                                                                                                                      See also:

                                                                                                                                        Investigating Happy

                                                                                                                                        Dec 2022

                                                                                                                                        I called Jeremy and asked him to pull a couple of records for me which told me that my brother had got himself a 2.1 MA in Classics as Edinburgh. I read his dissertation; it was good work, if he’d picked up the trick of not taking certain elements of the hidden world as read he’d have got a 1st. (Getting everything to work with that particular trick is one of the reasons that my dissertation is taking so long; that and saving the world.)

                                                                                                                                        I haven’t been able to narrow down the sword he seems to have picked up lately. I only caught a glimpse of it, and there are too many glowing swords (if it was glowing) in mythology to count. Henry thinks it might be Charlemagne’s Joyeuse.

                                                                                                                                        See also:

                                                                                                                                          Snakes on a Beach

                                                                                                                                          Dec 2022

                                                                                                                                          Like Muhammad Ali will we come and rain vengeance upon those who defy my father. Save my sister and convince your group of the true path to salvation.

                                                                                                                                            Thinking of Hecate

                                                                                                                                            Dec 2022

                                                                                                                                            The coin Hecate gave be showed three moons, back-to-back, on each side. It is a sign like Hecate’s wheel and the coin is a mean to get in touch with her. I’m keeping it in a lead box in the safe. Michelle has decided she is going to avoid that safe for the time being. I can’t say I blame her.

                                                                                                                                            Mina came to visit and I asked her advice. Hecate is very dedicated to her craft, and Ophelia having outside interests is a large source of the friction between them. I might find myself in a similar position if I agreed.

                                                                                                                                            It might also draw Morgan Le Fae out if Hecate took her grandson as an apprentice.

                                                                                                                                            There would be a price, so if I were to accept I should get everything in writing and have a lawyer check it over.

                                                                                                                                            See also:

                                                                                                                                              Team Meeting

                                                                                                                                              Dec 2022

                                                                                                                                              We had a catch up at Elliott’s.

                                                                                                                                              Rumours are flying around SATT about Henry’s relationships, including with me (sigh) and Patrizia (good grief) and Whisper. There are also questions about why lab techs have been seen wearing Henry’s jacket.

                                                                                                                                              (Ophelia gave them the jacket for protection when Colin the now sentient, giant, self-ambulatory cactus developed a love of giving people hugs).

                                                                                                                                              SATT, apparently, knows where 7 of Artie’s swords are — I really should have a chat with Patrizia and compare that to my list.

                                                                                                                                              The door by the gym containing the sword in the stone was brought to her attention, but she was also unable to open it — even when she commanded it to open “in the name of the keeper”… which caused every other door on the floor to slam open. Her pet scorpion, grown to giant size couldn’t bash its way in either.

                                                                                                                                              Henry has attempted to get in touch with Section One (using a post office box in the park opposite the office).

                                                                                                                                              Since John Silver had turned up to get in Henry’s way I told the team about how I met him. I was promptly disappointed in myself when Alexia spotted that Charles-Geneviève-Louis-Auguste-André-Timothée d’Éon de Beaumont had a few names in common with the irritating gentleman who lured us up to Durham not so long ago.

                                                                                                                                              Once I’d finished chastising myself for missing that, I returned to my story and, with the benefit of a fresh eye on it, recognised the scarab that had replaced the sword. It turns out that, while Michelle was otherwise occupied in Poland, the rest of her team went after a dealer with an interest in Louis XVI pieces and needed to steal the sword back after Elliott spotted the mistake he’d made when forging it.

                                                                                                                                              See also:

                                                                                                                                                A Tricky Christmas

                                                                                                                                                Dec 2022

                                                                                                                                                It was supposed to be a nice gathering of friends to celebrate Christmas. We’d just exchanged gifts when a heard of one hundred goats led by Tanngrisnir and Tanngnjóstr marching down the road, eating anything they found along teh way.

                                                                                                                                                Ophelia started brewing a potion in Elliott’s kitchen that would allow her to speak to the animals.

                                                                                                                                                We found out that after snacking on Christmas trees they had appeared in Trafalgar Square. We decided to head there to investigate.

                                                                                                                                                First though, Henry got in touch with City Farm in order to find a place to stash the goats. They were missing three. Ho boy.

                                                                                                                                                On the way to the square we came across oranges, spices, cards, Kallikantzaroi, buckets of KFC, Frau Perchta (who was dangerous enough that I encased her in ice and called a SATT collection team to take her somewhere to cool off), reindeer (in Regent’s Park), animated snowmen, a horde of mice holding placards reading ‘No cheeses for us meeces’ beseiging Neil’s Yard Dairy, and the Icelandic Yule Cat perched atop the 4th plinth at the square.

                                                                                                                                                We tracked the problem to Macs where a Leon, Son of Velos and Douglas, Son of Loki were holding a competition to see who could cause the most trouble before someone found them. The insisted we judge their tricks. I thought Douglas had the edge, but the majority vote went to Leon.

                                                                                                                                                Next year it is their sisters’ turn.

                                                                                                                                                See also:

                                                                                                                                                  Confronting d’Eon

                                                                                                                                                  Dec 2022

                                                                                                                                                  Now we had identified him, we went to have another word with d’Eon. He was worried about prophecy influencing our decision ‘the wrong way’ but did give us some more details of the prophecy:

                                                                                                                                                  Finding the right way to shatter the glass as the new incarnation will end or start afresh.

                                                                                                                                                  He told us that he had a sister, that she was still with the Roi (the organisation he was involved with now is a different one) and that she was handier with the sword than he is.

                                                                                                                                                  He made an excuse to visit the toilet, and soon after a woman left.

                                                                                                                                                  I followed her, disappointed that he would try such a ploy, to a house where she entered and discussed the matter with a woman who could only be her twin sister — they looked identical and squabbled like siblings (normal ones, they didn’t try to stab each other.)

                                                                                                                                                  “Too soon. Guidance might hurt.”

                                                                                                                                                  “They seem quite responsive, I’ve been following them for ages”.

                                                                                                                                                  They had a Gemini symbol on the wall (it represents twins, but Castor and Polux (the Dioscuri, children of Leda) in particular).

                                                                                                                                                  They seemed like they would at at this conversation for some time, so I decided to cut it short. The rest of the team hurried over from the tea rooms while I called Whisper and asked if she knew the twins. She did — they fought in the war against England — and would vouch for us.

                                                                                                                                                  I knocked and offered “Louise” the phone which got us inside.

                                                                                                                                                  They agreed to tell us what they knew.

                                                                                                                                                  • Glass is important to this group
                                                                                                                                                  • Finding the right way to shatter is important
                                                                                                                                                  • The right sword may shatter it
                                                                                                                                                  • Choosing the right sword is most important
                                                                                                                                                  • A long standing member of a secret group will guide
                                                                                                                                                  • The new incarnation will end of start afresh
                                                                                                                                                  See also:

                                                                                                                                                    Michael the Book Dealer

                                                                                                                                                    Jan 2023

                                                                                                                                                    I met with Michael at White’s to pick up the copy of Quia Sanguis (For Blood) he’d acquired for me.

                                                                                                                                                    He has his eye on a couple more books that he thought would be of interest to me — he was right — but was looking for payment in favours rather than cash. I expressed my interest, but also my dislike of open-ended favours. He is going to get back to me once he has acquired the books and has something specific in mind.

                                                                                                                                                    After I commented on the downsides of White’s excellent bacon sandwiches, Michel offered an introduction to his gym. He suggested it was a place to make useful contacts and that it was on another realm. The business card was plain white on the back while the front was black with a gold, Times New Roman T surrounded by a pair of bars on each side.

                                                                                                                                                    He’s definitely aware that Alexia is capable of inter-realm travel, but doesn’t seem to have picked up on Ophelia’s ability yet.

                                                                                                                                                    Conversation moved on to family, he considers Travette to be a zealot — she criticises hit attitude to life which I suggested was premised on “What’s the point of power and lineage if you aren’t going to enjoy it?”

                                                                                                                                                    When I mentioned I had a similar relationship with Morganette he told me that my sisters did have that reputation. The plural was interesting: Was he talking about another living sister of mine? Or the dead ones?

                                                                                                                                                    I was delighted when he brought up the subject of the Phoenix Library — it allowed me to ask about his involvement with an organisation that branched from the Hand of Isis — he didn’t say much but that it had moved quite a considerable way from the Hand.

                                                                                                                                                    He also claimed his father didn’t want to destroy the world, just to enjoy his place in it. That’s a remarkable claim, if true. I’m not inclined to believe it, but given the asgardian secret we’ve been learning about of late, it bears further investigation.

                                                                                                                                                    Quia Sanguis is certainly advanced. I’d be hesitant to try anything in it at my current skill level. Still, it is an interesting volume and can sit on a shelf until I am ready for it, or until I need to figure out what somebody else is up to with Blood Magic.

                                                                                                                                                    Since Henry has been dabbling in Blood Forging of late, I might invite him to take a peak at it. Possibly after getting permission from Mina first; I don’t want to get the blame for the estate blowing up.

                                                                                                                                                    That can wait a few weeks, I know Michael has his sources, and if that book ends up in Henry’s hands immediately then things can’t end well.

                                                                                                                                                    See also:

                                                                                                                                                      Tales

                                                                                                                                                      Jan 2023

                                                                                                                                                      Artie, Aphrodite, and Henry have all been speaking with Britannia. They say she is changed, is harder and less caring then she was before the box.

                                                                                                                                                      This is a concern.

                                                                                                                                                      The goddess then had a storyteller, by way of water-scrying, tell us tales that might be useful to us in the future.

                                                                                                                                                      We were told of the journey of Thor & Loki, some of the labours of Hercules (specifically how he poisoned his arrows with Hydra blood and then accidentally killed his centaur friend), the poem of The Robin and the Wren, and a tale about the Morrígan.

                                                                                                                                                      Henry has organised a new safe house. Apparently there is something living down the well and it is protected by a Griffon by the name of Vallstron.

                                                                                                                                                      I scryed Guthywn again and confirmed she was in the north east of Jötunheimr.

                                                                                                                                                      Now Artie is paying a bit more attention to SATT business again we caught up with him and picked his brains over the Heb Sed business. He told us he would take it to the ruling council, while writing a note to tell us to meet him at Elliott’s.

                                                                                                                                                      I have a horrible suspicion that whatever has been affecting SATT’s records is also influencing Britannia.

                                                                                                                                                      At Elliott’s we discussed the possibility of the Library of Maggie and the Watling Estate signing onto the Heb Sed pact instead of SATT. It’s an interesting idea, but one that needs Henry and Maggie to talk to their patrons about it.

                                                                                                                                                      See also:

                                                                                                                                                        Mordred’s Tribute

                                                                                                                                                        Feb 2023

                                                                                                                                                        Father was taking tribute when I arrived. Malsum was giving him a kissing cup in the most obvious display of “This gift is for you, but really it is for us” I’ve seen in quite some time.

                                                                                                                                                        The priestess who had been talking about the training on one of my earlier visits was giving him a girl. She was dressed in military styled leather armour (not the same style as Ares’ troops were using) with an abundance of knives. She managed to pull off a proper bow to father. The first had violet eyes. More evidence that whatever the priestess was up to, it wasn’t anywhere in Midgard.

                                                                                                                                                        The priestess say that “This is my first to you, my liege, she has been trained in all the ~~~, let me know if she is fit, if not we can change the training.”

                                                                                                                                                        Everyone except the four of us left. Father confirmed that she was “one of the new batch of trainees”. The way he looked at her made my skin crawl. I smiled.

                                                                                                                                                        I gave father the usual updates. He is aware that something is going on in Amarna and wanted me to look into it. He seems to be trying to downplay is concern over it.

                                                                                                                                                        He was interested in Hecate’s offer to me and didn’t discourage me from taking it up. He claimed she once held a flame for him. (Thankfully he is too young to be Ophelia’s father).

                                                                                                                                                        I was also able to learn a fair amount about Ice Giant Politics from him.

                                                                                                                                                        He was very pleased with me and Alexia when he learned about Verdas’ fate, and confirmed my suspicions that the collapse of his personal realm meant that he was really dead and gone.

                                                                                                                                                        I took advantage of being there to visit his library, copy some maps of Jötunheimr and do some research into magic and demonology.

                                                                                                                                                        The creature that Jade Fox cursed Henry with appears to have been a Mau (King) of the Mazoku.

                                                                                                                                                        I got home in time for Elizabeth and Andrew Porth (who was not using his chisel anywhere near enough for it not to be a cover for magic) to finish up the fountain. Ziczzi was delighted (as was I, it’s a beautiful piece of work).

                                                                                                                                                        I heard the two of the talking about going into partnership.

                                                                                                                                                        See also:

                                                                                                                                                          Heb Sed Progress

                                                                                                                                                          Feb 2023

                                                                                                                                                          After months, I’ve finally managed to get the team to talk to Taranis and update him about what we’re learned about the location of the Heb Sed artefacts.

                                                                                                                                                          On the way to Mac’s Henry told us that he’d been taken to the bottom of the ocean and given a gift — a C16 or C17 spanish silver coin with the image of an galleon on one side and the numeral 1, very worn, on the other. It may have come from Selene.

                                                                                                                                                          Taranis has replaced his missing arm with a silver prosthetic. He showed up in an unsurprisingly immaculate tailored suit and a white shirt.

                                                                                                                                                          We told him what we had learned about the artefacts.

                                                                                                                                                          One of the outstanding things needed for the ritual is the bull. There have been random appearances of bulls in parks all over the world, but our counterparts haven’t been able to capture any; they either die or disappear.

                                                                                                                                                          The proposal that the Library and Estate might sign on was of interest and Taranis is going to discuss it. He wanted to know if Maggie was planning to start her own lineage (no, but she was going to arrange successors).

                                                                                                                                                          See also:

                                                                                                                                                            To the Land of Ice

                                                                                                                                                            Feb 2023

                                                                                                                                                            We quietly portaled into Jötunheimr and I attempted to scry for Guthywn again.
