                                                                                                                                                            There was an odd blankness, like a wall, between us. I was able to conjure a vision into the water we had stopped beside. It showed a giantess (12-13’ tall) wearing a red and brown patched cloak and leather armour with a stylised hammer on one shoulder and an S on the other.

                                                                                                                                                            Later we would learn that the hammer represented her weapon of choice (and unusual in this land with the symbology of Thor) and that the S represented Prince Sepin to whom she had become champion.

                                                                                                                                                            We went to find lunch and gossip. Lady Margaret’s wealth caused quite a stir.

                                                                                                                                                            With the exception of our Lady’s maid, we servants mixed with the others of our class and were fed buffer-style. There were plenty of languages spoken there: Latin, Greek, Pidgin-Baltic, and Middle English. None of us had any real trouble making ourselves understood to at least some people.

                                                                                                                                                            The main bits of news were flooding to the east which had impacted the fruit crop; there seems to be more flooding of late. I filed it away as something to investigate later.

                                                                                                                                                            Price Sepin is reported to have a new champion — her description matches that of the women we say in my scrying — and is getting married.

                                                                                                                                                            We also picked up some advice on where to stay in the capital.

                                                                                                                                                            The journey was uneventful. There was a lot of traffic on the way, the royal wedding was attracting many visitors.

                                                                                                                                                            When we got there I pulled out the company Henry had given to me; I’d keyed it to Guthywn when we arrived. It was pointing towards the city centre.

                                                                                                                                                            We found the inn and learned that there was to be a presentation of the new princess in the grand auditorium.

                                                                                                                                                            There is much muttering when we get there about get being a foreign princess, or possibly just foreign and is a princess because she is marrying the prince. Nobody really seems to know what her background is. Sepin did have a previous love though, and it isn’t clear what happened to help (did she leave? Disappear? Die?)

                                                                                                                                                            Then Princess Travette was announced.

                                                                                                                                                            That was something.

                                                                                                                                                            That next morning Henry was AWOL. We’d noticed that there was a distinct lack of quality in the weapons and armour of Jötunheimr. We suspected he was at one of the local blacksmiths and Ophelia confirmed it with her ring while I was asking Winston if he knew where Henry was (Winston did not care).

                                                                                                                                                            He’d been collecting gossip while finding a better breakfast than the rest of us were getting.

                                                                                                                                                            Once we’d caught up we split up.

                                                                                                                                                            Henry and I went to the training ground, via the blacksmithery owned by his new friend to pick up some weapons.

                                                                                                                                                            While there he couldn’t resist interfering (the forge wasn’t hot enough, the smith broke a blade and was just going to hammer the two halves together instead of reforging it properly, and so on). When he paid for them he did so with a metal armband that had the smith scratching his head at the metalwork.

                                                                                                                                                            We were going to be noticed.

                                                                                                                                                            At the training ground we did some easygoing sparing at each other. We were here to scope out the crowd and listen for gossip, not to make a display of ourselves.

                                                                                                                                                            We ended up swapping sparing partners. Henry ended up fighting a man by the name of Adels while I faced off against his friend Gremog. We still took things easy and I enjoyed the gentle workout.

                                                                                                                                                            Meanwhile the party going to investigate the delivery wedding presents learned that the giants were expected to present something nice and there would be a prize for the best wedding gift.

                                                                                                                                                            One previous wedding saw a gift of a dragon claw, which ended up with the giver jailed for lying (after all, there’s no such thing as a dragon so how could he have killed one and taken its claw as a prize?).

                                                                                                                                                            Back at the training ground we were taking drinks with our sparing partners when a woman — Dura — slapped me and waltzed off. I made an excuse to the others at my table to explain it away by blaming it on an imaginary brother.

                                                                                                                                                            Later I was able to talk to her briefly and learn about the existence of Jonny.

                                                                                                                                                            We’d learned that there was to be a tournament in honour of the wedding, with the prize being to have the honour of arming the champion. Getting close to Guthywn was exactly what we wanted.

                                                                                                                                                            The fight was to third blood, or the snatching three ribbons from the opponents belt. We had no trouble making it through to the final round with victory going to Henry.

                                                                                                                                                            Adels and Gremog accused us of holding back. They weren’t wrong. We agreed to keep them in mind if any spots opened up at Lady Margaret’s training school.

                                                                                                                                                            Lady Margaret and her handmaiden Ophelia were invited up to the Royal Pavilion. Where Ophelia noticed something off about the tea and Maggie made a splash with the crown prince.

                                                                                                                                                            We were invited back to the palace where Maggie managed to arrange a private talk with her sister.

                                                                                                                                                            Guthywn’s reaction to Maggie’s appearance was as you might expect; happily we were able to talk her down before things turned to bloodshed.

                                                                                                                                                            She said things had been odd around here since before Travette turned up to marry the prince. The giants seem happy and the Jotunn less oppressed.

                                                                                                                                                            Guthywn didn’t know anything about Seb and the druids as far as the war with Ares and Ptah was going. She suggested I try the direct approach to figure out what they were up to.

                                                                                                                                                            She also told us of her emergency escape route: A red book on the shelf.

                                                                                                                                                            Dinner was an interesting affair. Travette and Sepin appeared to be genuinely in love; Ophelia got a chance to properly examine the tea they were drinking and discovered it to be a fertility potion — not the love potion we assumed.

                                                                                                                                                            Maggie’s hood feel down at one point and Travette didn’t blink an eyelid. You’d think she would be able to recognise her own sister.

                                                                                                                                                            Maggie has many outlandish theories.

                                                                                                                                                            The prize for best wedding gift went to Uilia who gifted a mechanical bird. If it wasn’t a spy for father; I’d be surprised.

                                                                                                                                                            Maggie’s gift of mead went down very well. It caused such a stir that we ended up discussing the possibilities of bringing some more to the palace.

                                                                                                                                                            See also:
                                                                                                                                                            • Pan-Realm Trade
                                                                                                                                                            • Portals

                                                                                                                                                            Michael and the Gym

                                                                                                                                                            Feb 2023

                                                                                                                                                            I met Michael at Whites again. He led me to a private office, to which he had a key. It was unremarkable and quite dull; it had the look of a freshly cleaned out room ready for a new person to move into it.

                                                                                                                                                            He pulled out a black card with the gold T and bars on it and added a drop of his blood, then he tapped it against a wall and a portal opened.

                                                                                                                                                            After getting a brief orientation of the gym we went separate ways — I did some lengths of the pool and had a massage to work the kinks out of my back — before meeting up for a spot of friendly sword practice.

                                                                                                                                                            He is very skilled, almost up to Henry’s level, and seems to enjoy the work. He commented that his father didn’t appreciate the blade.

                                                                                                                                                            Afterwards we took breakfast in the restaurant, briefly met Thrax and I overheard a couple of people talking about an archery contest. If I go back and run into them again I might have to find out more as I’m sure Alexia would be interested.

                                                                                                                                                            On the way out I was handed a membership packet. I’m going to give it some thought, it is a very nice gym, and there is the potential for some useful contacts, the prices are eye-watering though.

                                                                                                                                                            Thrax running around free from his father’s influence bothered me though. Lance defied his father and got landed with a Strife, how is Thrax getting off so easily?

                                                                                                                                                            See also:

                                                                                                                                                              Patrizia and the Swords

                                                                                                                                                              Feb 2023

                                                                                                                                                              I’d been wanting to have a talk with Patrizia about Artie’s swords for a while — Henry knowing more about them than me was grating — and I finally managed to find time to do it. I managed to get a few hints for my notes.

                                                                                                                                                              She is, like most of us, worried about Britannia who is still behaving oddly; she isn’t acknowledging Patrizia as the Keeper of SATT. I speculated that knowledge might be disappearing from her as it is from SATT itself. Although if either is the cause or both are symptoms I have no idea.

                                                                                                                                                              Our Keeper is a little obsessed with Henry — well, the man is highly irritating — and we speculated about why he drowned so frequently and yet managed to spend years at sea as Avery.

                                                                                                                                                              See also:
                                                                                                                                                              • Portals

                                                                                                                                                              Planning a Trade Route

                                                                                                                                                              Feb 2023

                                                                                                                                                              With Maggie suggesting that we would send some more mead to Prince Sepin I got busy working out how to turn that into a real opportunity.

                                                                                                                                                              My first port of call was Elliott. He was trying out a Japanese menu but didn’t think it would go down well with his regular clients. I suggested that saving them for theme nights or targetting business meetings would make them go down well. A major Japanese bank has its London offices a short hop along the central line from his place.

                                                                                                                                                              On the subject of the business, he was interested and had some sensible thoughts on dealing with the provenance of gemstones (I hadn’t considered forging marks on them at such scale) and insisted that the second-best mead didn’t come from Tesco’s suppliers. He is going to talk to a farm he knows in Norfolk.

                                                                                                                                                              We then enjoyed a couple of beers and the subject somehow turned to “Vampire Sex: Is it necrophilia”. I hasten to add that he brought it up, but that neither of us wanted to ask Mina or Nate about it.

                                                                                                                                                              I invited my brother to join me at dinner at Macs with the promise of a potentially lucrative business opportunity. It was a very nice invitation, but I didn’t put any contact details on it so he’d have to do some work if he wanted to RSVP. I was assuming he would accept, if he didn’t then I’d get to enjoy a nice meal at Mac’s and think through some of my research in peace.

                                                                                                                                                              I thought he’d feel safe there, but he still brought a bodyguard. Possibly in case I decided to do something to him on the way: as if I didn’t know where he lived and could have his snatched any time I pleased.

                                                                                                                                                              We had a very productive evening. It turns out that he is extremely competent when it comes to business. He just turns to jelly the moment anything remotely social happens.

                                                                                                                                                              See also:

                                                                                                                                                                Seb in Egypt

                                                                                                                                                                Mar 2023

                                                                                                                                                                With Alan as backup and Alexia on standby just in case, I quietly approached Amarna.

                                                                                                                                                                Happily I was able to get a decent enough look at the SAS deployment before they grabbed me — these guys are very good and I really do need to up my game.

                                                                                                                                                                They blindfolded me with a balaclava, handcuffed my arms behind my back and frogmarched me for about 20 minutes across the desert. Since I’d just had my fears that they’d sided with Ares and Ptah relieved I found it oddly relaxing.

                                                                                                                                                                To cut a long story short, Seb was peeved I’d snuck up on them, happy I’d brought a bottle of Elliott’s mead and told me that Greg had asked them to keep an eye on the place and asked him to keep it quiet.

                                                                                                                                                                Suddenly everything become a lot more clear, as it did to Seb when I told him Greg had disappeared off on a secret mission and we hadn’t seen him for months.

                                                                                                                                                                We had a discussion about the portal. It seems to be running off the combined power of the two gods, that’s a significant step above what Verdas had pulled off with the henges… and my disassembling that bit of magic caused earthquakes around the world. Not good. Surface to air missions have a good chance of triggering a similar energy release.

                                                                                                                                                                It is a lot of not very good.

                                                                                                                                                                See also:

                                                                                                                                                                  The Fall of SATT

                                                                                                                                                                  Mar 2023

                                                                                                                                                                  Monday arrived and it seemed like it was shaping up to be nicely quiet. I was catching up with paperwork while I waited for the rest of the team to get in so I could catch them up with what I’d learned in Egypt on Saturday night.

                                                                                                                                                                  I was interrupted by a summoning to Conference Room C. This was unusual but not unheard of, but we’d not had a meeting there since Greg disappeared on his mysterious assignment.

                                                                                                                                                                  We’d been summoned to answer questions from Senior Auditor Olivia Ironwood.

                                                                                                                                                                  This did not bode well. Then we were magically bound to our chairs and barriers placed between us. I didn’t feel like being very helpful at this point.

                                                                                                                                                                  Her lines of questioning were egregious, dwelt upon violations of SATT rules that I’d never heard of — and I had paid attention to the manual — and tried to dig deeply into my relationship with members of my family. The others suffered similar lines of questioning.

                                                                                                                                                                  She also took a strong interest in the whereabouts of “King Arthur” and Excalibur and was not best pleased we I pointed out that we weren’t our department head’s keepers.

                                                                                                                                                                  Eventually she must have decided that she was getting nowhere and decided to have us thrown into cells to weaken our resolve. Patrizia told us to run. We ran through a portal Ophelia opened.

                                                                                                                                                                  We arrived at the library and set about checking on our allies and loved ones Artie, I grabbed his sword from the wall and conjured a circle. He was in his office but I was able to create a link to the dagger on his desk. An image of his face replaced the reflection in the sword.

                                                                                                                                                                  He was holed up in his office while armed men patrolled the corridors.

                                                                                                                                                                  Meanwhile Ziczzi had given Michelle 7 minutes warning of the men coming for her and she’d been able to get out with everything that would be best kept out of Ironwood’s hands.

                                                                                                                                                                  We arranged to rendezvous at the Watling Estate.

                                                                                                                                                                  Maggie had been able to tap into SATT’s camera network, and her own more extensive one that she’d fitted without telling the rest of us. I want to have a word with her about boundaries, but am going to resist because I’d probably have done it myself if I’d let myself consider it.

                                                                                                                                                                  Patrizia was chained up in the conference room, and the work looked remarkably like that which we’d had to deal with in Amarna. It looked like Ms. Ironwood was our traitor.

                                                                                                                                                                  To get Artie out, Ophelia attached a potion to Remy and set his loose outside SATT through a very small portal. It would take him a while to make hit way to Artie’s private office so we moved to the estate to consult with Aphrodite and plan our next move.

                                                                                                                                                                  Aphrodite was shocked to learn what had happened and attempted to summon her sister who appeared to ignore her. Maggie’s cameras show her taking tea with Ironwood.

                                                                                                                                                                  We also saw that the door by the second floor gym was visible now.

                                                                                                                                                                  We decided we had to rescue Patrizia and retrieve Brainbiter from the 2nd floor before Ironwood got her hands on it.

                                                                                                                                                                  While we planned, I gave Merryweather a call to see if he’d heard anything about what was going on. He seemed a little surprised as he was under the impression that SATT instigated it. I downplayed matters as typical bureaucratic nonsense where the left hand didn’t know what the right was doing and learned that a white paper was going through which involved us. I persuaded him to send me a copy.

                                                                                                                                                                  The paper was compiled by Leo Miller who is a minor civil servant under Brandon Doyle (Deputy Home Secretary with connections to Mithras). It sets out a public-private partnership / NGO with Asclepius UK, Felicity Ash, Annabelle Rowland (who had been added to the board of directors two days previously), and Olivia Ironwood. It grants them powers under existing terrorism legislation that effectively gives them carte blanche to hunt down people like us.

                                                                                                                                                                  Henry took Winston for a ride into the garage as a distraction. Artie and I headed for the sword. Maggie and Alexia went to rescue Patrizia. Ophelia remained at the estate on portal duty.

                                                                                                                                                                  The distraction went off without a hitch. The rescue of Patrizia involved ripping the chair, the chains and some of the floor out and taking them to the estate, and the gym door turned out to be a little trickier.

                                                                                                                                                                  The handle wouldn’t budge an inch for Grandfather, and only moved a little for me. Exactly a fifth of what I’d expect.

                                                                                                                                                                  We summoned the rest of the team, and between us we were able to open it and enter a chamber containing a five flaming braziers and a large stone with five weapons embedded in it. Artie found himself unable to pass through the door.

                                                                                                                                                                  The stone held the sword we were expecting, a bow, a dagger, a mace, and a sword cane.

                                                                                                                                                                  The tailoring of them to our preferences gave me a profound, and uncomfortable, sense of inevitability. I grew up feeling I was beholden to father’s wishes and denied free will. This responsibility came with a nasty reminder of that feeling.

                                                                                                                                                                  With the weapons removed, the stone shrunk down so we took it and the braziers with us too.

                                                                                                                                                                  Back at the estate we started making plans and checking on our friends and allies.

                                                                                                                                                                  Just as I was starting to worry about Michelle, she drove up with Ziczzi and Elliott in toe. Picking him up explained why it took her so long to get here. I breathed a sigh of relief. Nate and Morgan had their own places to hole up in.

                                                                                                                                                                  Whisper was our primary inside man. She reported that Theon was dubious about the whole matter and didn’t know where to put his loyalties. I passed her a copy of the whitepaper to show him; he wasn’t pleased.

                                                                                                                                                                  Since Hecate witnessed the original swearing of oaths, Ophelia invited her to dinner. The politics of having her in a place dedicated to Aphrodite were… interesting.

                                                                                                                                                                  She brought gifts, and Henry received a Pearl that would ensure privacy for our conversations. She also strongly hinting that I was going to be her apprentice… gulp.

                                                                                                                                                                  Dinner conversation covered the history of SATT and was interrupted when Eric turned up and took up position by the Watling Estate’s gates.

                                                                                                                                                                  Since Ironwood had expressed an interest in the location of Excalibur and Patrizia had told me that Artie said he knew where it was, I just asked him.

                                                                                                                                                                  His answer?

                                                                                                                                                                  In the lake where Gawain chucked it over a millennia ago.

                                                                                                                                                                  Gods give me strength.

                                                                                                                                                                  Someone, I can’t remember who, said it was a shame we couldn’t ask Gawain so I sighed and said I’d call him.

                                                                                                                                                                  The room exploded.

                                                                                                                                                                  Honestly I’m surprised. Given everything that happened his past year or so I wouldn’t have thought the revelation that Gawain was still alive would come as a shock to a group of people who routinely spent time with Arthur and Lancelot… and as for Grandfather, I thought the revelation had come out at the Peace Talks.

                                                                                                                                                                  I had to take him outside and spill Sam’s identity to get him to drop the subject. So that’s another secret I have to apologise for giving away, and this time I don’t have one of the Strifes to blame.

                                                                                                                                                                  Sam also hasn’t seen the sword since it went into the lake. The Lady was one of Britannia’s scions, which doesn’t bode well, and that’s assuming nobody else has found it in the meantime. Like my father. He would really enjoy having Excalibur locked away in a secret room somewhere where he could go and stroke it from time to time.

                                                                                                                                                                  I’ve asked him to come to London and said I’ll pick him up the airport. We’re going to need some complicated conversations about Grandfather, Lancelot, and SATT and I’d really rather have them in person and at Mac’s.

                                                                                                                                                                  Ares and Ptah are at risk of censure by The Council which is meeting next month. Operating the portal magic on Midgard is a bit treaty violation so they could get the Furies set on them.

                                                                                                                                                                  I worry that with that news on the wind they might advance their plans to get ahead of things.

                                                                                                                                                                  Hecate returned with Hestia having consulted with Sancus; there’s enough evidence to declare them oathbreakers if they do anything to endanger mortals.

                                                                                                                                                                  The next day I had an early start to get to London and meet with Merryweather.

                                                                                                                                                                  Eric had settled in at the temporary HQ happily setting up along side the Tulip Guard.

                                                                                                                                                                  I called ahead to make sure he’d be waiting for me. There was an odd noise in the background, like a talking bird, but not a variety I could place.

                                                                                                                                                                  When I pulled up at his door I was surprised, but pleased, to see Agent Smith accompanying him.

                                                                                                                                                                  The conversation was moderately productive; they are, sadly, playing both sides for now but were happy to receive some dirt on Asclepius that I was able to dredge up from Mina’s network of rescued children last night.

                                                                                                                                                                  I was asked to use Agent Smith as a point of contact, and got some phone numbers and an email address from him.

                                                                                                                                                                  When they left, there was a feather left behind. It appears than Merryweather had a phoenix in his briefcase. Very odd.

                                                                                                                                                                  Meanwhile back at that Churchill War Rooms, the Archive Team had barricaded themselves the archive, it all looked very defensible and the chief was looking forward to getting some work done without interruption.

                                                                                                                                                                  Chris (scion of Ares and 2IC of the armoury) was being very friendly with Ironwood, there was no sign of his boss Ewen.

                                                                                                                                                                  Ice was having an argument with some of the armoured goons that Ironwood had brought in.

                                                                                                                                                                  The cameras in the morgue that Maggie had fitted were not functioning, but Alexia could sense a fire in there so she was able to view through that. After testing some personal information to make sure Alexia was who she claimed to be, and learning that Maggie was responsible for the cameras (which the spirits had warned him about), Watson relaxed a little and we gave him a briefing.

                                                                                                                                                                  He is going to help us set a trap for Ironwood at the Crosby Estate.

                                                                                                                                                                  We started making plans for an oath swearing in which we ended up with a significant guest list and a need to find a location.

                                                                                                                                                                  Alexia called Mac who was more than a little upset that she hadn’t sought sanctuary with him. His reaction when she suggested having the ceremony there and who would be attending was something along the lines of:

                                                                                                                                                                  I am not powerful enough to lock down the entire Greek pantheon!

                                                                                                                                                                  Location still undecided, although I have a feeling we may end up at the British Museum, we divvied up the invitees amongst ourselves.

                                                                                                                                                                  The previous night I’d asked Michelle if, given the changes in SATT’s organisation that she might want to join SATT. Not that I was asking her to, I wanted her to make that decision because she wanted not, not because I wanted her to.

                                                                                                                                                                  That sentence is a right mess.

                                                                                                                                                                  She’d spent most of the day discussing it with Nate, Elliott & Mina and had come to a decision. Nate told us they would join us… so long as they reported to me.

                                                                                                                                                                  Great. I seem to have been nominated Director of Dodgy Operations.

                                                                                                                                                                  It’s Henry who pulled the magical concealed weapon out of the stone.

                                                                                                                                                                  Much as I wanted to go to bed, Alexia prodded into drawing out a protective circle around the room storing those weapons. It was somewhat old school; a variant on the rituals surrounding the vigil a squire would take on the night before their knighting ceremony.

                                                                                                                                                                  See also:
                                                                                                                                                                  • Mordred son of Mordred

                                                                                                                                                                  Dinner with Freya

                                                                                                                                                                  Mar 2023

                                                                                                                                                                  Michelle and I met Freya at The Haunch of Venison]3 for dinner and to tell her the news about SATT. She was entirely in agreement with us about the whole matter and delighted that Michelle was joining SATT.

                                                                                                                                                                  Michelle, on the other hand, looked like she wanted to crawl out of her skin at the first sign of approval from her mother. That is some rebellious streak she has.

                                                                                                                                                                  Freya seemed surprised when I took Michelle’s side over some trifling matter; I’m not sure why. I wouldn’t be with Michelle if I didn’t think highly of her.

                                                                                                                                                                  See also:

                                                                                                                                                                    Gawain in London

                                                                                                                                                                    Mar 2023

                                                                                                                                                                    I filled Sam in about the situation and drove him to his London home.

                                                                                                                                                                    The treaty seems to be holding; everyone is behaving. Themis and Theia are arguing for peace. Chronos is, unsurprisingly, against it. Apep is keeping quiet.

                                                                                                                                                                    He wants to meet Artie, but is nervous about it. He, Grandfather and Whisper are a right trio. A millennium of avoiding each other because they might find out they’ve fallen out.

                                                                                                                                                                    See also:

                                                                                                                                                                      Father is Pleased

                                                                                                                                                                      Mar 2023

                                                                                                                                                                      The girl with the purple eyes has taken Metty’s place in the throne room. He clearly trusts her and had no problems with her hearing my report.

                                                                                                                                                                      I updated him on the civil war in SATT and he suggested Vivian might be involved, but he hasn’t see her in centuries.

                                                                                                                                                                      I told him about the Druids in Amarna and suggested it would enhance the family image if he were to offer reinforcements for them. He liked the idea and was willing to offer two hundred warriors but wanted some healing potions and trained birds in return. I think I might be kept busy as a go-between for a while.

                                                                                                                                                                      He provided me with his signet ring. That gives me a lot of authority. A worrying amount. I locked it away in a quiet little bank under my Dawson alias just in case he was planning to track me through it.

                                                                                                                                                                      See also:

                                                                                                                                                                        Boston, Lincolnshire

                                                                                                                                                                        Mar 2023

                                                                                                                                                                        Henry has been off trying to lure Section 1 into attacking him. It didn’t work. He did, however, make contact with someone calling themselves Agent K.

                                                                                                                                                                        They claim to work for the crown and think that Asclepius’ presence in the UK should be eliminated.

                                                                                                                                                                        It seems that John Dee made a prophecy that Henry would help the monarchy with a medical (that was the term used, despite it being anachronistic) matter. That tracks with eliminating Asclepius.

                                                                                                                                                                        K also left him a note saying that Ironwood was amassing forces. That does not sound good.

                                                                                                                                                                        Meanwhile at SATT Colin the cactus hasn’t been tracked down by the new management yet, and Watson has been autopsying one of Ironwood’s goons who has been stabbed by a 6–8″ dagger.

                                                                                                                                                                        With a convoy of goods heading north, we decided to take a much overdue trip to Boston to investigate the warehouse there.

                                                                                                                                                                        It wasn’t shy about advertising its ownership as being Asclepius. The local weren’t too happy with it; the workforce there weren’t mixing with them so they didn’t have a lot to tell us though. Security was high, but there was a possible blind spot in the camera ring.

                                                                                                                                                                        Remy scouted the area and we got a general idea of the layout.

                                                                                                                                                                        Later, undercover of darkness I went in. Slipping past the cameras I made my want into the security office, hooked a phone up to a PC so that Maggie could get access to their network — which was nicely air gapped before I got involved — stole a security jacket and went to explore.

                                                                                                                                                                        The paper files didn’t turn up anything too interesting, but the research section was a bazaar of horrors. They had numerous samples of blood and other liquids, to which I helped myself so Ophelia could do an analysis later on, a coffin-like injection machine (which I sabotaged), and a disturbing number of caged rabbits (which I freed after spray-painting PETA on the wall).

                                                                                                                                                                        Analysis

                                                                                                                                                                        Among the contents of the vials were blood (human, Scion, and Nāga) and a modified version of the Hyde Formula.

                                                                                                                                                                        Making sure that the phone I’d hooked up was neatly hidden inside the cable tidy at the back of the security desk, I made my exit.

                                                                                                                                                                        Meanwhile, Maggie had been tracking the SATT convoy. It had bypassed Boston and was making its way towards the Peak District — and her library.

                                                                                                                                                                        We portaled out way there sharpish.

                                                                                                                                                                        Henry talked them out of attacking the library. He had to, the rest of us have too many Titan associations for it to fly. It was a close thing though.

                                                                                                                                                                        I ran some tests of father’s ring. It doesn’t seem to have any magic associated with it, so I think it is safe.

                                                                                                                                                                        See also:

                                                                                                                                                                          The Runway & The Sword

                                                                                                                                                                          Mar 2023

                                                                                                                                                                          During a week of fashions shows we caught wind of models, who are often scions, disappearing. Being near the location we thought the Bardess had landed after the death of Verdas, we decided to deal with that issue at the same time.

                                                                                                                                                                          We used the temple at Montepulciano as our base of operations.

                                                                                                                                                                          We split our forces, which I still think was a mistake. The disappearances were recent and ongoing; a much more immediate threat that the Bardess who had been in her current situation for weeks. Henry, however, insisted. This is typical of him; always putting the smallest problems of people he knows above the greatest danger to strangers.

                                                                                                                                                                          At San Galgano Abbey, Alexia pulled at the sword in the stone and heard a wren. The weapon felt cold to Henry’s touch. The wren seemed upset by a deer, which has a weird pattern on it. Henry grabbed at the deer and it started to transform switching through several forms including that of a tortoise and a bear before turning into the Bardess.

                                                                                                                                                                          If this reads like one of the weirder sections of Le Morte d’Arthur then you can blame the people who were there for the telling of it.

                                                                                                                                                                          The Bardess had a spear wound that was a couple of days old.

                                                                                                                                                                          Maggie had intercepted an email:

                                                                                                                                                                          Subject C held in containment facility G in Grosseto should be ready to collect blood samples from next week. Rick don’t get the riding schools mixed up this time. C.i.a.m. centro

                                                                                                                                                                          We found a recuperation centre run by the Iaso Foundation that makes use of horse riding as part of its exercise programs in the area. It is run by something called by the Iaso Foundation. Iaso is one of the daughters of Asclepius. I think we have a target.

                                                                                                                                                                          Meanwhile, the rest of us attended the Bruno Ferrante fashion show.

                                                                                                                                                                          Thanks to the maidens, we were kitted out to look our best at the show.

                                                                                                                                                                          There was much mingling before Ophelia took one of the models back to her hotel… and they were both kidnapped en-route. I followed and confirmed they were being taken to the equestrian centre.

                                                                                                                                                                          Henry and Maggie followed on behind following my directions.

                                                                                                                                                                          Winston managed to show up. Somehow.

                                                                                                                                                                          By the time we’d finished kicking doors in, we’d uncovered some very unsavoury labs, rescued about 30 people (including a Naga) and set the place on fire.

                                                                                                                                                                          See also:
