                                                                                                                                                                                                The Day of the Heb Sed

                                                                                                                                                                                                Oct 2023

                                                                                                                                                                                                Ophelia supplied each of us with a healing potion. I took a pouch of the empowered sand.

                                                                                                                                                                                                Split up to get the artefacts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                Maggie & Elliott attacked leaving Horseguards by green robed figures wielded a Vauxhall Vectra and jewelled daggers. Maggie escapes with the bow. Leaves Elliott behind with a portal potion. He doesn’t use it or remain in contact, scrying did show him moving about central London.

                                                                                                                                                                                                The robed attackers intercept me and Alexia at the same time. We portal out, leaving a mess on the road.

                                                                                                                                                                                                The field is prepared for the Heb Sed. The Maidens are catering.

                                                                                                                                                                                                Michelle and Susan Grey take an instant dislike to each other.

                                                                                                                                                                                                All the Gods arrive. Except Ptah. Maggie does to find the Ladies who will hopefully be able to summon him.

                                                                                                                                                                                                Seb reports activity at the Lost City of Z.

                                                                                                                                                                                                Set gets concerned.

                                                                                                                                                                                                Ptah arrives at the Heb Sed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                Set looks old and very, very frail.

                                                                                                                                                                                                See also:

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Underworld

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Oct 2023

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Down stairs. Became dryer and hotter.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Lit by torches. Henry & Elliott were arguing over a book.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  We can’t hear them.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Elliott tries to hug Maggie and falls through her.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Henry taking Mina’s blood allows us to hear him. Elliott takes Alexia’s blood.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Mina’s wound transfers to Henry.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  We can hear Elliott.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Fire up ahead and much prevaricating from the team.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Remmy hot

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Mordred worried about using ice magic down here since it might be from Hel

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Henry can now understand Remy. Henry drops the news that Patrixia’s scorpion had delivered a message to Henry.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Tzona has disappeared and been replaced by a bright green kopesh. Elliott has a was septre.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Lake of fire. Gate in the middle of the fire. Snake curled around it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Did not like mention of Moses.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Alexia parted the fire.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  I felt Elliott’s akh in the fire and was able to retrieve it.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  The guardian asked us to sort out the weirdness.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  We came to a fork in the road. I sought for the feeling of Henry’s akh: We headed to the left.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  It opened into a cavern. Huge pool of water. Giant, bellowing, hippopotamus. Playing with a snake and a shaggy version of Henry — his akh.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Reuniting with himself and making peace with the hippo, we pass through the gate.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Artie got in touch on the Mk IIIs. 3 days have passed top side. We give him a progress report.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Aphrodite has gone to Olympus and is demanding to see Zeus. Sekmet is doing something similar with Osiris.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Something weird is apparently going on in Ireland. Sighting of the wyld hunt. Something on Twitter.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Looong corridor. Then rabbits. Multiple. Then hares. Then a bigger hare.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Hare deity: Wenet

                                                                                                                                                                                                  She appears to us… dressed as a Myan god. She was not pleased to have been “summoned”. Maggie explains what is going on. This twiggs her that the rest of us speak English so she switches.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  I made sure she knew about the oddness with the gates.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Wenet started prodding her wrist computer. Yes, she has a wrist computer.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  She draws a map. Shows that the path we are on is missing.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Notices that we have the guidebook and points out all the bits which are now wrong.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  The changes are beyond anything she or Thoth could do. Maybe Osiris & Wepwawet together could do it. Maybe Osiris or Hades.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  We speculate about how could do it. Isis is suspect. Probably needed help for it to be permanent.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Wenet takes an interest in Morgan when she comments on how great vents would be and the conversation ends up with the scion receiving a business card.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  On the other side of the wall is Apep, chained. Gate 10. We chant and stab him. Henry and Elliott get their somethings back.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Scorpian turns up. It’s been two weeks. The godesses are still upset.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Venessa not in Artie’s good books. Got compared to Guinivere. Patrixia annoyed with the ranting.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  We go to the heart chamber.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Maat missing. Croc very happy to feast on everyone.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Summon Thoth.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Can’t summon Maat.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Decide to summon Themis.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Thoth agrees and goes into a panic.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Takes a lot to pull her through. Something is blocking her. A barrier.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  She tells them to produce their hearts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Ophellia and Mini identify Henries with love.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Maggie finds Elliott’s with the voice of authority.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Elliot’s heart is weighted. It dips, but then rises up with a stream of his good deeds, then flies into his chest.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Themis: “HAve you recorded”

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Thoth: “Yes, yes my lady. All recorded”

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Henry’s heart is placed on the scales.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  They dip to the heart again, but then bounce up with many many many stories of sacrifices and blatant idiotic stupidity raise it back up. It flies off the sales and into Henry.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Themis stays to keep things in order.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Thoth opens the way. Door opens onto fields with pyramids.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  As soon we Henry and Elliott walk through the door he gets his “sars” back.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  There is a pryamid surrounded by a green barrier.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  The magic weapons carried by the ghosts break the barrier - with Maggie’s help.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Henry disappears (presumably snatched by Athena).

                                                                                                                                                                                                  The pyramid turns into stairs.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Climing them Eliott disappears near the top. When the rest of us get to the top. We’re back in Scotland.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  We’ve been gone a month.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Boys resurected.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Elliott proposes to Maggie. She says yes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Michael spent the last month trying to get through to me

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Trevette is in charge of his family

                                                                                                                                                                                                  She has ordered Michael to continue his work with the Library and Temple of Isis.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Apep is “quiet”

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Believes goddess (Isis) has broken with the pantheon

                                                                                                                                                                                                  We think P’tah has too

                                                                                                                                                                                                  At Heb Sed: Pheonix fought against Apep. Michel stood apart. Hand of Isis started out with us and then turned against us.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Hera was trying to pacify Aphrodite, not Zeus.

                                                                                                                                                                                                  Elliot: Things have returned to normal. Themis issue all OK but don’t do it again.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Shadow Hide

                                                                                                                                                                                                    You can hide unnoticed in any area of shadow big enough to hide your body. Someone with super hearing or smell will be able to make a contested roll to know that you are there.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    The Kladenets, Sword of Darkness

                                                                                                                                                                                                    You can use the sword to cast an area of darkness. This can work in conjunction with your shadow hide.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Blessing

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Takes time to prepare. Target (which can be self) rolls 3d6k2 instead of 2d6 until the blessing expires. Level affects range.

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Create Ice

                                                                                                                                                                                                    Creates ice out of moisture in the air. Effectiveness varies with the weather conditions.
